scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
The Head Chef has been waiting for you. He is enraged now!
Go to the kitchen now!
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
主廚一直在等你。他現在很生氣！
快去廚房！

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
I am living in a whirl of business!
I have been seeing too many people these days that I am even confused about the familiar faces now.
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
我忙得暈頭轉向！
最近見的人太多了，連熟臉都分不清了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
I am sorry about the misunderstanding.
I have been badgered by the Head Chef too much... Haha...
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
抱歉讓你誤會了。
我被主廚逼得太緊了...哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
I am living in a whirl of business!
I have been seeing too many people these days that I am even confused about the familiar faces now.
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
我忙得暈頭轉向！
最近見的人太多了，連熟臉都分不清了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
Hey, you! I have been looking for you!
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
嘿，就是你！我一直在找你！
你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
The Head Chef has been waiting for you. He is enraged now!
Go to the kitchen now!
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
主廚一直在等你。他現在很生氣！
快去廚房！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Argh!
When will this special assistant chef arrive here?
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
啊！
那個特別助廚什麼時候才能到？

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Argh!
When will this special's assistant chef arrive here?
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
啊！
那個特別助廚什麼時候才能到？

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Of course!
The food for the banquet is perfect!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
當然！
宴會的食物完美無缺！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
More!
More!
More!
Much more!
I want to satisfy the guests!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
更多！
更多！
更多！
還要更多！
我要讓客人們滿意！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I can't just let go of the banquet of my life this fabulously!
It should be more fabulous!
No, much more fabulous!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
我不能就這樣放過我人生中最棒的宴會！
它應該更棒！
不，要棒得多！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Hum...
I won't be satisfied if it was not miraculously luxurious and superlatively fabulous!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
嗯...
如果不是奇蹟般地奢華、極致地華麗，我是不會滿意的！

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef Apprentice[Royal Chef]
Head Chef!
We have a guest for you, Head Chef...
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師學徒]
主廚！
主廚，有位客人來找您...

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
You are late!
How can you be so late when we don't even have a second to spare!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
你遲到了！
我們分秒必爭，你怎麼能這麼晚！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I would have placed you in the Poring Range for a week!
But today is a special day. So I'll punish you later!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
我本該把你關進波利牧場一週！
但今天是特殊日子。所以我稍後再懲罰你！

scripts.text: Ask about the situation.
scripts.translation: 詢問情況

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
It is not the most important thing now!
Let's stop talking and make the banquet more fabulous!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在這不是最重要的事！
別廢話了，讓宴會更華麗吧！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Go to the empty spot and get prepared to cook!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
去空位那裡，準備好開始烹飪！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Once you prepare a piece of Griffon meat... You need to pour the sauce... What?
The sauce... Eh?
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
當你準備好一塊獅鷲肉後...你需要澆上醬汁...什麼？
醬汁...咦？

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Wait a minute!
The sauce is gone! Unbelievable!
We cannot do anything without the sauce!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
等一下！
醬汁不見了！難以置信！
沒有醬汁我們什麼都做不了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
You! The new assistant!
Go get the sauce from Oriental Oyster the sauce master!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
你！新來的助手！
去東方牡蠣那裡拿醬汁，他是醬汁大師！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now! Quick!
Hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在！快！
快點！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Isn't the sauce ready?
Go get the sauce from Oriental Oyster the sauce master!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
醬汁還沒好嗎？
去東方牡蠣那裡拿醬汁，他是醬汁大師！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now! Quick!
Hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在！快！
快點！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Oh!
This exquisite taste made by the master!
It is perfect!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
哦！
大師調變的這精緻味道！
完美！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Let's start cooking now!
Go to the empty spot and get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
讓我們開始烹飪吧！
去空位那裡，做好準備。

scripts.text:

Go to the empty spot and get prepared.
scripts.translation:

去空位那裡，做好準備。

scripts.text:

Now, you can bring this to the kitchen. That is the only thing left to do!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在，你可以把這個帶到廚房了。這是最後要做的了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
What are you waiting for!
Run to the dining room with this dish!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
你在等什麼！
帶著這道菜跑到餐廳去！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
A Royal Chef must be able to fill the empty plates as fast as possible!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
御用廚師必須能儘快填滿空盤子！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Arghhhh!
The mind for cooking!
The mind of the queen!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
啊哈哈哈！
烹飪的心！
女王的心！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
With the blazing spirit of mine!
I'll make the best dish!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
帶著我熊熊燃燒的鬥志！
我要做出最好的菜！

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你持有的物品太多了。
請整理你的背包並再試一次。-

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Arghhhhh!
I am sorry!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
啊哈哈哈！
對不起！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I thought you were the new assistant chef who was supposed to come. I am sorry about all the trouble!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
我以為你是那個本該來的新助手廚師。對於所有的麻煩，我很抱歉！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I have scolded the one who has brought you, hero. Please forgive us!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
我已經責罵了那個帶你來的人，英雄。請原諒我們！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
However, you really seem to have a true talent in cooking!
Grilled Griffon!
It was delicious!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
不過，你似乎真的很有烹飪天賦！
烤獅鷲！
真好吃！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I hope to be able to cook with you again!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
希望能再次和你一起烹飪！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
This is not the time!
Rush to the dining room before the food goes cold!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在不是時候！
在食物變涼之前衝到餐廳去！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Haha, I've been waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
哈哈，我一直在等你呢！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Let's not waste time and start cooking now!
Go to the empty spot and get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
別浪費時間了，現在開始烹飪吧！
去空位那裡做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Argh!
Take a rest now!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
哎呀！
現在休息一下！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
If I push you too hard, I would be in trouble!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
如果我逼你太緊，我就有麻煩了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
As each dish has the best moment to tastes it, each person has the best time to engage in cooking!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
每道菜都有最佳的品嚐時刻，每個人也有最適合烹飪的時間！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
You there!
You are getting in the way!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
喂！
你擋路了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now... then!
Today's main dish is the Grilled Griffon with the special sauce. The crust should be crunchy while the inside is juicy!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
那麼...開始吧！
今天的主菜是特製醬汁烤獅鷲。外皮要酥脆，裡面要多汁！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Since it is a dish for the banquet!
Each dish should look and taste exactly the same! Don't forget!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
這可是宴會用的菜！
每道菜的外觀和味道都必須完全一致！別忘了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Take a good look at what I do now, and do exactly the same!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
好好看我現在的動作，然後照做！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Yap!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
啪！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Humph!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
哼！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Whoa!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
哇！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Bam!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
砰！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Hahahaha!
An excellent Grilled Griffon DX is made!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
哈哈哈！
做出一道完美的特製醬汁烤獅鷲！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now, you can bring this to the kitchen. That is the only thing left to do!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在，你可以把這個帶到廚房了。這是最後要做的了！

scripts.text:

What are you waiting for!
Run to the dining room with this dish!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
你在等什麼！
帶著這道菜跑到餐廳去！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
A Royal Chef must be able to fill the empty plates as fast as possible!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
御用廚師必須能儘快填滿空盤子！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Hum... How savory!
The perfect combinations is just divine...
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
嗯...好鮮美！
完美的搭配簡直是神賜的...

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
What?
The sauce ran out?
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
什麼？
醬汁用完了？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
I am in trouble!
You don't know what the Head Chef would do if I am late...
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
我完蛋了！
你知道如果我遲到了，主廚會怎麼對我嗎...

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Hum... I need to make the sauce fast.
I am sorry to ask but would you help me with this?
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
嗯...我得快點做醬汁。
不好意思，能幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
My apprentice was sent to the medical office because he slipped on the sauce...
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
我的學徒因為滑倒在醬汁上，被送去醫務室了...

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
I cannot stop stirring the sauce. You can bring me the ingredient as I say the name.
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
我不能停下攪拌醬汁。我說出食材名字時，你幫我拿來。

scripts.text: [Oriental Oyster]
scripts.translation: [東方牡蠣]

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Oh my...
The ingredient is like the life for a sauce.
There shouldn't be a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
天哪...
食材對於醬汁來說就像生命一樣重要。
絕對不能出錯。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Then, let's start over from the beginning!
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
那麼，讓我們從頭開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Bring me the ingredient!
The Head Chef is looking at me with the set of murderous eyes!
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
把食材拿來！
主廚正用殺人的眼神盯著我呢！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Hum, very good!
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
嗯，非常好！

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你持有的物品太多了。
請整理你的背包並再試一次。-

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Oh!
Very good!
Thanks to you, I could make the perfect sauce!
Bring it to the Head Chef now!
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
哦！
非常好！
多虧了你，我做出了完美的醬汁！
現在立刻把它端給主廚！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
You seem to be talented in sauce making.
Why don't you become a master sauce maker?
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
你似乎在製作醬汁方面很有天賦。
為什麼不成為一位醬汁大師呢？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Oh!
Very good!
Thanks to you, I could make the perfect sauce!
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
哦！
非常好！
多虧了你，我做出了完美的醬汁！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
You seem to be talented in sauce making.
Why don't you become a master sauce maker?
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
你似乎在製作醬汁方面很有天賦。
為什麼不成為一位醬汁大師呢？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
I knew you would come again!
That is the magic of the sauce!
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
我就知道你會再來的！
這就是醬汁的魔力！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
How about making a fabulous sauce today?
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
今天要不要做一款絕妙的醬汁？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Oh my!
The palate is very important for a chef.
When you are tired the palate doesn't work properly.
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
天哪！
對於廚師來說，味覺非常重要。
當你疲憊時，味覺就無法正常工作了。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
You seem very tired now.
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
你現在看起來很累。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
If you want to make a perfect sauce, take some rest.
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
如果你想做出完美的醬汁，先休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Oh! You are here!
Did you take a rest? How about making the sauce again?
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
哦！你來了！
休息好了嗎？要不要再試試做醬汁？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
I hope you don't waste your talent.
Why don't you become a master sauce maker?
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
我希望你不要浪費你的天賦。
為什麼不成為一位醬汁大師呢？

scripts.text: [Oriental Oyster]
scripts.translation: [東方牡蠣]

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
First, bring me the ingredient for the refreshing flavor.
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
首先，給我拿來清爽口味的食材。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Bring me the ingredient for the chewy texture.
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
給我拿來有嚼勁口感的食材。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Bring me the ingredient that shines brightly.
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
給我拿來閃閃發光的食材。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
First, bring me the ingredient for the soft taste.
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
首先，給我拿來口感柔軟的食材。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Yes! That's it!
Bring it to me!
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
沒錯！就是這個！
把它拿給我！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Argh!
The sauce is ruined!
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
啊！
醬汁毀了！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
We cannot use this sauce now!
We should start again from the beginning!
scripts.translation:
[東方牡蠣]
這個醬汁現在沒法用了！
我們得從頭再來！

scripts.text:
The juice made of fresh Muka
It is refreshing.
scripts.translation:
用新鮮摩卡製成的果汁
清爽可口。

scripts.text:
Jelly made of chewy Poring
It emphasizes the chewy texture...
scripts.translation:
用Q彈的波利製成的果凍
突出了Q彈的口感...

scripts.text:
The powder made of Shining Plant
It adds some sparkles to the dish.
scripts.translation:
用光芒草製成的粉末
能為菜餚增添幾分光彩。

scripts.text:
Giantaurus Milk Butter
It tastes surprisingly soft.
scripts.translation:
巨牛乳酪
口感意外地柔軟。

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
I wash the dishes again... Again... Again...
And it never ends!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
我又在洗碗了... 又... 又...
這永遠沒有盡頭！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
However, this is the fate of a Dishwasher!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
不過，這就是洗碗工的命運！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
It is a fate!
I have to endure it!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
這就是命運！
我必須忍受它！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Please bring me!
More dishes to wash!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
請給我拿來！
更多要洗的盤子！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
I'll get over it!
My fate!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
我會克服的！
我的命運！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Hahaha... It is a new plate.
I'll make it squeaky clean like this!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
哈哈... 這是一個新盤子。
我要把它洗得閃閃發亮！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Oh... The Head Chef has been looking for you.
Is there any problem?
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
哦... 主廚一直在找你。
有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Oh... The Head Chef has been looking for you.
Is there any problem?
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
哦... 主廚一直在找你。
有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Oh! Are you here to help me again?
Isn't a clean dish makes you feel clean?
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
哦！你又是來幫我的嗎？
乾淨的盤子難道不讓你感覺清爽嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Well, I guess it is just normal to feel that way!
With that spirit! Please bring me 15 more dishes to wash!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
嗯，我覺得有這種感覺很正常！
帶著這種精神！請再給我拿來15個要洗的盤子！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Please be careful with them, since those are some precious dishes!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
請小心一點，因為那些是很珍貴的盤子！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
I wash the dishes again... Again... Again...
And it never ends!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
我又在洗碗了... 又... 又...
這永遠沒有盡頭！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
However, this is the fate of a Dishwasher!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
不過，這就是洗碗工的命運！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
It is a fate!
I have to endure it!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
這就是命運！
我必須忍受它！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Please bring me!
Please bring me about 15 more dishes to wash!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
請給我拿來！
請再給我拿來大約15個要洗的盤子！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
I'll get over it!
My fate!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
我會克服的！
我的命運！

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你持有的物品太多了。
請整理你的背包並再試一次。-

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Hahaha... It is a new plate.
I'll make it squeaky clean like this!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
哈哈... 這是一個新盤子。
我要把它洗得閃閃發亮！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Don't push yourself too hard.
Why don't you go take a rest and come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
別太勉強自己了。
為什麼不去休息一下，明天再來呢？

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Thank you for helping me last time!
It is very important to take enough rest after work.
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
謝謝你上次幫我！
工作後充分休息是非常重要的。

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Argh!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
啊！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
The housewife's eczema is back in action in my right hand!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
主婦的溼疹又在我右手發作了！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Hode Cream!
Please give me the Hode Cream!
Arghhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
蚯蚓霜！
快給我蚯蚓霜！
啊——！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
My cooking was perfect!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我的烹飪完美無缺！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I cannot believe that I am able to cook with the Head Chef!
It feels like I am dreaming!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我簡直不敢相信，我能和主廚一起烹飪！
感覺像是在做夢一樣！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Delicious!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
真好吃！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I prefer to have it with salt than sugar!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
比起加糖，我更喜歡加鹽！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
The best way to taste it is to taste it as it is! The best flavor is the flavor of the ingredient itself!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
品嚐它最好的方式就是原味品嚐！
最好的味道就是食材本身的味道！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Dear Head Chef! Please marry me!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
親愛的主廚！請嫁給我吧！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hello.{0}.
Are you having a good time?
May I help you?
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
你好，{0}。
玩得開心嗎？
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Tell him about Tamarin.
scripts.translation: 告訴他關於塔馬林的事

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Oh!
He...
He was making fun of me for working here! How great!
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
哦！
他...
他居然嘲笑我在這兒工作！太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Please tell him to work hard!
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
請告訴他要努力工作！
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Alice]
Oh, Tamarin must be the friend who often goes missing, right?
scripts.translation:

哦，塔馬林一定是那個經常失蹤的朋友，對吧？

[馬克]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

哈哈哈哈！

Oh, Tamarin must be the friend who often goes missing, right?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Mark]
{0}, please tell Tamarin that.
I hope to be able to get away from the preparation duty for the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
{0}，請告訴塔馬林這件事。
我希望自己能擺脫宴會的準備工作。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hello. {0}.
Are you having a good time?
May I help you?
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
你好，{0}。
玩得開心嗎？
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alice]
Mark! You shouldn't put it there. Put it here...
Since we are working at the palace, we shouldn't overlook even the tiniest thing!
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲]
馬克！你不應該把它放在那裡。放在這裡...
既然我們在宮殿工作，就不能忽視任何微小的細節！

scripts.text:
[Alice]
Hum... I know you are busy, but you shouldn't just make people work for no good reason since it is the business of the palace.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲]
嗯...我知道你很忙，但你不應該無緣無故地讓人工作，因為這是宮殿的事務。

scripts.text:
[Alice]
I'll tell them about it. Would you let Tamarin know?
The preparation for the banquet doesn't end until the banquet is over.

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Eh?
No wonder he wasn't coming back!
Since he often goes missing, I didn't give it much thought.
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
咦？
難怪他沒回來！
因為他經常失蹤，所以我沒太在意。

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Since Mark is working here as well. Why don't we ask him?
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
既然馬克也在這裡工作，我們為什麼不問問他呢？

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Oh, I was caught by his brother.
I was dragged here by force...
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
哦，我被他的哥哥抓住了。
我是被強行拖到這裡來的...

scripts.text:

Where.... Where was it?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Mark is on the stairs. Go up there and see him.
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
你聽到了嗎？
馬克在樓梯上。上去看看他吧。

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Haha!
How unlucky is Mark for working in the banquet held for the heroes!
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
哈哈！
馬克真倒霉，竟然在為英雄們舉辦的宴會上工作！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Haaaaaaa!
What is going on...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哈啊——！
發生什麼事了...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Haaaaaaa!
What is going on...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哈啊——！
發生什麼事了...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Oh...{0}, is that you?
I wondered if you would come since the heroes from all over the places were supposed to attend the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哦...{0}，是你嗎？
我本來以為你會來的，因為各地的英雄都應該參加這場宴會。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Are you enjoying the banquet...
...Wait! You appear to be...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
你正在享受宴會嗎...
...等等！你看起來像是...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
No way!
{0}, did that happen to you too?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
不會吧！
{0}，你也遇到那種情況了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
When I was looking around to find more food for Dyu, someone took me to the Head Chef and made me work there!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
當我四處找食物給迪尤時，有人把我帶到主廚那裡，讓我在那裡工作！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
They were so busy preparing for the banquet that I had no time to explain... And I ended up...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
他們忙著準備宴會，我根本沒時間解釋...結果我就...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Haha... They were just so busy that I couldn't just quit working...
Haha... Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哈哈...他們實在太忙了，我沒法直接辭職不幹了...
哈哈...哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I think it is too late for me...
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我想...對我來說已經太遲了...
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
If you find Dyu in the Banquet Hall, please tell him that I won't be able to go back with food since I am too busy.
Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
如果你在宴會廳找到迪尤，請告訴他，因為我太忙了，沒法帶食物回去。
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:

哈哈哈哈...

Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:

如果你在宴會廳找到迪尤，請告訴他，因為我太忙了，沒法帶食物回去。
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
...Phew, that is my sister.
Well then.{0}, why don't you come with me to enjoy the banquet...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
...呼，那是我妹妹。
那麼，{0}，要不要跟我一起去享受宴會...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
...I guess we should finish what we have been doing!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
...看來我們應該把手頭的事情做完！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I should bring the used dishes to the kitchen.
It would take less time if we do it together. Let's finish it and go eat something delicious!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我得把用過的餐具送到廚房去。
我們一起做會快一些。做完我們就去吃好吃的吧！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I guess we should finish what we have been doing!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
...看來我們應該把手頭的事情做完！

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Hum... What am I supposed to do next...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
嗯...我接下來該做什麼來著...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Whoa...{0}, thank you.
Now I have some room to breathe...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哇...{0}，謝謝你。
現在我終於能喘口氣了...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Oh... It was just impossible for me to quit...
When I was about to leave after reporting to the Head Chef, I was caught by Mark' brother.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
唉...我根本沒法辭職...
我向主廚彙報完準備離開時，被馬克的哥哥抓住了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I guess it would make my life much easier if I just give up.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我想，要是我乾脆放棄的話，生活可能會輕鬆很多。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hello.
You must be the hero whom everyone talks about.
I am honored to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
你好。
想必你就是大家口中那位英雄吧。
很榮幸見到你。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Are you invited to the banquet?
This place is not the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你是受邀參加宴會的嗎？
這裡不是宴會廳。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You must be {0} whom everyone talks about.
Thank you for visiting us.
I am Spica of the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
想必你就是大家口中那位{0}吧。
感謝你的到來。
我是內裡烏斯家族的斯皮卡。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I am Skia.
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我是斯基亞。
很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And he is my bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
他是我的保鏢。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
My name is Crux Findel.
I am learning swordsmanship in the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我叫克魯克斯·芬德爾。
我正在內裡烏斯家族學習劍術。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Our mother, the current head of the family, is supposed to be here.
However, since many heroes like you,{0}, are said to attend this banquet,
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我們的母親，也就是現任家主，本該在這裡的。
不過，據說像您這樣的英雄，{0}，也會參加這場宴會，

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Our mother let us come here to meet and learn from them.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我們的母親讓我們來到這裡，與他們會面並學習。

scripts.text: Where is the candidate for the throne?
scripts.translation: 王位候選人在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Oh, you must be invited as the observer to the ritual...
I see.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哦，您一定是被邀請來觀看儀式的...
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Erich is in the royal library.
I guess he could be looking for blueprints of some sort which interest him.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
埃裡希在皇家圖書館。
我想他可能在尋找一些他感興趣的圖紙。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Nerius is not interested in the throne.
Erich didn't have to participate in the Royal Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
內裡烏斯對王位不感興趣。
埃裡希也不必參加皇家議會。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Since he is just a candidate merely for effect, he must be doing what he wants to do now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
既然他只是為了場面而成為候選人，那他肯定正在做他想做的事。

scripts.text: Why aren't you interested in the throne?
scripts.translation: 為什麼你們對王位不感興趣？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
It is one of the characteristics of the Nerius.
The family is led by women for generations. Therefore, we turn out more queens than kings.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
這是內裡烏斯家族的一個特點。
家族由女性領導了好幾代。因此，我們家族出的女王比國王多。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
If Erich hasn't come forth, one of us, Skia and I would have been elected as a candidate for the queen.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
如果埃裡希沒有出面，我和斯基亞中的一位就會被選為王位候選人。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Our mother didn't like it.
That's why Erich became a candidate for the throne. Poor cousin...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我們的母親不喜歡那樣。
所以埃裡希成為了王位候選人。可憐的表親...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, I guess that's enough information about our family.
Have you exchanged greetings with all other families?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
好了，關於我們家族的資訊大概就這些了。
您和其他家族都打過招呼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Since freedom doesn't come often for us, I tend to enjoy it as much as possible.
So...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
因為自由對我們來說並不常見，所以我傾向於儘可能享受它。
所以...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Why don't you enjoy it with us?
I believe the lord of the Heine family would make a good friend too.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
為什麼不和我們一起享受呢？
我相信海爾內家族的領主也會是個不錯的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia, my beloved twin.
You need to learn to speak more elegantly.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞，我親愛的雙胞胎。
你需要學會說話更優雅一些。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Anyways, what I want to say is that
the Nerius family is always open to you,{0}, so please visit us
anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
總之，我想說的是，
內裡烏斯家族的大門永遠向您敞開，{0}，所以請隨時來訪。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess other families must be ready by now and about to move soon.
We may have some time to spare.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我想其他家族現在應該都準備好了，馬上就要出發了。
我們可能還有些時間。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}, why don't you go back to your room and wait for the message?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}，您為什麼不回房間等待訊息呢？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Why don't you go visit other families if you have not visited them all?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
如果您還沒有拜訪所有家族，為什麼不先去拜訪一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess other families must be ready by now and about to move soon.
We may have some time to spare.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我想其他家族現在應該都準備好了，馬上就要出發了。
我們可能還有些時間。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}, why don't you go back to your room and wait for the message?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}，您為什麼不回房間等待訊息呢？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
We must get prepared for the Banquet now. We need some time to dress up.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我們現在必須為宴會做準備了。我們需要時間換裝。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Why don't you go visit other families if you have not visited them all?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
如果您還沒有拜訪所有家族，為什麼不先去拜訪一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I'll send you a formal invitation to make up for this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我會給您發一封正式邀請函來彌補這次失禮。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I have heard the story briefly from Skia.
Lord Nyhill must have a constitutional weakness for alcohol.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我從斯基亞那裡簡單聽說了這件事。
尼希爾大人肯定有酒精過敏的體質弱點。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are not hiding anything, right?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你沒有什麼在隱瞞吧？

scripts.text: I saw someone suspicious.
scripts.translation: 我看見了可疑的人。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are lying.
I have to let the elders know about this anyway.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你在撒謊。
不管怎樣，我都必須告知長老們這件事。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I wonder if the old folks would hear me out though.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不過，不知道那些老人家會不會聽我解釋。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia told me something similar to that.
Crux didn't find out much.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞也告訴過我類似的事情。
克魯克斯並沒有查出什麼。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess some shady characters must have mixed in with the bunch of temporary employees hired for the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
看來肯定是有幾個不三不四的傢伙混進了為宴會臨時僱傭的員工隊伍裡。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
...Anyways, I guess we have to warn the elders about this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...總之，我想我們必須警告長老們這件事。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Sorry about all the trouble.
How unlucky of you to be involved in this mess.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
抱歉給你添麻煩了。
真倒霉，讓你捲進了這堆爛攤子裡。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, I am not doing well either.
The royal family is focusing on finding out who is pulling the strings.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
嗯，我這邊情況也不太好。
王室正集中精力調查幕後黑手是誰。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
...All they can do is to sort out the puppets infiltrated into the palace.
But it is better than doing nothing.
Now... then.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...他們目前能做的，就是清理混入宮殿的間諜。
但這總比什麼都不做強。
那麼...接下來呢。

scripts.text: Where is Skia?
scripts.translation: 斯基亞在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
She went to hang out with Lord Nyhill!
I don't know what she sees in the pretty boy with no substance.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
她去找尼希爾大人玩了！
我真不知道她看上了那個華而不實的帥哥哪一點。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Could it be...
Could it be that?
Is she enchanted by his looks?
Crux, you answer me!
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
難道說...
難道就是那樣嗎？
她是被他的外表迷住了嗎？
克魯克斯，你回答我！

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Wha... What? Well...
It sounds plausible...
By the way, Lord Nyhill is under probation so he is not supposed to leave his room.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
什...什麼？嗯...
聽起來挺有道理的...
順便說一下，尼希爾大人正處於觀察期，按規定是不允許離開房間的。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, I stand corrected. She went to visit Nyhill in his room.
...Isn't it the same thing?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
好吧，我收回剛才的話。她是去尼希爾的房間探望他了。
...這難道不是一回事嗎？

scripts.text: Crux, cheer up...
scripts.translation: 克魯克斯，振作點...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Oh, are you leaving now?
It sure is wise of you to leave before the lady's head explodes.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
哦，你現在就要走了嗎？
在女士爆發之前離開，真是明智之舉啊。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Don't mind me.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
別在意我。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
We'd better move now since the situation doesn't look good.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
情況不妙，我們最好現在就離開。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are rather slow-footed.
It has been a while since I got the message that you came back.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你的動作真慢。
我收到你回來的訊息已經有一會兒了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I invited you for no special reason.
Since they keep calling for meetings to discuss what has happened during the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我邀請你並沒有特別的原因。
只是他們一直在召集會議，討論儀式期間發生的事情。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
There comes lord of the Heine family.
You seem to move around rather freely considering that you are under confinement.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
海爾內家的領主來了。
考慮到你正處於軟禁之中，你的行動似乎相當自由。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...?
{0}, I have something to tell you.
And about the confinement, it is OK as long as I stay in the western wing of the royal villa...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...？
{0}，我有件事要告訴你。
至於軟禁，只要我待在皇家別墅的西翼，就沒問題...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
By the way, Skia? What are you doing?
.......
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
順便問一下，斯基亞？你在做什麼？
.......

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia?
She is not here now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞？
她現在不在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Oh, this must be it.
The shadow duty.
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
哦，原來如此。
影子職責。
這是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
...How could you tell at a glance?
I am busted.
Am I a bad actress?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
...你怎麼一眼就看出來了？
我被拆穿了。
我的演技很差嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Even if you are twins, you don't look exactly the same.
I just noticed certain differences.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
即使是雙胞胎，你們看起來也不完全一樣。
我只是注意到了一些細微的差別。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Really? I am flattered though.
I am glad that you have been looking at me, not Spica.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
真的嗎？雖然有點受寵若驚。
很高興你一直在看我，而不是斯皮卡。

scripts.text: Why are you in that outfit?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼穿這身衣服？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hum... It is to protect Spica who will be the head of the Nerius family.
Sometimes, I stand forward instead of Spica.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯...這是為了保護將成為內裡烏斯家族首領的斯皮卡。
有時候，我會代替斯皮卡站出來。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
While my sister learned what the head of the family must know from our mother,
I learned to hide and fight.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
當我的姐姐從母親那裡學習家族首領必須知道的知識時，
我學習的是躲藏和戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
That is why people call me the shadow princess.
It is my first time attending an official event in the light.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
這就是為什麼人們稱我為影子公主。
這是我第一次以公開身份參加正式活動。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Anyways, I am filling in for Spica who has left to run some errands now.
I need to show how she is attending the royal banquet with grace.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
總之，斯皮卡現在出去辦事了，我在替她出席。
我需要表現出她優雅地參加皇家宴會的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Thanks to Lady Spica, I get to move around as much as I can now...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
多虧了斯皮卡女士，我現在能自由行動了...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
When will she come back?
The meeting of the representatives has been over...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
她什麼時候回來？
代表們的會議已經結束了...

scripts.text: What brought you here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼會來這裡？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I have come to deliver you the message that there is a mission for you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我來是給你送個訊息，你有任務要執行。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
To be exact, I volunteered since I heard that you were visiting the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
準確地說，是因為聽說您要拜訪內裡烏斯家族，所以我主動請纓的。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
It must be about the incident during the ritual, right?
What does the hero have to do with the royal family's business?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
這一定是關於儀式期間發生的那件事吧？
英雄為什麼要干涉皇室的私事？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Well, you can ask Spica later.
She was there in the meeting, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
嗯，您可以稍後問問斯皮卡。
她當時就在會議上，您知道的。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
This conversation is getting too long.
Please go meet my grandfather and father first.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
這段對話太長了。
請先去見我的祖父和父親吧。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
They must be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
他們一定在等您。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hum... I see. I shall ask Spica to fill me in with the details when she comes back.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯...我明白了。等斯皮卡回來，我會讓她給我講講細節。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Then, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
那麼，我們走吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
{0}, please come to see me again later!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
{0}，請稍後再來找我！

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I have to wait for Spica's return and change clothes.
I cannot leave now.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我得等斯皮卡回來換衣服。
我現在不能走。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
What would happen when I get out like this and encounter Spica on the way?
We will be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
如果我這樣出去，在路上遇到斯皮卡怎麼辦？
那就糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
What are you doing here, you punk?
Get out of here now before I call someone to drag you out!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你這朽魔在這裡幹什麼？
在我叫人把你拖出去之前，趕緊滾！

scripts.text:
[Ian]
How did you get in here.
Only the people with permission are allowed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你是怎麼進來的？
只有獲准的人才能在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Get out of here now before I call someone to drag you out!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
在我叫人把你拖出去之前，趕緊滾！

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Are you the hero invited to the banquet? The Royal Assembly to be exact.
Nice to meet you. I am ^0000cdIan Walther^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你是受邀參加宴會的英雄嗎？確切地說是皇家集會。
幸會。我是^0000cd伊恩·沃爾特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Although ^0000cdthe Walther family doesn't participate in the Royal Assembly^000000, we are attending the banquet as one of the seven royal families.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
雖然^0000cd沃爾特家族不參與皇家集會^000000，但我們作為七大皇室家族之一齣席了宴會。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
This is the ^0000cdheir of the Walther family, Isenhonor^000000. He is my nephew.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
這位是^0000cd沃爾特家族的繼承人，伊森霍納^000000。他是我的侄子。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
He will be the head of the family as he attains adulthood this year. As of now, I am in charge of the family business.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
他今年成年，將成為家族首領。目前，由我負責家族事務。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
How do you do? I am ^0000cdIsenhonor Walther^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
您好。我是^0000cd伊森霍納·沃爾特^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why aren't you participating in the Royal Assembly when there is the heir?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然有繼承人，為什麼你們不參與皇家集會？

scripts.text:
[Ian]
I wonder of you know this, ^0000cdthe candidate from our family was involved in an unfortunate incident^000000 in the ^0000cdprevious Royal Assembly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
不知道你是否知道，^0000cd我們家族的候選人^000000在^0000cd上一屆皇家議會^000000中遭遇了一場不幸的事故。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
^0000cdIsenarm^000000 who was the candidate for the throne acted violently all of a sudden. ^0000cdHe ended up being killed by the heir of the Geoborg family^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
^0000cd伊森阿姆^000000，這位王位候選人突然變得暴力起來。^0000cd最終被格博格家族的繼承人殺害了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
After discussion, our family decided not to take part in the ^0000cdRoyal Assembly^000000 this time.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
經過商議，我們家族決定這次不參與^0000cd皇家集會^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
......

[Ian]
Well then. I hope you enjoy the banquet. The banquet is held for you after all.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
那麼。希望您能盡興。畢竟這場宴會是為您舉辦的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Thank you for sparing me some time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。感謝您抽出時間。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Are you enjoying the banquet?
I hope you enjoy the banquet since it is held for you.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
您覺得宴會如何？
希望您能盡興，畢竟這場宴會是為您舉辦的。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Long time no see, Ian.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
好久不見，伊恩。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Why are you here? I thought we agreed ^0000cdnot to see each other ever again after the previous Royal Assembly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你怎麼在這裡？我記得我們約定過，^0000cd在上次皇家集會之後再也不見面^000000。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
I remember that, but the heir of your family has been busy these days.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
我記得，但你們家族的繼承人最近很忙。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
He has been digging around so much that the story has reached me.
No one seems to pay much attention, but you never know.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
他一直在四處打聽，訊息傳到了我這裡。
雖然似乎沒人太在意，但誰也不知道會發生什麼。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
I told Isenhonor to ^0000cdstop investigating about his brother's death^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
我已經告訴伊森霍納，^0000cd不要再調查他哥哥的死因^000000。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
He should. It would get us both in trouble if the fact that ^0000cdwe were going to kill the imperial candidate of the Geoborg family^000000 leaks out.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
他應該這麼做。如果^0000cd我們要殺害格博格家族皇室候選人^000000的事情洩露出去，我們兩家都會有麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
No one knows about it, you know.
The ^0000cdplan was ruined ^000000as Isenarm was killed while acting violently.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
沒人知道這件事，你知道的。
^0000cd計劃被破壞了^000000，因為伊森阿姆在暴動時被殺了。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
I am sorry about your heir.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
對於你們繼承人的事，我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
I don't care who becomes the heir as long as he leads the family well.
I don't understand why Isenarm who has behaved so well acted that way though...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
我不在乎誰成為繼承人，只要他能好好領導家族就行。
我不明白伊森阿姆一直表現這麼好，為什麼會有那樣的舉動...

scripts.text:
[Ian]
He must have sensed something to act like than when he was about to be elected as the king... There is no way to find out now...
Geoborg has been silent as well ever since, I hear.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
他一定察覺到了什麼，才會在即將當選國王時那樣做...現在已經無法查明瞭...
聽說格博格家族從那以後也一直沉默。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Yes, the word has it.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
是的，訊息就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Since Isenarm was killed by Geoborg, ^0000cdthe Walther family has been excluded from the Royal Assembly^000000 this time.
He was a great boy. It is a shame since he was the perfect candidate for the throne.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
既然伊森阿姆是被格博格家族殺害的，^0000cd沃爾特家族這次就被排除在皇家集會之外^000000。
他是個優秀的男孩。很遺憾，他本是王位的完美候選人。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
The important thing is that as long as we both keep silent, the truth will remain unknown forever.
Then, I guess we will never see each other again.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
重要的是，只要我們倆都保持沉默，真相就永遠無人知曉。
那麼，我想我們以後也不會再見面了。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Make sure to warn your heir not to dig around the incident, no more.
If it gets out, my family can deny it.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
務必警告你的繼承人，不要再調查這起事件了。
如果事情敗露，我的家族可以否認一切。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
However, you Ian will be in trouble as the same member of the family since there is no witness or proof left now.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
不過，伊恩，既然現在沒有任何證人或證據，作為同族的你也會陷入麻煩的。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Are you threatening me?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你在威脅我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Shh... You'd better keep your voice down. Your heir may hear you.
I mean, we should be careful.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
噓...你最好小聲點。你的繼承人可能會聽到。
我是說，我們得小心點。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Well, I cannot be absent for so long anyway. Let me head back now.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
好了，我也不能缺席太久。我先回去了。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Argh... How dare...!
I shouldn't have worked with him in the first place. I lost my poor nephew for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
可惡...竟敢...！
我一開始就不該和他合作。我白白失去了我那可憐的外甥。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor Walther]
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納·沃爾特]
你看起來行李很多。沒事吧？
看起來又多又重。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor Walther]
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納·沃爾特]
要不要減少一些？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
You must be an adventurer. Thank you for visiting this gloomy place.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你一定是位冒險者。謝謝你來到這個陰鬱的地方。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
The representative of our family is over there. I hope you have a good time then.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我們家族的代表在那邊。希望你玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello?

[Isenhonor]
What are you doing here? The Banquet Hall is over there.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你在這裡做什麼？宴會廳在那邊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was sorry that I didn't get the time to talk to you then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，當時沒來得及和你說話。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
What story? You mean the story of my brother being killed for his violent behavior? You seemed to hear it so eagerly. I hope you don't believe that bullshit.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
什麼故事？你是指我哥哥因暴力行為被殺的故事嗎？你聽得很認真的樣子。我希望你別相信那些鬼話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, well...

[Isenhonor]
I cannot believe that my brother has acted violently. Even if he did, there must have been a ^0000cdreason.^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我無法相信我的哥哥會做出暴力的行為。即使他做了，也一定有^0000cd原因^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
My brother, he must have done it for something. No one knows the truth, but people seem to believe the gossip.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我哥哥，他一定是為了某件事才那樣做的。沒人知道真相，但人們似乎都相信那些謠言。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you want to clear the name of your brother, you can investigate on your own.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你想為你哥哥正名，你可以自己去調查。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I am trying. But ^0000cdthe elders of my family don't want me to dig out the dishonorable incident^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我正在嘗試。但^0000cd我家族的長老們不想讓我挖掘那件不光彩的事件^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Also, it is impossible to meet ^0000cdErnst Geoborg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
而且，要見^0000cd恩斯特·格博格^000000是不可能的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wouldn't he meet you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他不會見你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
No. any access to him is blocked.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
不。所有接觸他的途徑都被切斷了。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
The ^0000cdGuardian Knight^000000 and ^0000cdErnst Geoborg^000000 are the only people who know what has happened that day. However it is impossible to meet them. I don't know where to begin...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
只有^0000cd守護騎士^000000和^0000cd恩斯特·格博格^000000知道那天發生了什麼。然而，要見他們是不可能的。我不知道該從哪裡開始...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A Guardian Knight? Did your brother have a Guardian Knight?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
守護騎士？你哥哥有守護騎士嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Yes. Each member of the Walther family has a Guardian Knight. Our family is in overseas trade so that we often travel by ship.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
是的。沃爾瑟家族的每個成員都有守護騎士。我們家從事海外貿易，經常乘船出行。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
As you know, the sailors are not a gentle bunch and we tend to carry money with us so that we are often threatened. We all have to bring Guardian Knights with us.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你也知道，水手們可不是什麼溫和的人，而且我們身上常帶著錢，所以經常受到威脅。因此，我們都必須帶上守護騎士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where is your Guardian Knight then, Isenhonor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，伊森霍納，你的守護騎士在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I am sick of Guardian Knights since my brother's Guardian Knight abandoned my brother and ran away. I don't want to call them Guardian Knights.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
自從哥哥的守護騎士拋棄了他並逃跑後，我就對守護騎士感到厭煩了。我不想再稱他們為守護騎士。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
What should I call a Guardian Knight who betrays the master and runs away?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
背叛主人並逃跑的守護騎士，還能叫什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think it would be a good idea to start from your Guardian Knight. Since they worked together as Guardian Knight, he must know something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得從你的守護騎士開始調查是個好主意。既然他們曾作為守護騎士一起工作，他一定知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Well, when I asked, he told me he knew nothing. If he did, he must have told me before I even asked.
They were pretty close and often exercised together.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
嗯，當我問他的時候，他說他什麼都不知道。如果他知道，肯定在我問之前就會告訴我了。
他們關係很親密，經常一起訓練。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Oh, well, since they were so close, he could have tried to defend his friend.
Why didn't I think of that...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
哦，對了，既然他們關係那麼親密，他可能曾試圖為他的朋友辯護。
我怎麼沒想到這一點...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let me talk to him now. If I hear anything, it would be a good thing. Even if I don't get to hear anything it would still count as a try.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我現在去和他談談。如果我聽到什麼，那是好事。即使聽不到什麼，也算嘗試過了。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Why would you go through such trouble?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你為什麼要費這麼大的勁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I have a hunch. As an adventurer, my instinct says that there must be something going on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我有一種預感。作為冒險者，我的直覺告訴我一定有什麼不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Do all the adventurers count on their hunch like that? This could be dangerous. It is no matter to approach with a hunch.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
所有冒險者都靠預感行事嗎？這很危險。僅憑預感去接近情況是不行的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is why it is called an adventure. Adventurers where the adventures are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這就是為什麼它被稱為冒險。冒險者就是去冒險的。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我不明白。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You may call it a needless meddling out of curiosity. However, I cannot neglect anyone in distress.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可以說這是出於好奇心的多管閒事。但是，我不能對處於困境中的人置之不理。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I appreciate your help though. I am desperate enough to accept your favor. However, I don't think you wouldn't hear much from the Guardian Knight though.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
不過，我很感激你的幫助。我已經絕望到願意接受你的好意了。但是，我不認為你能從守護騎士那裡聽到多少東西。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
If you want to meet him anyway, go to ^0000cdour manor in the south of Alberta^000000. He must be there.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
如果你還是想見他，去^0000cd艾爾貝塔南部的我們莊園^000000。他一定在那裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，就這樣吧。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Adventurer, how did your meeting with the Guardian Knight in Alberta go? Not that I expect too much...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
冒險者，你在艾爾貝塔與守護騎士的會面如何？
雖然我不抱太大希望...

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
However, still, I have hoped to hear good news from you...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
不過，我還是希望能從你那裡聽到好訊息...

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Adventurer, you are back. How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
冒險者，你回來了。情況如何？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I have something for you...
Oh? Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我有東西要給你...
哦？它去哪了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I must have left it back. Let me go bring it for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我一定是把它忘在那邊了。讓我去取來給你。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
You are back. How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你回來了。情況如何？

scripts.text: I told him the story of meeting the Guardian Knight of Isenarm and the conversation with him.
scripts.translation: 我告訴他了與伊森霍納的守護騎士會面以及談話的內容。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is the ^0000cdletter^000000.

[Isenhonor]
Well, this indeed is the seal of our family, and it is my brother's handwriting.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
嗯，這確實是我們家族的印章，而且是我哥哥的筆跡。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
As you said, my brother's Guardian Knight must have not betrayed my brother.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
正如你所說，我哥哥的守護騎士一定沒有背叛他。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
My brother indeed must have done such a thing for a reason.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我哥哥做這種事，一定是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess this is all I can do you now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想，我現在能做的也就這些了。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I understand. I should take on from here. Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我明白了。接下來該由我接手了。謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Please come back anytime when you need the help of the Walther family.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
如果你需要沃爾瑟家族的幫助，請隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
You are a valuable guest for us, the Walther family, from now on, dear adventurer. I'll help you anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
親愛的冒險者，從今以後，你都是我們沃爾瑟家族尊貴的客人。只要你願意，我會隨時幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Based on the piece of information you have brought me, I am collecting other information too. It is not enough year, but I believe that I can unveil the truth someday.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
根據你帶來的線索，我也在收集其他資訊。雖然還不夠，但我相信總有一天能揭開真相。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I called Simon from Alberta. I need to gather all the help I can get now.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我聯絡了艾爾貝塔的西蒙。現在我需要召集所有能得到的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I will see you again when the truth is revealed.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
等真相大白時，我們再見面。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I am looking for the Guardian Knight of Isenhonor. Where can I find him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我在找伊森霍納的守護騎士。我能在哪裡找到他？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I am his Guardian Knight. What's the matter? Has anything happened to him?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我就是他的守護騎士。怎麼了？他出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I shouldn't have stayed behind. Is he all right?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我不該留在這裡。他沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Kidnapping? Injury? Robbery? Fall? What is it? Oh, I should go there now...!
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
綁架？受傷？搶劫？摔倒了？到底怎麼了？噢，我現在就趕過去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. Isenhonor is all right. Nothing happened. I am here to ask you something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷靜點。伊森霍納沒事。什麼都沒發生。我來是想問你點事。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Phew, I guess it wasn't my lord who called me. I am still glad that I is OK.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
呼，看來不是我家主人叫我來。還好他沒事。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
What are you going to ask me? Well, who are you by the way?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你想問什麼？對了，順便問一下，你是誰？

scripts.text: [I told him the conversation with Isenhonor in the palace briefly.]
scripts.translation: [我把在宮中與伊森霍納的對話簡要告訴了他。]

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Oh, sorry about that. I am ^0000cdSimon Walther Marshall^000000.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
噢，抱歉。我是^0000cd西蒙·瓦爾特·馬歇爾^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I don't know the whereabouts of ^0000cdKain Walther Walker^000000 who used to be the Guardian Knight of Isenarm, unfortunately.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
不幸的是，我不知道^0000cd凱恩·瓦爾特·沃克^000000的下落，他曾是伊森霍納的守護騎士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You both have Walther in your names. Is there a special reason for it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們的名字裡都有“瓦爾特”。這是有什麼特殊原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Every knight belongs to the Walther who is assigned to a member of the Walther family is given the name, Walther.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
每一位騎士都隸屬於瓦爾特家族。被指派給瓦爾特家族成員的騎士，都會被賜予“瓦爾特”這個名字。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
The name gives a sense of belonging. Also it gives us the pride to have been recognized as excellent knights.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
這個名字賦予了我們歸屬感。同時也讓我們引以為傲，因為這意味著我們被認可為優秀的騎士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right. By the way, did you say that you know nothing about Kain Walther Walker?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來如此。對了，你剛才說不知道凱恩·瓦爾特·沃克的下落？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
No, I don't.
However...
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
不，我不知道。
不過...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However...?

[Simon]
I heard a ^0000cdstrange gossip^000000 from some of the knights there when I escorted Isenhonor to the palace.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
當我護送伊森霍納去宮殿時，我聽到那裡的一些騎士在傳^0000cd奇怪的流言^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
They heard ^0000cda pickpocket locked in the basement of the palace^000000 babbling about how he had seen a person from the Walther family in a foreign country.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
他們聽說^0000cd一個被鎖在宮殿地下室的小偷^000000在胡言亂語，說他曾在外國見過一位瓦爾特家族的人。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
However, no family member left the country due to the royal banquet. It was strange to hear that. I think that person could be ^0000cdKain^000000.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
然而，由於皇家宴會，沒有家族成員離開過國家。聽到這話很奇怪。我想那個人可能是^0000cd凱恩^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I wanted to investigate myself considering the importance of the matter. But Isenhonor ordered me to go back to Alberta so I had to come back here.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
考慮到事情的重要性，我想親自調查。但伊森霍納命令我回艾爾貝塔，所以我不得不回來了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The pickpocket in the underground prison?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
地下監獄裡的小偷？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Yes. I don't know his real name, but he is called ^0000cdBigfoot^000000 in the underworld.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
是的。我不知道他的真名，但他在地底下被稱為^0000cd大腳怪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Minor offenders like pickpockets are usually locked in this other place. But that guy was caught pickpocketing in Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
像扒手這種小罪犯通常會被關在別的地方。但那個人是在阿魯納菲茲被抓的。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Due to diplomatic issues, we have taken his custody and locked him in the underground prison.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
由於外交問題，我們接管了他的羈押權，並將他關進了地下監獄。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
That guy seems to have a lot of information from all over the continent. Even when his words about seen the person of the Walther family wasn't true, I felt that I could get useful information from him.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
那個人似乎掌握著來自大陸各地的許多情報。即使他聲稱見過瓦爾特家族的人這句話不屬實，我也覺得從他那裡能獲取有用的資訊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whether the information he has is true or not, I would rather go visit him. Thank you for the information.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不管他掌握的情報是否屬實，我還是想去拜訪一下他。謝謝你的情報。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Please say hello to my master when you get back to the palace. Tell him that I will be guarding this place well.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
回到宮殿後，請代我向師父問好。告訴他我會好好守護這裡的。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
And, let him know that he can call me anytime. I would gladly go there to guard him.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
還有，告訴他隨時都可以叫我。我很樂意過去守護他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I'll let him know for sure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我一定轉告他。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Have a safe trip then!
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
那麼，祝你旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Simon]
How did your visit to the prison go?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你去監獄的拜訪怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
You can go see the convict called ^0000cdBigfoot^000000 locked in the ^0000cdUnderground prison of the palace^000000.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你可以去見見被關在^0000cd宮殿地下監獄^000000的犯人^0000cd大腳怪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Didn't you hear anything else from Isenhonor? Please extend my greetings to him when you go to Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你沒有從伊森霍納那裡聽到其他訊息嗎？去普隆德拉時請代我向他問好。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Dear adventurer! At last, Master Isenhonor called me! I am happy that I can guard my lord nearby.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
親愛的冒險者！終於，師父伊森霍納叫我了！我很高興能在他身邊守護他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Glad to hear that. Then what are you doing here now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
聽到這個訊息真好。那你現在在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I am waiting for the ship to Izlude. I will rush to the ship when it comes here.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我在等去依斯魯得島的船。船一到我就趕過去。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I have a lot of questions for you, but I guess I'd better hear the story from my master. Then dear adventurer, have a safe trip!
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我有許多問題想問你，但我想還是聽師父講述比較好。那麼，親愛的冒險者，祝你旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
What if anything happens to my master while I am gone...
Shall I leave for Prontera now?
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
如果我不在的時候師父出了什麼事...
我現在就出發去普隆德拉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
No, he will be mad at me.
He will call me someday. Let's wait here.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
不，他會生我的氣。
總有一天他會叫我的。就在這裡等著吧。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
Just a little more.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
再等一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
What a fine day. However, the house feels to empty and lonely.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
今天天氣真好。不過，這宅邸感覺有些空曠和寂寞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello? Is this the manor of the Walther family?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好？這裡是瓦爾特家族的宅邸嗎？

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Yes, it is. What brought you here. Since everyone has left for Prontera, you cannot meet the master now.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
是的，沒錯。您找誰？
既然大家都去普隆德拉了，您現在見不到主人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isenhonor has sent me here to meet the Guardian Knight.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是伊森霍納派我來的，我要見守護騎士。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Oh, really? He has been waiting for Isenhonor's call so much! I am happy for him.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
哦，真的嗎？
他一直很期待伊森霍納的召喚！真為他高興。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Simon, the Guardian Knight of Isenhonor is near the ^0000cddock^000000 where the ship leaving for ^0000cdIzlude^000000 is anchored.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
伊森霍納的守護騎士西蒙，就在停泊著前往^0000cd依斯魯得島^000000船隻的^0000cd碼頭^000000附近。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
He is waiting there to go to Prontera as soon as possible when Isenhonor calls him.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
他在那裡等著，一旦伊森霍納召喚他，他就立刻動身去普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Go to where the ship to Izlude is anchored.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
去停泊著前往依斯魯得島船隻的碼頭吧。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Mahatra Mornen, the butler of the Alkish family, I cannot take his arrogance anymore.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
阿爾基什家的管家瑪哈特拉·莫倫，
我實在受不了他那副傲慢的樣子了。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
They only own a manor. And they call themselves as the best family in Alberta? What do they think of the Walther family!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
他們不過是有座宅邸罷了，
竟然自稱是艾爾貝塔最尊貴的家族？他們怎麼看待沃爾特家族啊！

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
They cannot even make eye contact when they meet us.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
見到我們時，他們連眼神都不敢接觸。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Our master is just too gentle to leave them alone. How classless.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
我們的主人太溫和了，才會任由他們這樣。
真是毫無教養。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Fried chicken, baked potato, beer, fresh cheese... Ha.... I crave those ordinary dishes now that I am locked in a place like this.
I would marry anyone who brings them to me.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
炸雞、烤土豆、啤酒、新鮮乳酪...哈...
被關在這種地方，我現在特別渴望這些家常菜。
誰要是把這些帶給我，我就娶誰。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Argh! Not again! I am terrified!
But I would be safe as long as I am locked in here.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
啊！又來了！好可怕！
不過只要我被關在這裡，就是安全的。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Fried chicken, baked potato, beer, fresh cheese... Ha.... I crave those ordinary dishes now that I am locked in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
炸雞、烤土豆、啤酒、新鮮乳酪...哈...
被關在這種地方，我現在特別渴望這些家常菜。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I would marry anyone who brings them to me.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
誰要是把這些帶給我，我就娶誰。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Argh! Not again! I am terrified! But I would be safe as long as I am locked in here.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
啊！又來了！好可怕！不過只要我被關在這裡，就是安全的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Bigfoot?

[Bigfoot]
Oh no! I won't eat that! I don't want to have another bite of that pigs feed! I may not be a gourmet, but my tongue hasn't been decomposed or anything!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
不行！我不吃那個！
我才不想再吃一口那種豬食！
我雖然算不上美食家，但我的舌頭還沒爛掉呢！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Bring me something I can eat! I know that I am locked in the prison, but I deserve to eat something edible!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
給我帶點能吃的東西來！
我知道我被關在監獄裡，但我有權吃點像樣的食物！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There must have been a misunderstanding. I am not the warden here. I came here to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡肯定有什麼誤會。我不是這裡的獄卒，我是來找你的。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You are now? I am relieved to hear that. The food here just sucks.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
是嗎？那我就放心了。
這裡的食物真難吃。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Who are you by the way? You look like an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
話說回來，你是誰？
你看起來像個冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Well, it is not important. You are here to ask me something, right? You know nothing in this world is free.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
算了，這不重要。
你來這裡肯定是想問點什麼吧？
要知道，這世上沒有免費的午餐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...What do you want?

[Bigfoot]
Get me out of here.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
把我弄出去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It would be beyond my ability.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這超出了我的能力範圍。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Don't be such a perfectionist. You must be of a high rank to come down here, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
別那麼死板。
你能來這種地方，地位肯定不低吧？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Well, I understand. I knew it was a difficult favor to ask anyway.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
嗯，我理解。
本來就知道這是個很難開的口。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I didn't think you would let me out. I just got it out loud.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我沒指望你真能放我出去。
只是隨口說說而已。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
However, you turned it down so firmly. You could at least pretend to consider or think about it.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
不過你拒絕得也太乾脆了。
至少可以假裝考慮一下嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you really want then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你到底想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Money of course. The price depends on the information you want.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
當然是錢。
價格取決於你想要什麼資訊。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I don't offer a monthly installment plan. I only take cash. I only accept currencies older than 2 years. I'll spend it meaningfully when I get out here in the future.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我不接受分期付款。
只收現金，而且只要流通超過兩年的舊幣。
等我以後出去了，會好好花掉它們的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't have much money, but I know where to spend it. I guess I should turn down the deal. Goodbye then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒多少錢，但我知道該花在哪。
看來這筆交易做不成了。再見。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Hey! Don't take the joke too seriously. Don't your friends call you stubborn?
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
嘿！別太當真了。
你朋友是不是都叫你“固執”？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I knew it. You give up too easily. You are still young, you know.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我就知道。
你放棄得太容易了。
你還年輕，知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please get to the point.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請說重點。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Well, you remind me of something...
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
嗯，你讓我想起一件事...

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Yes! Bring me fried spicy dumplings and green salad! That's right! Bring me that.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
對了！給我帶點炸辣餃和綠色沙拉來！
沒錯！就帶這些來。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I cannot eat the horrible food here much so I keep thinking about the food out there.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
這裡的食物太難吃了，我根本吃不下，
所以總是想著外面的美食。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
What I crave the most is that. Would you do this for me at least? ^0000cdThree fried spicy dumplings and one green salad!^000000
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我最渴望的就是那個。
至少這一點你能幫我吧？
^0000cd三份炸辣餃和一份綠色沙拉！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can do that. Wait for me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以做到。等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You don't have to tell me to wait. I cannot go anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
你不用讓我等。我哪裡也去不了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Wait, you stop there for a moment.
I don't smell the greasy dumplings and fresh salad at all.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
等等，你在那兒停一下。
我完全聞不到炸辣餃和新鮮植物的味道。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Did you bring the food? ^0000cdThree fried spicy dumplings and one green salad!^000000
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
你帶食物來了嗎？^0000cd三份炸辣餃和一份綠色沙拉！^000000

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I won't talk before you bring them to me! Check again and bring them!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
在你把它們帶給我之前，我不會說話！再檢查一下，把它們帶過來！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I smell it! This smell! Take out what you have brought.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我聞到了！這個味道！把你帶來的東西拿出來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you are.

[Bigfoot]
Oh, my love. I'll enjoy every bite of it. Well, ask me the question now.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
哦，我的愛。我會享受每一口。好了，現在問你的問題吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that you saw a person of the Walther family in a foreign country. Where did you see him? How did you know that he was from the Walther family?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽說你在外國看到了沃爾瑟家族的人。你在哪裡看到他的？你怎麼知道他是沃爾瑟家族的人？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Oh, you wanted to know that. As you know, it is rare to see seafarer Walthers in other places of Rune-Midgarts, except Alberta and Prontera.
They are good at hiding their identities other than those who are well known.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
哦，你想知道這個。如你所知，在盧恩·米德加茲的其他地方，除了艾爾貝塔和普隆德拉，很少見到海員沃爾瑟。
除了那些出名的人，他們很擅長隱藏身份。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
However, I saw the distinctive symbol of the family in ^0000cdVeins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
然而，我在^0000cd伯仁斯^000000看到了該家族獨特的標誌。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Veins? Who did you see there? And how?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
伯仁斯？你在那裡看到了誰？怎麼看到的？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I don't know who he is. I was working as always. You know you have to work to make ends meet.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我不知道他是誰。我像往常一樣工作。你知道，為了生計必須工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean pickpocketing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是說偷竊？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You don't have to be so specific about it. Don't you want to hear the story? Well, don't worry. I do have a sense of honor. I'll keep my promise to you who has brought me the dumplings.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
你不必說得那麼具體。你不想聽故事嗎？好吧，別擔心。我有榮譽感。我會遵守向給我帶炸辣餃的你許下的承諾。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Anyways, I found a shabby man who seemed so defenseless in the market there. His wallet was fat. So I took it and went off.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
總之，我在市場裡發現了一個衣衫襤褸的男人，看起來毫無防備。他的錢包很鼓。所以我拿了它就走。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I opened the wallet in a secluded corner of the market. He turned out to be quite loaded. And I found an ^0000cdold letter^000000 in there. The one stamped with the ^0000cdseal^000000, you know.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我在市場的一個偏僻角落打開了錢包。他原來很有錢。我在裡面發現了一封^0000cd舊信^000000。就是蓋有^0000cd海豹寶寶^000000印章的那封，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The fact that he had the letter doesn't prove that he was a person from the Walther family.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他擁有那封信並不能證明他是沃爾瑟家族的人。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Hey, I am getting there. After checking what was in the wallet, I was going to call it a day. I had earned enough.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
嘿，我快說到重點了。檢查完錢包裡的東西后，我打算收工。我已經賺夠了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Then, that shabby man appeared.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
然後，那個衣衫襤褸的男人出現了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I don't have to tell you the rest of the story, right? Whoa... I thought I was fighting three men at the same time. His fist was like...! Phew... When he was punching me, I saw it.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
剩下的故事不用我多說了吧？天哪...我以為我在同時和三個人打架。他的拳頭簡直像...！呼...他打我的時候，我看到了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
There was a hidden ^0000cdsword^000000 under his cloak. The ^0000cdhandle was engraved with the symbol^000000. You see, well. Do you believe my story now?
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
他的斗篷下藏著一把^0000cd劍^000000。^0000cd劍柄上刻著那個符號^000000。你看，嗯。現在你相信我的故事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did you manage to see that when you were beaten up so bad?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你被打得那麼慘，是怎麼看清的？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Oh, have some faith. Don't you know what I do for living?
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
噢，要有信心。你不知道我是靠什麼謀生的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean pickpocketing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是說偷竊？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Hey, don't be so specific, please!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
嘿，請不要說得那麼具體！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Anyways, my profession required a sharp eye to catch whatever is significant at a glance. That's how I thrive in this field.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
總之，我的職業需要敏銳的眼睛，一眼就能抓住重點。這就是我在這個領域生存的方式。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
When I see a person, I need to identify the position of the wallet, any weapon in possession, the target's wits and how fast the target can run in a moment. This job required such a special quality.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
看到一個人時，我需要在瞬間判斷錢包的位置、是否持有武器、對方的智商以及逃跑速度。這份工作需要這種特殊的能力。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You don't have to believe me, but you can trust my professional skill.
Well, you must have hidden your money inside the belt and your shoes. Nice work. Those are tough spots to steal from.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
你不必相信我，但你可以信任我的專業技能。
嗯，你肯定把錢藏在腰帶和長靴裡了。幹得漂亮。那些地方很難偷竊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, I guess I can trust your skill.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我想我可以相信你的技術。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyways, it sure seems suspicious. Thank you for your information.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，這確實很可疑。謝謝你的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Don't you need anything else? I want to have some dessert now.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
你不需要別的了嗎？我現在想吃點甜點。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. This is enough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不。這就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Oh, no! Dessert! My dessert!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
哦，不！甜點！我的甜點！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
What is it? Did you change your mind?
Do you want more information? I'd really like to have some Mastela Fruit Wine.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
怎麼了？你改變主意了？
你想了解更多資訊嗎？我真的很想要一些瑪絲黛拉果酒。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Did you forget where to go?
You should go to ^0000cdVeins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
你忘了要去哪了嗎？
你應該去^0000cd伯仁斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Bring me some dessert when you come back!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
回來時給我帶點甜點！

scripts.text:
[K]
You seem to carry a heavy burden.
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你看起來揹負著沉重的負擔。
要不要減輕一些？

scripts.text:
[K]
I want to go back...
There again...
scripts.translation:
[K]
我想回去...
但是...

scripts.text:
[K]
Who are you? Why are you staring at me? Are you after my wallet too?
It hasn't been long since I sent a person who stole my wallet to the prison.
scripts.translation:
[K]
你是誰？為什麼盯著我看？你也是來搶我錢包的嗎？
我剛把一個偷我錢包的人送進了監獄。

scripts.text:
[K]
I guess no such information is shared among the pickpockets. Get lost if you don't want to be sent to prison.
scripts.translation:
[K]
我想，這種資訊在小偷之間是不共享的。如果你不想被送進監獄，就滾開。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are quite quick-tempered, aren't you.
^0000cdKain Walther Walker^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你脾氣真暴躁啊。
^0000cd凱因·瓦爾特·沃克^000000。

scripts.text:
[K]
I don't know such name.
scripts.translation:
[K]
我不認識這個名字。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The one who betrayed his master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
背叛師父的人。

scripts.text:
[K]
Who... Who are you? Reveal yourself!
Why are you telling me such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你...你是誰？報上名來！
你為什麼要告訴我這些？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
People say that. I don't buy it though.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人們都這麼說。但我並不相信。

scripts.text:
[K]
Why don't you believe it? Why? Do you know anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你為什麼不相信？為什麼？你知道些什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are the one who knows the truth, Kain Walther Walker.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
知道真相的人是你，凱因·瓦爾特·沃克。

scripts.text:
[K]
Tell me. Who are you? Do you know anything about the death of Isenarm?
scripts.translation:
[K]
告訴我。你是誰？你知道伊森亞姆死因的真相嗎？

scripts.text:
[K]
Your life depends on your answer. I have enough reason to kill you since you know who I am.
scripts.translation:
[K]
你的性命取決於你的回答。既然你知道我是誰，我殺你理由充分。

scripts.text:
[K]
Well, tell me.
Who are you? How did you find me? And what do you know about the death of Isenarm?
scripts.translation:
[K]
好吧，告訴我。
你是誰？你怎麼找到我的？還有，你知道伊森亞姆死因的什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am asked to investigate the death of Isenarm by Isenhonor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是受伊森霍納之託，調查伊森亞姆的死因。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While carrying out the investigation, I got the information that you would be here. I came here to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在調查過程中，我得知你會在這裡。所以我來這裡見你。

scripts.text:
[K]
Isenhonor? At last, he is in action!
scripts.translation:
[K]
伊森霍納？終於，他行動起來了！

scripts.text:
[K]
Oh, please excuse my bad manners. I am sorry. Please forgive my earlier behavior.
scripts.translation:
[K]
啊，請原諒我的無禮。我很抱歉。請原諒我剛才的態度。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's OK. It wouldn't hurt to be careful, Kain Walther Walker.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係。小心一點也好，凱因·瓦爾特·沃克。

scripts.text:
[K]
I cannot use the name, Walther, anymore.
When a star disappears, its satellite shall lost its name too. Even worse, I am a sinner who haven't been able to my star.
scripts.translation:
[K]
我不能再用“瓦爾特”這個名字了。
當星星消失時，它的衛星也會失去名字。更糟糕的是，我是一個連星星都無法觸及的罪人。

scripts.text:
[K]
Is Isenhonor investigating the death of Isenarm? I will do my best to help him by his side.
scripts.translation:
[K]
伊森霍納在調查伊森亞姆的死因？我會盡我所能在他身邊協助他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not yet. Isenhonor wants to know the truth behind his brother's death, but he is not in the position to carry out the investigation due to the circumstances.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還沒有。伊森霍納想知道他弟弟死因的真相，但由於情況特殊，他無法親自進行調查。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's why I, who is relatively free to move around, am is doing the research for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以我，這個行動相對自由的人，正在替他進行調查。

scripts.text:
[K]
Is that so... Then what can I do to help you? I'll do whatever I can do to reveal the truth.
scripts.translation:
[K]
原來如此...那我能為你們做什麼？我會盡我所能揭露真相。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can tell me what happened when you were with Isenarm. Why you disappeared before Isenarm's death, why you are here and all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可以告訴我當時和伊森亞姆在一起時發生了什麼。為什麼你在伊森亞姆死前失蹤了，為什麼你會在這裡，等等。

scripts.text:
[K]
In fact I know nothing about his death myself. However, he ^0000cdsent me here with a mission^000000 before incident broke out.
scripts.translation:
[K]
事實上，關於他的死，我自己也一無所知。不過，在事件爆發之前，他^0000cd曾派我執行一項任務^000000。

scripts.text:
[K]
When I was going to go back after completing the mission, he sent me a lot of money and a ^0000cdletter^000000. It said ^0000cdnot to return to Rune-Midgarts^000000.
scripts.translation:
[K]
當我完成任務準備返回時，他寄來了很多錢和一封^0000cd信件^000000。信中寫道^0000cd不要返回盧恩·米德加茲^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And then?

[K]
I heard the news of his death after few days. I wanted to go back, but I couldn't because of his last order. I couldn't even be there by his side...
scripts.translation:
[K]
幾天後，我聽到了他去世的訊息。我想回去，但因為他的最後命令，我無法回去。我甚至沒能陪在他身邊...

scripts.text:
[K]
After a long time, I heard the rumor about the violent behavior which caused Isenarm to be killed.
scripts.translation:
[K]
過了很久，我聽到了關於伊森亞姆因暴力行為而被殺的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[K]
And also the story of the Guardian Knight who betrayed his master...
scripts.translation:
[K]
還有那個背叛了師父的守護騎士的故事...

scripts.text:
[K]
When I became a wanted man, I wanted to back and tell the truth. However, the letter said ^0000cdnot to return no matter what^000000. I couldn't let down the last order given by my master.
scripts.translation:
[K]
當我成為通緝犯時，我曾想回去說出真相。但那封信上寫著^0000cd無論如何都不要回來^000000。我不能違背師父下達的最後命令。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess Isenarm didn't want you to be involved. If anything happened to him, you would have been the one in the biggest trouble.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想伊森亞姆是不想讓你捲入其中。如果出了什麼事，你會陷入最大的麻煩。

scripts.text:
[K]
Ha... Perhaps... I didn't think of that... Here are the ^0000cdletter and sword Isenarm^000000 has give me.
scripts.translation:
[K]
哈...也許...我沒想過這一點...這是^0000cd伊森亞姆^000000給我的信件和劍。

scripts.text:
[K]
Please give them to Isenhonor. I hope they help him recover his brother's honor.
scripts.translation:
[K]
請把它們交給伊森霍納。我希望這能幫他恢復他兄弟的名譽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Keep the sword. The sword is like the life of the knight. I believe Isenarm would want you to have it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
留著劍吧。劍就像騎士的生命。我相信伊森亞姆會希望你擁有它。

scripts.text:
[K]
Then, have a safe travel.
scripts.translation:
[K]
那麼，祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[K]
Did you deliver the letter and the words to Isenhonor well?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你順利地把信件和話轉達給伊森霍納了嗎？

scripts.text:
[K]
Please let him know that I am ready to devote my life if he needs my help.
scripts.translation:
[K]
請告訴他，如果他的需要，我隨時準備獻出生命。

scripts.text:
He is lying in bed, deeply wounded.
It doesn't seem that he is in the state to talk.
scripts.translation:
他躺在床上，傷勢嚴重。
看起來他現在的狀態不適合交談。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
How disrespectful of you to enter without permission.
Get out of here now.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
未經允許就闖入，真是無禮。
現在立刻離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Please, calm down.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
請冷靜一下。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Why don't you enjoy the banquet?
Nyhill went to the Banquet Hall too.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你不去享受宴會嗎？
尼希爾也去了宴會廳。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
He didn't make a good first impression, but he is not a bad kid...
He is just...
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
他給人的第一印象不太好，但他並不是個壞孩子...
他只是...

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Well, I guess I shouldn't talk more.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我想，我不該再多說了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You are here at last.
The archduke has been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你終於來了。
大公一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Nillem said he would visit your room after making all preparations. You may wait in your room.
We are counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
尼勒姆說，等一切準備就緒後，他會去你的房間。你可以在房間裡稍作休息。
我們對你寄予厚望。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I have heard the story from my father.
I have received the approval for you to access the Past Memories of the Royal Family freely.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我從父親那裡聽說了這件事。
我已批准你自由查閱王室的過去記憶。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Let's talk about the Past Memories of the Royal Family tomorrow
Since you must be tired going through all the trouble today.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
關於王室的過去記憶，我們明天再談吧。
畢竟你今天已經費了不少心力，一定很累了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Are you going back to that place?
Nillem has told me.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你又要去那個地方了嗎？
尼勒姆跟我提過了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
That it is difficult for him to connect multiple times since he is just a human after all.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
畢竟他只是個普通人，很難多次進行連線。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I appreciate your efforts for the royal family.
But don't push yourself too hard.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我很感激你為王室所做的努力。
但請不要太勉強自己。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You are here, just in time.
Are you going there again today?
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你來得正好。
今天又要去那裡嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I see.
...Oh, do you know what Nyhill is doing?
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我明白了。
...哦，你知道尼希爾在做什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
.....Never mind.
He must be staying quietly since he has been sentenced to disciplinary confinement.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
......算了。
既然他被判處禁閉，應該正在安靜地待著吧。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
那麼，再見。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Sorry about all the trouble.
I hope it works this time.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
抱歉給你添麻煩了。
希望這次能順利。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Please save the piece of Ymir Heart from Valkyrie.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
請從瓦爾基里手中奪回尤彌爾之心碎片。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
...I know it is almost impossible to change the past.
But there is no other way.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
...我知道改變過去幾乎是不可能的。
但除此之外別無他法。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
We need to try everything we can do.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我們必須嘗試一切可能的方法。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
While you are on a mission down there, we are proceeding with the investigation.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
當你在下面執行任務時，我們將繼續進行調查。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
We are searching for the lead to the intruders.
Let's play our parts well.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我們正在尋找入侵者的線索。
讓我們各司其職吧。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Nillem must be waiting for you.
Please do your best as always.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
尼勒姆一定在等你。
請像往常一樣盡力而為。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You are back.
Is it the same this time?
I suppose so.
But, I really don't think all the efforts will go wasted.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你回來了。
這次也是一樣的結果嗎？
我想是的。
但我真的不認為所有的努力都會白費。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Thank you very much.
Someday, when you need the power of our family,
We will be on your side no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
非常感謝。
總有一天，當你需要海爾內家族的力量時，
無論發生什麼，我們都會站在你這邊。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
That is all we can give you for now as the reward.
I am sorry that we cannot offer you more.
I'll make sure there is no inconvenience to you while living in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
目前我們只能給你這些作為獎勵。
很抱歉我們無法提供更多。
我會確保你在宮殿裡生活時不會受到任何不便。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
See you tomorrow then.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
那麼明天見。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
You must be the returned hero invited to the banquet.
This banquet is for you. Please enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
您一定是受邀參加宴會的歸來之英雄。
這場宴會就是為您準備的。請盡情享用。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Haha... The archduke must be very angry.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
哈哈...大公大人一定很生氣吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I have participated in the Royal Assembly, but I wonder if it has been the right decision.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我參加了皇家議會，但我不確定這是否是正確的決定。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I tried to do this for everyone, but it seems to cause trouble.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我本想為大家做點什麼，但看來反而惹了麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
