Now I am home and it seems that Helmut, Wolf, and Agnes have been all good.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
現在回到家，看來赫爾穆特、狼和阿格妮絲都過得很好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
I think it is great, though a little disappointing.
It is stupid to think like this, as I left home.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
我覺得這很好，雖然有點失望。
我離開了家，這樣想有點傻。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
停下！你們兩個都停下。聽你們說話，我頭都暈了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我有個問題。你們有什麼有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我有一個。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我接受這個請求。你的問題是什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說戰爭故事、王室八卦之類的。
我想關於皇家議會或宴會有很多故事。我現在在首都，為了瞭解這裡的氣氛，我覺得應該聽聽那些故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那個故事！我們都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
讓我來講！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我也知道這個故事。但我不確定是否應該把它講給你聽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼？如果你想要報酬，我可以給你。糖果？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你給糖果作為報酬？太傻了。我們不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你最好別提報酬。我母親告訴我不要接受陌生人的東西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我們現在正在交談。那你想要什麼？代替糖果。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
報酬對我來說不重要。重要的是你是否有資格聽這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
資格？你在說什麼？他有時候說話很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我要報酬。如果你給我足夠的報酬，我什麼都可以告訴你。所以先拿出你的誠意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒想騙你們。但你們倒是直截了當地說出想要什麼。一開始我看你們是小孩子才輕視你們。
好吧，我會給報酬。至於資格？聽個八卦還需要資格嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這取決於你想聽什麼樣的八卦。價值越高，風險就越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
這八卦有這麼危險嗎？我剛才聽的時候完全沒感覺到。金，你難道知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
那是艾倫。你只能相信他30%。如果他總是對的，世界早就毀滅幾十次了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼辦？告訴我。你們到底想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於到了談生意的時候！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我喜歡漂亮的東西！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！僅此而已！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道你們在說什麼。請慢慢說，詳細一點？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單。證明你的實力。我想你應該知道^0000cd狂暴米諾斯^000000吧。
那是肌肉發達的惡魔。抓住它來證明你很強大。它的力量數值是^0000cd33^000000！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了。這樣就夠了嗎？我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下。你不聽我們說話嗎？你說過要給報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你不能只聽艾倫的然後就走。我們是一個團隊！看到我們三個一起玩耍，難道你不知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難道我也得照你們說的做...？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我不會丟下我的朋友。照他們說的做。如果不做，你就會失去資格。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我明白了。那你們想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我想要漂亮的絲綢布料！我聽說宮殿裡會舉辦宴會，公主們穿著漂亮的裙子。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我也想要漂亮的衣服！我想要^0000cd漂亮的絲綢布料^000000！我會讓我母親給我做的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，好吧，你們想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
考慮到我的身高，大概需要^0000cd十二^000000塊？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很簡單。那麼，小傢伙，你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本包含盧恩·米德加茲全部歷史的書。它在皇家圖書館裡，我從未見過。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身邊沒有人能進入宮殿，書店也不賣這本書。請幫我弄來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是想讓我偷它嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你瘋了嗎？你以為我是什麼人？幫我借來就好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。^0000cd狩獵33只大玫瑰，獲取12塊柔軟的絲綢布料，並從皇家圖書館借出盧恩·米德加茲的歷史書^000000。我很快就回來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我會等著你的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回來了。這些是你們想要的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
讓我看看。是的！就是這些。真漂亮。好柔軟！我真的可以擁有這些嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然，我既然帶來了，就是因為你想要。那麼，你之前說的話只是空話嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
不！不！我是真的想要！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還有你的書。它真的很重也很大。我只借到了一卷。其他卷已經被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你。我終於可以讀了。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你身上有濃重的血腥味。是的，你獵殺了大玫瑰。你是一名強大的戰士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我獵殺了它們全部。現在，讓我聽聽那個昂貴的故事。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭，王室。赫爾穆特·羅根堡。如果他成為國王，整個大陸將被捲入戰爭的漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
黑暗將席捲大陸，痛苦的呻吟將籠罩整個大陸！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是正在流傳的謠言嗎？但我不知道這意味著什麼。有人能給我解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很簡單。如果赫爾穆特·羅根堡成為國王，戰爭就會爆發。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...這太簡單了。請解釋得更詳細一些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
哎呀！你們兩個到底在說什麼？讓我來解釋一下。那個謠言是這樣的：

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
如果赫爾穆特·羅根堡成為國王...，啊對了，你們聽說過關於羅根堡的謠言嗎？特別是關於^0000cd四個孩子死亡^000000的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我不知道。以前從未聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
這也只是謠言。但我確信這是真的。總之，我聽說他們是被謀殺的，

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
當時他們正在訪問外國。赫爾穆特·羅根堡深受打擊，從那以後他一直在戰場上游蕩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，他確實在戰場上游蕩。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我想這是因為王室會議。這就是現在流傳的謠言。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
^0000cd據說^000000如果赫爾穆特成為國王，他將入侵殺害他父母的那個國家，並發動戰爭以統一大陸。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
而羅根堡的二兒子正在做生意，為戰爭籌集資金。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得這麼詳細？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
大家都知道。這裡到處都是關於這件事的議論。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我的父母很擔心。他們害怕赫爾穆特成為國王並發動戰爭。
事實上，每個人都很焦慮。他們不喜歡戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他以外。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我也討厭戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們的講述。這正是我需要的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
如果你還有問題，隨時來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你的書！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
男人不會把任何人趕出去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子們，你們好？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又來了。還需要什麼嗎？不過你能來真好。我得把書還回去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有關於羅根堡傳聞的問題。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
關於那個家族沒有新的故事。沒有故事，就意味著死亡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我來這裡不是為了聽新的傳聞。我在找那個給你們講故事的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是誰在傳播這個謠言。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
為什麼？你要去抓那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，他的祖父讓我給他帶個口信。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
他們明明是一家人，為什麼不能見面呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，情況不完全是那樣... 嗯... 是的，差不多就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
這真的很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，確實如此。但有時候，即使是家人之間，見面也很困難，不得不請人代為傳話。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這次，你需要更可靠的憑證...

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
啊，他來了！喬納森！我們有客人。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
親愛的冒險者，是什麼風把你吹到這裡來了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
找到謠言最初傳播者的方法，就是找到謠言的源頭。但我沒想到你會在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你是來看我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。你的家人讓我給你帶個口信。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
誰是邁爾？^0000cd你的名字叫邁爾^000000嗎？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你明明讓我只叫你喬納森的。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。他們很可愛，但相處起來挺讓人頭疼的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你是喬納森·邁爾？還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我一聲！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們。我要和他談一件非常重要的事。你們是把耳朵閉上，還是讓我們單獨待一會兒？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是閉不上的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我想聽。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
快過來！他們要談重要的事了。大家，把耳朵閉上。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
真是乖孩子。談完之後我會給你們甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我的耳朵已經閉上了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊。那就談吧。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
啦啦啦啦啦 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們既可愛又聰明。我很好奇他們將來會長成什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
是的。所以我在這裡，就是為了觀察、教導並引導他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯。這只是我能做的而已。對了，口信是什麼？

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告訴邁爾，赫爾穆特已移交繼承權，他的兩個兄弟也放棄了爭鬥。]

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
那太好了。他們是我的兄弟，我為他們感到驕傲。最幸運的是^0000cd狼改變了主意^000000。和他爭論真的很煩人。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
狼必須看到一切塵埃落定才算完。不過從某種角度來說，這也挺好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你可能不信，他是我最喜歡的家人。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
啊，總之，很抱歉讓你看到了我們家裡不愉快的一面。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之間爭鬥是很常見的事。我也...

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，我覺得我得去一趟家裡。雖然家裡一直讓人心煩，但我覺得這次去會很有趣。請告訴我的家人，在我工作期間，我會在這裡幫助他們。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
還有，告訴他們宴會結束後我會去拜訪他們。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
另外，請告訴阿格妮絲，很抱歉我不能陪她去參加宴會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我會的。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
如果你需要幫助，隨時來找我。我會竭盡全力幫助你。保重！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Do you want business with us? But we don't meet with anybody.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你想和我們做生意？但我們不見任何人。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
We are not easy people anybody can speak to.
Go back.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我們不是誰都可以對話的人。
回去。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Today, the wind is cold and smells rotten. I feel that something has happened.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
今天的風很冷，帶著腐朽的味道。我感覺發生了什麼事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah, sorry, I couldn't clean myself for a few days.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，抱歉，我好幾天沒洗澡了。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is it so? I feel that they are testing me.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
是嗎？我覺得他們在試探我。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
He has come with empty hands.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
他空手而來。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Anyone without credentials cannot hear good stories. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
沒有憑證的人聽不到好訊息。回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
How can you say that! You must have forgotten what you should bring.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你怎麼能這麼說！你一定忘了該帶什麼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先，^0000cd12塊軟布^000000，^0000cd盧恩·米德加茲的歷史書^000000

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
還有嗯...^0000cd殺死33只大玫瑰^000000給艾倫。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
其中有些奇怪的東西，但有什麼關係...他想要。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Do you hear more? If so, you need to prove you have stronger credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你聽到了更多？如果是這樣，你需要證明你有更強的憑證。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This is a ritual that calls blood! A ritual of destruction and darkness!!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是一個召喚鮮血的儀式！一個毀滅與黑暗的儀式！！！！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又開始了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Please go. We'll handle him.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
請離開。我們會處理他的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The threat of war has disappeared. Hero in the time of turbulence is not born. Darkness calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭的威脅已經消失了。在動盪的時代，英雄是不會誕生的。黑暗在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又開始了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Please go. We'll handle him.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
請離開。我們會處理他的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It is a good weather today.
The banquet is in full swing in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[金]
今天天氣真好。
宮殿裡的宴會正進行得如火如荼。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are happy as their business prospers when palace purchases lots of goods in large volumes. I will tell them to buy me a book tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[金]
因為宮殿大量採購物資，父母的生意興隆，他們很高興。我打算明天讓他們給我買本書。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
End of today's diary.
scripts.translation:
[金]
今日日記結束。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It is a good weather today.
The banquet is in full swing in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[金]
今天天氣真好。
宮殿裡的宴會正進行得如火如荼。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
They will be all destroyed when a bloody day comes.
Why are we recording those vain things?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
當血腥之日來臨，這一切都將被毀滅。
我們為什麼要記錄這些虛無的東西？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Because records remains forever.
If you record today, someone in the future will read them and remember us.
scripts.translation:
[金]
因為記錄會永遠留存。
如果你記錄下今天，未來的人讀到它，就會記得我們。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Human comes from nothing and goes to nothing.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
人類生於虛無，歸於虛無。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？為什麼兩手空空？我看不到你拿了我們讓你拿的東西。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你是因為我們是孩子就看不起我們嗎？我真的很討厭這種人。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
嘿！你不是那種人吧？你看起來不像是那樣的人。你是忘了該拿什麼了吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先，^0000cd12塊軟布^000000，^0000cd盧恩·米德加茲的歷史書^000000

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
還有嗯...^0000cd殺死33只大玫瑰^000000給艾倫。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
其中有些奇怪的東西，但有什麼關係...他想要。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I am enjoying reading the book you gave, though it is too large and heavy.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我正在讀你給我的書，雖然它又大又重。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My dream is to become a historian. I would like travel around Midgards and discover old hidden stories.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我的夢想是成為歷史學家。我想走遍米德加爾特，發掘那些被遺忘的古老故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Jonathan returned the book you borrowed and he borrowed me other two volumes.
scripts.translation:
[金]
喬納森還了你借的書，並向我借了另外兩卷。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Jonathan is great! I will become a man like Jonathan in the future.
scripts.translation:
[金]
喬納森真棒！將來我要成為像喬納森那樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
How beautiful and shining the dresses of princesses would be! I wish I could wear as many pretty dresses as possible.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
公主們的禮服一定很美很閃亮吧！我希望我能穿上儘可能多的漂亮裙子。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hello, singing birds and pretty flowers.
Are you having a beautiful day today too?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你好啊，唱歌的小鳥和漂亮的花朵。
你們今天也過得愉快嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
Why don't I have normal person around me?
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又開始了。
為什麼我身邊沒有正常人呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Are you talking to me?
If so, you are successful. I heard it very clearly.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你在跟我說話嗎？
如果是的話，你成功了。我聽得很清楚。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我拒絕平庸。
我太過偉大，不能被它束縛。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？為什麼兩手空空？我看不到你拿了我們讓你拿的東西。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你是因為我們是孩子就看不起我們嗎？我真的很討厭這種人。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
嘿！你不是那種人吧？你看起來不像是那樣的人。你是忘了該拿什麼了吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先，^0000cd12塊軟布^000000，^0000cd盧恩·米德加茲的歷史書^000000

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
還有嗯...^0000cd殺死33只大玫瑰^000000給艾倫。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
其中有些奇怪的東西，但有什麼關係...他想要。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Please ask my mother to use this cloth to make clothes
My mother makes pretty clothes!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
請拜託我的母親用這塊布做衣服。
我母親做的衣服很漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Now I guess that she is in the palace to repair the dresses of princesses.
Ah, I wish that she was here!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我想她現在應該在宮殿裡修補公主們的禮服吧。
啊，真希望她在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Jonathan said that the threat of war is gone. What a relief that would be.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
喬納森說戰爭的威脅已經解除了。真是讓人鬆了一口氣。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Dear adventurer? What are you doing here? It is dangerous. The monster came down here just before. Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
親愛的冒險者？你在這裡做什麼？這裡很危險。剛才有魔物下來了。請立刻離開。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm OK. I'm accustomed to everyday life of being attacked by monsters.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒事。我已經習慣了每天被魔物攻擊的生活。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I forgot you are a great warrior. Please forgive my rudeness.
By the way what has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我忘了你是一位偉大的戰士。請原諒我的無禮。
順便問一下，是什麼把你帶到這裡的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came here to bring Lord Helmut. Your grandfather is very worried about you. He said you are away from home in an important time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我來這裡是為了帶赫爾穆特大人回去。您的祖父非常擔心您。他說在這個關鍵時刻，您卻離家在外。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I don't go back. ^0000cdI belong here, the front^000000. Please tell my grandfather so.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我不回去。^0000cd我屬於這裡，前線^000000。請這樣告訴我的祖父。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But everybody is worried about you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是大家都為您擔心。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I cannot go back. As a matter of fact, I resent the people who left my parents die since I became mature.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我無法回去。事實上，自從我成熟以來，我就怨恨那些任由我父母死去的人。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
And I thought that it is the right way to develop the power that makes people to have no choice but to follow.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我認為，發展出讓人別無選擇只能追隨的力量，是正確的道路。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
So, my goal was to unify the continent and make my power reached at every corner of the continent. So I trained and trained myself.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
所以，我的目標是統一大陸，讓我的力量觸及大陸的每一個角落。為此我不斷訓練自己。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
However, when I listened to Myer and Agnes, I realized that the way I pursue could cause sadness and misfortune to someone.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
然而，當我聽到邁爾和阿格妮絲的話後，我意識到我追求的道路會給某人帶來悲傷和不幸。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
So I decided to ^0000cdgive up the unification war ^000000that pushes people into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
所以我決定^0000cd放棄那場將人們捲入戰爭漩渦的統一戰爭^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
This is where I should stay. Here I can ^0000cdprotect more people safely^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
這裡才是我該待的地方。在這裡，我可以^0000cd更安全地保護更多人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Considering the position of our family, I will cooperate in what is needed for the Royal Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
考慮到我們家族的地位，我會配合王室議會所需的一切。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
But I hope that Wolf will lead everything. When the Royal Assembly is closed, please tell Wolf that I will ^0000cdtransfer the position of heir to him^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
但我希望由狼來領導一切。當王室議會結束後，請告訴狼，我將^0000cd把繼承人的位置移交給狼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Wolf will need lots of power. I will stay here to protect our people.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
狼需要大量的力量。我會留在這裡保護我們的人民。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
如果你這樣做，狼就不會堅持戰爭，邁爾也不會再那樣犧牲自己了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...I see. I will tell you message to your grandfather.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我明白了。我會把您的話轉告給您的祖父。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Yes. thank you. Please take care.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
是的，謝謝。請多保重。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
This is where I should stay.
Please tell him '^0000cdI give up wars and transfer my position of heir to Wolf^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
這裡才是我該待的地方。
請告訴他，'^0000cd我放棄戰爭，並將繼承人的位置移交給狼^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
如果你這樣做，狼就不會堅持戰爭，邁爾也不會再那樣犧牲自己了。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
那麼，再見。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I can feel the earth is shaking.
An attack is expected soon. I have to make preparation.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我能感覺到大地在震動。
預計很快會有攻擊，我必須做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Give shout of concentration!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
大聲喊出專注的口號！！！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Louder!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
再大聲點！！！！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
We!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我們！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I am very happy that I came back here.
Now I've got something to do.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
我很高興能回到這裡。
現在我有事要做了。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
And I think it is great that Lord Helmut has given up the unification war.
I knew nothing about unification, but I wished that no war would break out.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
而且我覺得赫爾穆特大人放棄統一戰爭是件好事。
我對統一一無所知，但我希望不要爆發戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Here, I would like to help Lord Helmut to protect people's safe and peaceful days.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
在這裡，我想幫助赫爾穆特大人保護人們的安全與和平。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Now it is the time that Lord Helmut begins to feel thirsty.
I think I should prepare something to drink.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
現在赫爾穆特大人開始感到口渴了。
我想我應該準備點喝的。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Thank you for coming here to deliver the message. Without you, I would not have listened to anything like the one I heard today.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
謝謝你來這裡傳達訊息。如果沒有你，我可能不會聽今天聽到的這些話。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Fight, fight, and fight.... I don't want that either.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
打，打，再打...我也不想要那樣。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
They are my family who are closer to me than anyone.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
他們是我的家人，比任何人都更親近我。

scripts.text:
[Ordinary Man]
Shh! You'd better not speak to me.
There are may eyes around.
scripts.translation:
[普通男子]
噓！你最好不要跟我說話。
周圍有很多眼睛盯著。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Butler]
It is a fast way to get stronger to take a good rest after a hard battle.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
在激烈的戰鬥後好好休息，是變強的快速途徑。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The Richard family runs various ways of training. Taking a rest is one of the most important training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族採用各種訓練方式。休息是最重要的訓練之一。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The former heads of the Richard family have also taken enough rest after training. Well, it's too common to mention, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族的前任家主們也在訓練後充分休息。嗯，這太常見了，我就不多說了。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Everyone may know how one feels itching for more action after training. However, that is the time to take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
每個人可能都知道訓練後想繼續行動的感覺。然而，那正是該休息的時候。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The next training would be just as tough. You'd better take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
接下來的訓練同樣會很艱苦。您最好現在先休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I feel that you must be raring to get some action. I guess it is the time to proceed with the next training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我感覺您似乎躍躍欲試。看來是時候進行下一階段的訓練了。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
How do you do? I have been waiting for you after being informed by the Chamberlain.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您好。侍從長告知我您會來，我一直在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This it the room of the Richard family which has been controlling the military power of the kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這裡是理查德家族的房間。這個家族一直掌控著王國的軍事力量。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I have heard your name for that {0}, you are the hero in the subjugation of Morocc
scripts.translation:
[管家]
久仰大名，{0}。您是平定莫洛克的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Oh! I am sorry to take too much of your time. Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
啊！抱歉佔用了您太多時間。房間裡，家族繼承人波正在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Let me escort you inside.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
請允許我為您引路。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This it the room of the Richard family.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這裡是理查德家族的房間。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Po, the next head of the family, is taking a rest. Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
家族繼承人波正在休息。請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
房間裡，家族繼承人波正在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Have you met the next head of the family?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您見過家族繼承人了？

scripts.text:
[Butler]
If the next head of the family meets you {0}, please...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
如果家族繼承人見到您，{0}，請...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Oh! I am sorry about my bad manners. It is nothing. Please never mind...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
啊！抱歉我的失禮。沒什麼，請別介意...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我從家族繼承人波那裡聽說，您打算嘗試理查德戰鬥訓練計劃。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
For now, the training would be too overwhelming for you. You'd better learn the basics before proceeding with the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
目前，這種訓練對您來說可能過於艱難。您最好先打好基礎，再進行訓練。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我從家族繼承人波那裡聽說，您打算嘗試理查德戰鬥訓練計劃。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The training of the Richard family is differentiated from other training programs.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族的訓練與其他訓練計劃有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You must have been getting yourself trained by hunting the monsters individually.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您一定一直在獨自獵殺魔物來訓練自己吧。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
From now on, you can be trained with hunting certain types of monsters such as human, animal, insect, fish, plant, demon, angel, nothing and dragon monsters.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
從現在開始，您可以針對特定型別的魔物進行訓練，例如人類、動物、昆蟲、魚類、植物、惡魔、天使、虛無和龍類魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
It is supposed to be more effective to swing a sword than to say 100 words.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
與其說一百句話，不如揮劍一次來得有效。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Good. Are you ready now?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
很好。您準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum, there seems to be an issue which cannot be resolved. Well, try again and if the same issue occurs, take a screenshot and send it to the admin team.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯，似乎出現了無法解決的問題。請再嘗試一次，如果問題依舊，請截圖併發送給管理員團隊。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Please select a training program to try.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
請選擇一個訓練計劃進行嘗試。

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Human
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-人類

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Animal
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-動物

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Insect
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-昆蟲

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Fish
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-魚類

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Plant
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-植物

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Devil
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-惡魔

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Angel
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-天使

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Immortal
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-不死族

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Intangible
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-虛無

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Dragon
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-龍類

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 {0} monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練需要獵殺50只140級或以上的{0}魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Would you try this training?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您要嘗試這項訓練嗎？

scripts.text: Try.
scripts.translation: 嘗試

scripts.text: Do not try.
scripts.translation: 不嘗試

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum... You don't like the contents of the training? Well, it's OK. Why don't you choose another training?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...您不喜歡這項訓練的內容嗎？沒關係，您可以選擇其他訓練。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You shouldn't let your guard down even when you feel that the training is too easy for your level. Good luck...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
即使您覺得訓練對您的等級來說太簡單，也不要掉以輕心。祝您好運...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Congratulations on completing the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
恭喜您完成訓練。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
If you keep training, you'll achieve the goal you want.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
如果您堅持訓練，終將達成您想要的目標。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This is what I have prepared for the reward for completing training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這是我為您準備的完成訓練後的獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
We thank you for training with us since it benefits the Richard family. Don't feel pressured.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
感謝您參與我們的訓練，這對理查德家族大有裨益。請不要有壓力。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You are participating in the training. Do you need anything?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您正在參與訓練。有什麼需要嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: About the way of training
scripts.translation: 關於訓練方式

scripts.text: About the goal of training
scripts.translation: 關於訓練目標

scripts.text: Give up the training.
scripts.translation: 放棄訓練

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
對待訓練應當如同對待實戰一樣！在訓練期間切勿掉以輕心。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The Richard family has always been concerned about the ways to produce more excellent warriors.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族一直關注如何培養出更優秀的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
One of the former heads of the family felt that the way to train with a certain monster had a limit.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
家族的前任家主之一認為，針對特定魔物的訓練方式存在侷限性。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The former and former head of the family... Oh! Just to clear things out, he is retired, but he is not dead.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
前任...以及前任的家主...啊！為了澄清一下，他雖然已經退休，但並沒有去世。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum... Let's come back down to the business... He has come up with the method to train with the monster depending on the level of the trainee or the type of the monster.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...讓我們回到正題...他提出了一種根據學員等級或魔物型別來調整訓練的方法。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Well... The training began like that...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...訓練就是這樣開始的...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The goal of the training... It is an easy and difficult question.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
關於訓練的目標...這是一個既簡單又複雜的問題。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The most obvious goal must be getting stronger. I would have answered if I was younger.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
最顯而易見的目標無疑是變強。如果我還年輕，我也會這樣回答。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
However, I would like to answer that it is to protect the people around me.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
不過，我想說的是，目標是保護身邊的人。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The goal may be different for each warrior.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
對於每位戰士來說，目標可能都不盡相同。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I won't stop you from giving up. However, you should know that the progress of your training so far won't be reflected in the next training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我不會阻止您放棄。但您應該知道，迄今為止的訓練進度不會體現在下一次的訓練中。

scripts.text: Do not give up.
scripts.translation: 不放棄

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Good decision. You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
明智的決定。對待訓練應當如同對待實戰一樣！在訓練期間切勿掉以輕心。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Too bad. If you finished the training, you must have been able to reap the benefit of hard work.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
真遺憾。如果您完成了訓練，本可以收穫辛勤努力的成果。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
An adventurer? I guess you need to try harder now.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
冒險者？看來你現在需要更加刻苦才行。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I'd like to take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我現在想休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You must be an adventurer invited to the palace. I am taking a rest now. Talk to the butler in front of the door to make an appointment.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你一定是被邀請到宮殿的冒險者。我現在正在休息。請去門口找管家預約時間。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
That is the way to do it in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
在宮殿裡就是這樣辦事的。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You must be the adventurer who has made a great contribution in the subjugation of the dark lord. Your work is known in the palace as well.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你一定是那位在討伐暗黑之王中立下赫赫戰功的冒險者。你的事蹟在宮殿裡也是廣為人知。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Especially, us, the Richard family, are interested in your work.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
尤其是我們，理查德家族，對你的事蹟非常感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Do you want to know why?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你想知道原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, even if you don't want to know, I am going to say what I want to say anyway.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
好吧，就算你不想聽，我也要把我想說的說清楚。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
In fact, it was not your will to come here. I am pretty sure that you must have come here since the his nibs called you. I understand that.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
其實，你並不是自願來到這裡的。我相當確信，一定是那位大人把你叫來的。我理解這一點。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Although the adventurers may care less about the palace affairs, the Richard family is in charge of the military force of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
雖然冒險者可能對宮廷事務不太在意，但理查德家族負責著盧恩·米德加茲的軍事力量。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
We produce many excellent warriors as well. Hum! I am curious all of a sudden. Have you heard of the warrior from the Richard family?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我們也培養了許多優秀的戰士。哼！我突然有點好奇。你聽說過理查德家族的戰士嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我聽過。

scripts.text: No, I haven't.
scripts.translation: 不，沒見過。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Hahaha, I guess the name of Richard must be known to the adventurers as well.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哈哈，我想“理查德”這個名字在冒險者中也是很有名的。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Oh, my. I must have been a braggart. The Richard family should try harder.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哎呀，我是不是有點自誇了。理查德家族應該更加努力才對。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, since it is not important, I guess we should let it pass. It's been a long time since I say this much. I am thirsty.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
算了，既然這並不重要，那就過去吧。我已經很久沒說過這麼多話了。我渴了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Shall we take a rest before proceeding?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
在繼續之前，我們要不要休息一下？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, let's talk about the reason that the Richard family has been interested in you then.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
好吧，那我們就來說說理查德家族為什麼對你感興趣的原因吧。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
As known, the Richard family is producing outstanding warriors. We run a systematic training system to support that.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
眾所周知，理查德家族培養出了傑出的戰士。我們有一套系統化的訓練體系來支援這一點。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I am not fond of such training, but I believe that it is an effective training program based on the know-how of the family.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我雖然不太喜歡這種訓練，但我相信這是基於家族經驗的有效訓練方案。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Please listen up since I am about to get to the point.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
請仔細聽，因為我馬上要說到重點了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I guess the adventurers were not that interested; however, there were many members of the royal family participating in the subjugation of the dark lord. I have been reported of your work from them.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我想冒險者可能對此不太感興趣；然而，有許多王室成員參與了討伐暗黑之王的行動。我從他們那裡聽到了關於你事蹟的報告。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
When I was reported of the contributions you made, a question came to my mind. What if a free roaming adventure take part in the strict training system? What would happen? I got curious.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
當我聽到你做出的貢獻時，我腦海中浮現出一個問題。如果一位自由冒險者參與到嚴格的訓練體系中，會發生什麼呢？我對此感到很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I would like to make a handsome payment if a renowned adventurer like you helps us.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
如果你這樣一位著名的冒險者願意幫助我們，我很樂意支付一筆可觀的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I feel that it is an attractive offer. Would you challenge the warrior training system of the Richard family?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我覺得這是一個很有吸引力的提議。你願意挑戰理查德家族的戰士訓練體系嗎？

scripts.text: I'll try.
scripts.translation: 我會盡力。

scripts.text: I decline.
scripts.translation: 我拒絕

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I guess the offer hasn't been attractive to you. I am sorry, but come back later when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
看來這個提議對你沒有吸引力。很抱歉，等你改變主意時再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Indeed! I like the quick decision. I value the spirit of challenge.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
太好了！我喜歡你果斷的決定。我很看重挑戰精神。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Let me tell the butler about it. You can proceed with the training through him.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
讓我告訴管家這件事。你可以通過他來進行訓練。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Don't underestimate the butler who would guide you through the training.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
不要小看那位將指導你訓練的管家。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
He is a member of the Richard family himself. He is an outstanding warrior.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
他本身就是理查德家族的一員。他是一位傑出的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I wonder if you are happy with the rewards of the training.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我想知道你對訓練的獎勵是否滿意。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
It would be difficult to offer you a payment higher than that for now. Please do it as if you are having a part-time job.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
目前很難提供比這更高的報酬。請把它當作一份兼職工作來做。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You may find it obvious. However, the more you get yourself trained, the more benefits that Richard family gets. We are willing to pay for it.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你可能覺得這很明顯。然而，你訓練得越多，理查德家族獲得的益處就越多。我們願意為此付費。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Oh! You must be participating in the training. Well, how do you find the training?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哦！你一定正在參加訓練。那麼，你覺得訓練怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I have participated in the training myself when I was younger. It brings back the good old memories.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我年輕時也參加過這種訓練。這讓我想起了美好的舊時光。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
There are a variety of training programs. Please choose what you'd like to participate. Well, the adventurers tend to do what they usually do.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
這裡有各種各樣的訓練專案。請選擇你想參加的專案。嗯，冒險者通常都會做他們習慣做的事。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Accidents happen when you let your guard down. Always make sure to watch out.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
當你放鬆警惕時，意外就會發生。請務必時刻保持警惕。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I believe the most important thing to a warrior is the spirit of challenge. The challenge to move on to the next level... It is the most important thing.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我相信對戰士來說，最重要的是挑戰精神。挑戰自我，邁向下一個層次...這是最重要的事。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
A song of a warrior was very popular in the pub in Prontera. I am sad that I cannot hear it these days.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
普隆德拉的一家酒館裡曾流行一首戰士之歌。我很遺憾，這些天聽不到了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Do you like gambling by any chance? Doesn't the tension make you feel like a warrior in battle?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你碰巧喜歡賭博嗎？那種緊張感難道不讓你覺得自己像戰場上的戰士嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
There! Stop there!
Please go through the inspection for a security check.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
喂！站住！
請接受安檢檢查。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Please place your identification and personal belongings on this table and stand facing the wall...
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
請將您的證件和個人物品放在這張桌子上，然後面向牆壁站立...

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Martin! What are you doing?
Don't be rude to the guest to the room! I told you.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
馬丁！你在幹什麼？
我告訴過你，不要對客人無禮！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
It is for the safety of the queen.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
這是為了女王的安全。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
You are near the queen for security, not to chase away the guests discourteously.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
你靠近女王是為了安保，而不是為了不禮貌地趕走客人。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
The palace is so hectic like this. How can we guard the queen with such an easygoing way of thinking!
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
宮殿裡這麼混亂，怎麼能用這種隨和的態度來保護女王！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
We cannot help it during the Imperial Ordinance!
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
在帝國法令期間，我們也無可奈何！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Now the Imperial Ordinance would just be...
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
現在的帝國法令只不過是...

scripts.text:
[Queen]
It is noisy out here.
scripts.translation:
[女王]
外面好吵。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Huh! Your majesty!
I am sorry.
We have a guest here.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
啊！陛下！
非常抱歉。
這裡有一位客人。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Extend the queen every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
請對女王保持最高的禮遇。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
I have something to you. Please talk to Jerad here.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
我有事要交代。請和這裡的傑拉德談談。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
I don't know why but Scarlet and Lidion have been on bad terms for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
不知道為什麼，斯嘉麗和利迪昂已經很久不和了。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
They are similar in age so that it would have been nice if they are friends...
However, they both have such strong personalities.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
他們年紀相仿，要是能成為朋友就好了...
不過，他們倆的性格都很強。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Of course, Scarlet looks several times younger.
It is supposed to be the characteristic of the Jahas.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
當然，斯嘉麗看起來年輕好幾倍。
這應該是雅哈家族的特徵吧。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Ernst told me that he would go to the Banquet Hall.
I wonder if he is still there.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
恩斯特說他要去宴會廳。
不知道他是不是還在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Ha...
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
哈...

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Do you have any business left here?
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
您在這裡還有別的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Extend the queen every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
請對女王保持最高的禮遇。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Please excuse me for all the trouble.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
給您添麻煩了，請見諒。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
I am sorry.
There was nothing suspicious found of your belongings.
Let me return your bag.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
非常抱歉。
您的物品中沒有發現可疑之處。
請拿回您的包。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Have you been going through it?
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
你們翻查過了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
It doesn't hurt to be careful when there are a lot of passengers around here.
I don't want to experience such thing again.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
這裡乘客眾多，小心一點總沒錯。
我不想再經歷那樣的事情了。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Ha...
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
哈...
非常抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
If you don't mind, how about talking to the members of the Geoborg family in the Banquet Hall?
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
如果不介意的話，您可以去宴會廳和吉奧伯格家族的成員談談嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
She has been taking care of the state affairs alone. Not to mention the Royal Assembly...
She hasn't been able to sleep for days.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
她一直獨自處理國事。更別提皇家議會了...
她已經好幾天沒睡好覺了。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Oh!
The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
哦！
女王的妹妹“斯嘉麗·雅哈”剛才去了宴會廳。您也許能在那裡見到她。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Oh!
The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
她雖然不是家族成員，但瞭解女王的一切。
[保鏢 傑拉德]
哦！
女王的妹妹“斯嘉麗·雅哈”剛才去了宴會廳。您也許能在那裡見到她。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
她雖然不是家族成員，但瞭解女王的一切。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Oh!
The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
哦！
女王的妹妹“斯嘉麗·雅哈”剛才去了宴會廳。您也許能在那裡見到她。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
她雖然不是家族成員，但瞭解女王的一切。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Scarlet is much older than the queen, but she doesn't look that old at all.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
斯嘉麗比女王年長許多，但看起來一點也不顯老。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Of course, the queen is well along in years now as well...
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
當然，女王如今也已年事已高...

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
I hope the queen and Ernst can take some rest now.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
我希望女王和恩斯特現在能好好休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
After the Royal Assembly is over, the queen may turn over the throne to the new king, and go to the castle of Scarlet.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
皇家議會結束後，女王可能會將王位傳給新國王，然後前往斯嘉麗的城堡。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
I am a little worried for that I have been serving under the queen my entire life.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
我有些擔心，因為我一生都在侍奉女王。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Do you have any business left here?
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
您在這裡還有別的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Welcome.
I am Queen Catherine D. Geoborg.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
歡迎。
我是女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I am sorry if my knights have caused you trouble.
They are a little sensitive these days. Please understand.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
如果我的騎士們給您添了麻煩，我很抱歉。
他們最近有些敏感，請多包涵。

scripts.text: Ask about the Geoborg family.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於喬博格家族的事

scripts.text: Leave the room.
scripts.translation: 離開房間

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I see.
Come back anytime if you have any other questions.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
我明白了。
如果您還有其他問題，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Since the banquet for you heroes is being held in the Banquet Hall, please enjoy your time here.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
既然為英雄們舉辦的宴會正在宴會廳舉行，請盡情享受這裡的美好時光。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
We, the Geoborg family, are the descendants of Tristan I who founded this world. Our family has produced numerous kings and knights for generations.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
我們喬博格家族是創立這個世界的特里斯坦一世的後代。我們的家族世代產生了無數國王和騎士。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
In the first Royal Assembly which was held, the forth prince Ernst was elected as a candidate. However, he has given up his position in the Royal Assembly this time due to several incidents.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
在第一次舉行的皇家議會上，第四王子恩斯特被選為候選人。然而，由於發生了幾起事件，他這次放棄了在皇家議會中的職位。

scripts.text: What do you mean by several incidents?
scripts.translation: 您說的幾起事件是指什麼？

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Oh... It slipped my tongue.
It is a little difficult to tell you about those incidents.
I'd rather you pretend I didn't say it.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
哦...是我失言了。
向您講述那些事件有些困難。
希望您能當作我沒說過。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You have come here, but there isn't much that I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
您來到這裡，但我能告訴您的並不多。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
If you have more questions, you may ask Jerad and Martin here.
Please excuse me for not sharing more time with you due to some urgent duties.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
如果您還有更多問題，可以詢問這裡的傑拉德和土撥鼠。
由於有緊急公務，無法與您多作停留，請見諒。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You have come here, but there isn't much that I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
您來到這裡，但我能告訴您的並不多。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
If you have more questions, you may ask Jerad and Martin here.
Please excuse me for not sharing more time with you due to some urgent duties.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
如果您還有更多問題，可以詢問這裡的傑拉德和土撥鼠。
由於有緊急公務，無法與您多作停留，請見諒。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You mean Prince Ernst?
Well?
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
您是指恩斯特王子？
是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
He comes here to say good morning and either helps me the work or does other things.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
他來這裡向我道早安，然後要麼幫我處理工作，要麼做其他事情。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Ever since the banquet started, he has been carrying his work to somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
自從宴會開始以來，他一直在把公務帶到別處處理。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
He could be somewhere in the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
他可能在宴會廳的某個角落。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Haven't you met Prince Ernst yet?
He just stopped by and went out again...
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
您還沒見過恩斯特王子嗎？
他剛才來過，又出去了...

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I am worried about the representative of our family wandering around like this.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
我很擔心我們家族的代表這樣四處遊蕩。

scripts.text: Tell her about what you have heard.
scripts.translation: 告訴她你聽到的傳聞

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Oh...
Dear hero, please don't mind such stories much.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
噢...
親愛的英雄，請不要太在意那些傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
It is a problem that we, the Geoborg family, should get over ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
這是喬博格家族應該自我反省的問題。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
The ink pad of the highest quality to be used in the royal debate room?
It is the clerk who writes down everything. Why are they buying luxury item that no one will ever use...
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
要在皇家議事廳使用的最高品質墨臺？
那是記錄員用來記錄一切的。為什麼要購買沒人會用的奢侈品...

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I have enough dresses to last my lifetime. Why do they keep making them...
A cutback!
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
我有足夠穿一輩子的裙子。為什麼還要一直做...
必須削減開支！

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Hum.. Trade request from Marol Kingdom...
I should dispatch an envoy to take care of it soon...
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
嗯...來自馬羅爾王國的貿易請求...
我應該儘快派遣特使去處理...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, what can I help you, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢，有什麼可以幫您的嗎，親愛的冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, what can I help you, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢，有什麼可以幫您的嗎，親愛的冒險者？

scripts.text: Ask about the Geoborg family.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於喬博格家族的事

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Heh!
Is there no one around here who is curious about me?
Everyone who ever talks to me talk about that!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
嘿！
這裡難道沒有對我感到好奇的人嗎？
每個跟我說話的人都在說那個！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Don't be startled.
It is a joke.
Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢！
別被嚇到了。
這是個玩笑。
哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
As you know, the Geoborg family is the descendant of...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
如您所知，喬博格家族是...的後裔

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Tristan I who have founded the kingdom!
Is there anyone who doesn't know the story in this kingdom?
Dear Lady Jaha.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
是建立了這個王國的特里斯坦一世！
在這個王國裡，還有誰不知道這個故事嗎？
親愛的雅哈女士。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, my!
Lidion Geoborg!
Why are you out here in the Banquet Hall? You must not be feeling so well.
You should have been taking a rest in your manor!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢，天哪！
利迪翁·喬博格！
您怎麼會在宴會廳？您身體一定不舒服吧。
您應該在您的宅邸裡休息！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
I couldn't risk letting a lady of the Jaha family pretend to know about the Geoborg family. I couldn't just take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
我不能冒讓雅哈家族的女士假裝瞭解喬博格家族的風險。我不能就這樣休息。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, my!
Lidion Geoborg!
Why are you out here in the Banquet Hall? You must not be feeling so well.
You should have been taking a rest in your manor!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢，天哪！
利迪翁·喬博格！
您怎麼會在宴會廳？您身體一定不舒服吧。
您應該在您的宅邸裡休息！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
I couldn't risk letting a lady of the Jaha family pretend to know about the Geoborg family. I couldn't just take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
我不能冒讓雅哈家族的女士假裝瞭解喬博格家族的風險。我不能就這樣休息。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Phew, that old jerk!
He is younger than me and always tries to preach!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
呼，那個老頑固！
他比我年輕，卻總是想對我說教！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Well... For that reason, the Geoborg family will retire to a quiet life for a while as soon as the Royal Assembly is over.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢！
嗯...因此，皇家議會結束後，喬博格家族將暫時退隱，過上安靜的生活。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
I really hope that Catherine doesn't suffer from sorrow anymore.
That's why I fully support such decision!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
我真的希望凱瑟琳不再遭受悲傷。
所以我全力支援這個決定！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
However, Prince Ernst is nowhere to be found.
His aunt has come a long way to comfort her poor nephew, you know!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
不過，恩斯特王子卻不知去向。
他的姨媽可是大老遠趕來安慰他那可憐的外甥的，你知道嗎！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
My sister chased me away to the Banquet Hall, saying she was busy. And I cannot find my nephew either.
Eww...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
我姐姐把我趕到了宴會廳，說她在忙。我也找不到我外甥。
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you run into Ernst in the Banquet Hall, please tell him to come this way.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
如果你在宴會廳遇到恩斯特，請告訴他來這裡一趟。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
However, Prince Ernst is nowhere to be found.
His aunt has come a long way to comfort her poor nephew, you know!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
不過，恩斯特王子卻不知去向。
他的姨媽可是大老遠趕來安慰他那可憐的外甥的，你知道嗎！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
My sister chased me away to the Banquet Hall, saying she was busy. And I cannot find my nephew either.
Eww...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
我姐姐把我趕到了宴會廳，說她在忙。我也找不到我外甥。
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you run into Ernst in the Banquet Hall, please tell him to come this way.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
如果你在宴會廳遇到恩斯特，請告訴他來這裡一趟。

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你持有的物品太多了。
請整理你的背包並再試一次。-

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Haven't you found him yet?
Should I ask Catherine?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢！
你還沒找到他嗎？
我應該問問凱瑟琳嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
That expression on your face... You must have heard what people say.
There must have been no good stories in particular...
Please don't mind such stories much.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
看你那個表情...你一定聽到了人們的議論。
肯定沒有什麼好聽的話...
請不要太在意那些流言蜚語。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Ernst must have been hiding from such whispers as well.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
恩斯特肯定也在躲避這些閒言碎語。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Well, I guess he needs some rest.
You hero, cheer up and enjoy the banquet!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
好吧，我想他需要休息一下。
英雄，振作起來，好好享受宴會吧！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
What a waste to let the banquet end like this!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
讓宴會這樣結束，真是浪費！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, hero!
Are you having a good time?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢，英雄！
你玩得開心嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you have some time to spare, please tell me some fun stories from your adventure.
I am sick of listening to Lidion's nitpicking.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
如果你有空閒時間，請給我講講你冒險中的趣事吧。
我聽膩了利迪翁的挑剔了。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
We, the Geoborg family, is one of the seven royal families, but we are the creme de la creme for producing the highest number of kings in the history.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
我們喬博格家族是七大皇家家族之一，但在歷史上，我們是產生國王數量最多的家族，堪稱其中的佼佼者。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
In fact, we are settled in Prontera, the center of the Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
事實上，我們定居在盧恩·米德加茲的中心，普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Despite the series of unfortunate events regarding the princes after the death of King Tristan III,
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
儘管在特里斯坦三世國王去世後，發生了一系列關於王子的不幸事件，

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Prince Ernst Geoborg was elected as the most regnant candidate in the last Royal Assembly. It shows just influential the Geoborg family is.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
但在上一次的皇家議會上，恩斯特·喬博格王子被選為最有力的繼位候選人。這正顯示了喬博格家族的影響力。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
He has given up from the position.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
他已經放棄了那個職位。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
What?
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
I said!
Prince Ernst gave up his position as the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
我說！
恩斯特王子放棄了王位候選人的職位。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
What a nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
真是胡鬧！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
You didn't know!
You must have been separated from the outside world for too long!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢！
你不知道嗎？
你肯定與外界隔絕太久了！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
I won't let this punk... Ernst....!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
啊...！
我絕不會讓那個朽魔...恩斯特...！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Punk?
Even if you are an elder of the family, he is still a prince. You should extend him every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
朽魔？
即使你是家族長老，他依然是王子。你應該對他保持應有的禮遇。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
啊...！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
I won't let this punk... Ernst....!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
啊...！
我絕不會讓那個朽魔...恩斯特...！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Punk?
Even if you are an elder of the family, he is still a prince. You should extend him every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
朽魔？
即使你是家族長老，他依然是王子。你應該對他保持應有的禮遇。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
啊...！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Tut...
Letting anybody in like this... The dignity of the palace has fallen down to the ground.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
真是的...
就這樣讓任何人進出...宮殿的威嚴早已蕩然無存了。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Did you hear the story?
The skeleton of King Tristan III has been found.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
你聽到那個傳聞了嗎？
特里斯坦三世國王的骸骨被發現了。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Oh my!
Gosh!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
天哪！
真是難以置信！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
It is a secret. Don't tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
這是秘密。不要告訴任何人。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
...So the princes must have been poisoned...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
...所以那些王子一定是被毒殺了...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
What on earth!
Well, in the last Royal Assembly...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
真是荒唐！
就在上次的皇家集會上...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Ha!
He has given up the royal authority like that!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
哈！
他就這樣放棄了王權！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Doesn't he even care for the people of his family?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
他難道不關心家族子民嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Your voice is too loud!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
你的聲音太大了！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
No...
I didn't say anything wrong.
Did I?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
不...
我沒有說錯話。
是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
How can he decide such a major issue as he wants?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
像這樣重大的問題，怎麼能由他一個人決定？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
I knew it. He has been hanging out with that punk from the third-rate family too long...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
我就知道。他在那個三流家族的朽魔身邊待得太久了...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
So is the queen who is handling all the matters of the palace now?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
那麼現在處理宮殿事務的是女王嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
She hasn't showed her presence to the public so far...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
她至今還沒有在公眾面前露面...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
How foolish it is to give up the regal power like that!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
就這樣放棄王權，真是太愚蠢了！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
I won't ever let go of such power!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
我絕不會放棄這樣的權力！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Hey, you!
Not anyone can have such power.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
嘿，你！
不是誰都能擁有這種權力的。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Why not?
I am free to dream!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
為什麼不行？
我有自由夢想的權利！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Is the Geoborg family cursed?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
吉奧堡家族是被詛咒了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Shh!
You shouldn't say such a thing so easily!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
噓！
你不該這麼輕易地說這種話！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
The women in the line here are so scary.
They curse, push and fight...
scripts.translation:
[單身漢]
這裡排隊的女人們好可怕。
她們會詛咒、推搡和打架...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why don't you just go back then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你為什麼不乾脆回去呢？

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
Are you telling me to go back when Jurgen is right inside of the door?
I won't!
scripts.translation:
[單身漢]
尤爾根就在門裡面，你讓我回去？
我不回去！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
I won't go before seeing the elegant and luminous presence of him!
I have come here from Payon to meet Jurgen!
scripts.translation:
[單身漢]
在見到他優雅而光輝的身影之前，我絕不離開！
我從斐揚趕來，就是為了見尤爾根！

scripts.text:
[Miss]
Jurgen treats us all the same. We should have a sense of fair play.
Who ever it was, turn yourself in!
scripts.translation:
[小姐]
尤爾根對大家都一視同仁。我們應該有公平競爭的意識。
不管是誰，都請自首吧！

scripts.text:
[Miss]
Who was it? Who pretended to be close to Katrin and went along with her? Come out here! We have made a pact not to stand out!
scripts.translation:
[小姐]
是誰？是誰假裝和卡特琳親近，跟著她混進來的？出來吧！我們約定過不引人注目的！

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
Jurgen belongs to all of us! No one should have him to oneself! I won't let anyone to do that!
scripts.translation:
[婦女們]
尤爾根屬於我們所有人！誰也不能獨佔他！我絕不允許任何人那樣做！

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
I won't let anyone monopolize Jurgen! The heaven may forgive, but I won't!
scripts.translation:
[婦女們]
我絕不允許任何人獨佔尤爾根！上天也許會原諒，但我不會！

scripts.text:
[Gyusoo]
It is no use getting a ticket number... It is just too difficult to wait for my turn.
scripts.translation:
[圭秀]
拿到排隊號碼也沒用... 要等到我的輪次實在太難了。

scripts.text:
[Gyusoo]
When will Jurgen come out?
When will be my turn to see him?
scripts.translation:
[圭秀]
尤爾根什麼時候出來？
什麼時候輪到我見他？

scripts.text:
[Bachelorette]
There! If you are a newbie, don't be so naive and try to fit in here!
scripts.translation:
[單身女子]
喂！如果你是新手，別這麼天真，想在這裡混進去可沒那麼容易！

scripts.text:
[Bachelorette]
[Bachelorette]
Hey, don't you push me there! Stand in the line. Isn't it your first time here to see Jurgen?
scripts.translation:
[單身女子]
[單身女子]
嘿，別在那兒推我！排好隊。難道你是第一次來見尤爾根嗎？

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Hey, you lady! Don't push!
Stay in the line!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
嘿，那位女士！別推！
排好隊！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
There was this lady who was carried out with a broken ankle from pushing!
It is all for your own good!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
剛才有位女士因為推搡被抬了出去，腳踝都骨折了！
這都是為了你們好！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Ha, I am already feeling tired as always.
I didn't know that women were so strong before.
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
哈，我照例已經覺得很累了。
我以前不知道女人們這麼強壯。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
I started yesterday and realized why the people who had worked here before quit.
Despite being with so many ladies here, I am not happy at all.
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
我昨天才開始工作，就明白了為什麼之前在這裡工作的人都辭職了。
雖然身邊有很多女士，但我一點都不開心。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
As you see, there are no guards guarding the doord to other family's residences.
However, there are too many infiltrators to the Wigner residence who get in there to see Jurgen. Now the door is guarded at all times.
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
你看，通往其他家族住宅的門是沒有衛兵看守的。
但是，試圖潛入維格納住宅見尤爾根的刺客太多了。現在門時刻都有人看守。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Oh, be quiet there!
It is too noisy that Jurgen cannot take his beauty rest!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
哦，那邊安靜點！
太吵了，尤爾根沒法好好休息！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
It is not for my sake, but for Jurgen.
It would make you sad if Jurgen is unable to sleep, right? So be quiet!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
這不是為了我自己，而是為了尤爾根。
如果尤爾根睡不好覺，你會難過的，對吧？所以請安靜點！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Oh, wait there! Stop there!
Aren't you the one who has infiltrated the room before? You don't have to run hiding your face! Come back here!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
哦，站住！別跑了！
你之前是不是潛入過房間？不用遮著臉跑啊！給我回來！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
She went off again. She sure is fast.
I am glad that my own sister doesn't come to a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
她又跑掉了。跑得真快。
還好我妹妹不會來這種地方。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
When I applied to become a guard, I wanted to keep the palace safe with my own hands...
Never did I know that I would end up here...
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
當初申請當衛兵時，我想親手守護這座宮殿的安全...
沒想到最後會落到這裡...

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Hey, you! There! Stand in the line! Stop there! You shouldn't block the way!
If you keep doing that, I'll stop you from coming here!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
嘿，你！那邊！排好隊！站住！別擋路！
再這樣，我就禁止你進來了！

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, although I respect your hard work going through all the obstacles and hardships, it is still a little too early for you to be here.
I hope I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，雖然我很敬佩你克服重重困難來到這裡，但現在對你來說還太早了。
期待稍後見到你。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Who are you?
Only the people with permission can enter this place. Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
你是誰？
只有獲准的人才能進入這裡。請離開。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome to the Wigner family. My name is ^0000cdLevuiere Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，歡迎來到維格納家族。我是^0000cd勒維埃爾·維格納^000000。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I am honored by your visit while you are attending the banquet held for you, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
在您參加為您舉辦的宴會期間，能收到您的拜訪，我深感榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
This banquet carries more meaning than celebration since the Royal Assembly is conducted at the same time. Did you hear that?
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
這場宴會不僅僅是慶祝，因為皇家議會也在同時舉行。您聽到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
There is a candidate from our family who participates in the Royal Assembly as well. Would you like to meet him?
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
我們家族也有一位候選人參加皇家議會。您想見見他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
She is the lady of the Wigner house, ^0000cdCatherine Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
她是維格納家的女主人，^0000cd凱瑟琳·維格納^000000。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
How do you do? Please make yourself at home while you are staying with us, the Wigner family. Please let me know if you experience any inconvenience here.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您好？在我們維格納家族做客時，請像在自己家一樣自在。如果您遇到任何不便，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We, Wigners, will support as much as possible for your convenience, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我們維格納家族會盡最大努力為您方便，親愛的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor too if you have the time, dear adventurer. You are always welcome.
Where is ^0000cdJurgen^000000 now?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
親愛的冒險者，如果您有時間，也請參觀我們的莊園。您隨時歡迎。
^0000cd尤爾根^000000現在在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you looking for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你在找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
There you are! Dear adventurer, this is the ^0000cdheir of the Wigner family^000000, and the ^0000cdcandidate for the throne^000000 participating in the Royal Assembly this time.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
你來了！親愛的冒險者，這位是^0000cd維格納家族的繼承人^000000，也是這次參加皇家議會的^0000cd王位候選人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hello. My name is ^0000cdJurgen Wigner^000000. It is very nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你好。我是^0000cd尤爾根·維格納^000000。很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, please make yourself home here. If you need anything or find anything inconvenient, please let us know anytime.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，請在這裡像在自己家一樣自在。如果您需要任何東西或發現任何不便，請隨時告訴我們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your hospitality.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你的款待。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Then, please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那麼，請原諒我的失禮。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Tut, I am worried that he lacks sociability. He would have to meet a lot of people as the heir of the house, you know. Dear adventurer, please excuse my son's discourtesy.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
唉，我擔心他缺乏社交能力。畢竟作為家族的繼承人，他需要結識很多人，您知道的。親愛的冒險者，請原諒我兒子的無禮。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If time allows, would you like to meet our children? They have been excited to meet the hero who defeated Morocc in the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
如果時間允許，您願意見見我們的孩子嗎？他們一直很想見見在宴會上擊敗摩洛克的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Then please make yourself at home and take a look around, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
那麼，請像在自己家一樣自在，四處看看吧，親愛的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, please make yourself home and take your time looking around here.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，請像在自己家一樣自在，慢慢參觀這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If time allows, would you please tell our children the stories of your adventures? It would be an invaluable experience for them.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
如果時間允許，您能給我們講講您的冒險故事嗎？這對他們來說將是無比珍貴的經歷。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Then, have a restful time.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
那麼，祝您休息愉快。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, did you meet the children? I would love to have some tea with you and listen to your stories if you are available.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，您見到孩子們了嗎？如果您有空，我很想和您一起喝杯茶，聽聽您的故事。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
We like to hear the stories of adventurers very much.
Those adventures are valuable experiences that money cannot buy.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
我們非常喜歡聽冒險者的故事。
那些冒險經歷是金錢買不到的寶貴財富。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I wonder if our children have observed their manners though. We must have spoiled them for that they sometimes act so imprudently.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不知道我們的孩子是否守住了禮儀。我們可能太寵他們了，所以他們有時會表現得有些魯莽。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I am trying to warn them a little these days, Please excuse their behaviors if they have done anything rude to you.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
最近我一直在提醒他們。如果他們對您做了什麼無禮的事，請原諒他們的行為。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all. Jurgen seemed to have grown since my last visit.
Katrin and Isaac impressed me as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
完全不會。尤爾根看起來比我上次來訪時更成熟了。
卡特琳和艾薩克也給我留下了很深的印象。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We have been too easy on them.
We are ashamed that we were not prepared properly for the Royal Assembly last time.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我們對他們太寬鬆了。
上次皇家議會我們準備得不夠充分，我們感到很慚愧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
It is not important whether he becomes the king or not.
If he is a king material, he will be. If not, he doesn't have to be the king. I don't want to stress him out for that.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
他是否成為國王並不重要。
如果他具備國王的潛質，他就會成為國王。如果沒有，他也不必非當國王不可。我不想因此給他太大壓力。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Don't you have any ambitions? What a glory would it be if we turn out a king from our family of our generation!
Since our ancestors founded this kingdom, we deserve to produce a king.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您難道沒有野心嗎？如果我們這一代能出一位國王，那將是多麼榮耀的事！
既然我們的祖先建立了這個王國，我們就理應產生一位國王。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
The king is a hollow position. It only comes with responsibilities?
Haven't I told you before? Did you forget?
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
國王只是一個虛位，隨之而來的只有責任。
我以前告訴過您吧？您忘了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If our family turns out a king, much of our fortune will be spent. Once, our family has really suffered from it.
Near the king, there are always a swarm of pesky flies.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
如果我們家族出了一位國王，我們的許多財富都會消耗殆盡。曾經，我們的家族真的因此吃過苦頭。
在國王身邊，總有一群煩人的蒼蠅。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You know, it could be the exact opposite.
It may reinforce our family.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您知道嗎，情況可能恰恰相反。
這可能會鞏固我們家族的勢力。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Now there are Katrin and Isaac who can back up Jurgen.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
現在有卡特琳和艾薩克可以支援尤爾根。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Hum... Isaac.
Thinking of him makes me confident.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
嗯...艾薩克。
想到他，我就很有信心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must trust Isaac quite a lot.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來您非常信任艾薩克。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Oh, we must have left you out of the conversation, dear adventurer.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
哎呀，看來我們把你排除在談話之外了，親愛的冒險者。
真是不好意思。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all. I have been enjoying the conversation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係。我一直很享受這段談話。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Now that you mention it, how do you find our third child, Isaac?
He is the most Wigner-like one among the children.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
既然您提到了，您覺得我們的第三個孩子艾薩克怎麼樣？
他是孩子們中最像維格納家族的人。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
While Jurgen is interested in the looks, he doesn't really care for money or the throne...
If Katrin was a son, I would have gladly leave everything to her.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
尤爾根雖然注重外表，但他並不真正在乎金錢或王位...
如果卡特琳是個兒子，我會很樂意把一切都留給她。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Fortunately, the third child who used to be a mischievous boy has grown up to be suitable for the name of Wigner.
Not that the other two are inadequate.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
幸運的是，那個曾經調皮的三兒子已經長大，配得上維格納這個名字了。
