這並不是說其他兩個孩子不夠格。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I know what you mean.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白您的意思。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Nevertheless, don't talk like that in front of the children. It is not good to favor a child.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不管怎樣，別在孩子面前這樣說。偏袒一個孩子是不好的。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
As a member of the Wigner family, one must be able to cope with criticism.
They should be able to determine what's right upon listening to the words of other people. Also, they need to be able to deal with the hard truths.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
作為維格納家族的一員，必須能夠應對批評。
他們應該能夠根據他人的話語判斷是非。此外，他們還需要能夠面對殘酷的真相。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please don't talk like that in front of the children.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
請不要在孩子面前這樣說。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I never talk to them like this you know.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
你知道的，我從不對他們這樣說話。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Anyways, Isaac seems busy doing something these days. Do you know what he is doing?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
總之，艾薩克最近似乎很忙。你知道他在做什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I heard that he is doing something with the third son of the Roegenburg family. You don't need to worry about Isaac. He knows how to take care of himself.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
我聽說他在和羅根堡家族的三兒子一起做事。你不用擔心艾薩克。他知道如何照顧自己。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Arghhhhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
啊哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
^0000cdKatrin?^000000

[Catherine]
^0000cdKatrin?^000000 Has something happened to my baby? I should get going...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
^0000cd卡特琳？^000000 我的孩子出什麼事了嗎？我得趕緊過去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You two stay here. It might be dangerous. Let me go take a look first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們兩個留在這裡。可能會有危險。讓我先去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Has something happened to our child, I mean, Katrin?
Shouldn't I go down there myself?
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
我們的孩子，我是說卡特琳，出什麼事了嗎？
難道我不應該親自下去看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It could be dangerous. Please wait here for a minute.
I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可能會有危險。請在這裡稍等片刻。
我去。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I asked what had happened to the children, but they didn't tell me.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，歡迎。
我問孩子們發生了什麼事，但他們沒有告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Are they hiding something bad from me...?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
他們是不是在對我隱瞞什麼不好的事情...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, they are not. You don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，他們沒有。您不必為此擔心。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Then please tell me what it is about.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
那麼請告訴我，那是關於什麼的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If they have decided not to tell you, it is not my story to tell.
Since I have to run some errands, I should get going now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果他們決定不告訴您，那也不是我該說的事。
我還有些雜事要辦，現在該走了。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, you seem busy.
Is it about what our children have asked you?
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，您看起來很忙。
是關於孩子們問您的那件事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We have decided not to question it any more.
They have grown up, but we still tend to baby them too much...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我們已經決定不再追問了。
雖然他們長大了，但我們還是忍不住把他們當嬰兒一樣照顧...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Anyways, if you need help, please let me know anytime.
And thank you for helping our children.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
總之，如果您需要幫助，請隨時告訴我。
還有，謝謝您幫助我們的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, I have heard the story from the children.
They didn't go into all the details, but I heard that they owed you a huge favor.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，我從孩子們那裡聽到了故事。
他們沒有說所有細節，但我聽說他們欠您一個大人情。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
The children are getting along so much better these days.
Not that they were on bad terms, but now they seen to care for one another more. I am so glad.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
孩子們最近相處得越來越好了。
雖然他們之前關係也不壞，但現在他們似乎更關心彼此了。我真高興。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
You seem to be the messenger of luck to our family.
It is our family tradition to keep a person like you close and treat well.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
您似乎是我們家的幸運使者。
按照我們家的傳統，我們要好好對待像您這樣親近的人。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor after the banquet is over.
We would be honored to have you as a guest to our home.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
宴會結束後，請去我們的莊園拜訪。
能邀請您做客，我們深感榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Hello, dear adventurer. Welcome!
We are honored by your visit to the Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您好，親愛的冒險者。歡迎！
維格納家族很榮幸您的到來。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please let me know if you experience any inconvenience here.
As the lady of the house I would make your stay as pleasant as possible.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
如果您在這裡感到任何不便，請告訴我。
作為女主人，我會讓您的停留儘可能愉快。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You may talk to the head of the family standing next to me. His name is Levuiere Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您可以和站在我旁邊的家族首領交談。他的名字是勒維埃爾·維格納。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Have you met our children? Having a conversation with you would be an invaluable experience for our children, dear adventurer.
They haven't been through any trouble growing up so we feel that they lack in various life experiences.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您見過我們的孩子嗎？與您交談對孩子們來說將是寶貴的經歷，親愛的冒險者。
他們成長過程中沒經歷過什麼麻煩，所以我們覺得他們缺乏各種生活經驗。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Since I am married to a man from the family which has founded this country, I want to raise my children worthy of the name. However, my husband is not interested in fame and power.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
既然我嫁給了這個國家創始家族的人，我想把孩子培養得配得上這個姓氏。然而，我的丈夫對名聲和權力並不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I feel very sorry about it.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
對此我感到非常遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
However, I tend to let our children to whatever they want to do, which makes me wonder if I have spoiled them...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不過，我傾向於讓孩子做他們想做的任何事，這讓我懷疑自己是不是把他們寵壞了...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I'd like to hear your stories for that.
It is always a great joy to listen to the stories of the people who have gone through a lot of experiences.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我想聽聽您的故事。
傾聽那些經歷豐富的人的故事，總是件樂事。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
What if anything has happened to my baby, Katrin?
I'd better I go down there myself.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我的孩子卡特琳，是不是出什麼事了？
我最好親自下去看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It could be dangerous, please wait here for a minute.
Let me go down there and see what has happened.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可能會有危險，請在這裡稍等片刻。
讓我下去看看發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I hope everything is OK.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
希望一切都好。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I asked what had happened to the children, but they didn't tell me.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，歡迎。
我問孩子們發生了什麼事，但他們沒有告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Are they hiding something bad from me...?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
他們是不是在對我隱瞞什麼不好的事情...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, they are not. You don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，他們沒有。您不必為此擔心。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Then please tell me what it is about.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
那麼請告訴我，那是關於什麼的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If they have decided not to tell you, it is not my story to tell.
Since I have to run some errands, I should get going now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果他們決定不告訴您，那也不是我該說的事。
我還有些雜事要辦，現在該走了。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I wonder if our children haven't bothered you much. Although we are very curious, we have decided not to question it any more.
They have grown up, but we still tend to baby them too much...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不知道我們的孩子有沒有給您添麻煩。雖然我們很好奇，但決定不再多問了。
他們長大了，但我們還是忍不住把他們當小孩子寵著...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Anyways, if you need help, please let me know anytime.
And thank you for helping our children.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
總之，如果您需要幫助，請隨時告訴我。
還有，謝謝您幫助我們的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
For some reason, our children have become very close to one another.
I think it is all thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不知為何，我們的孩子們彼此變得非常親密。
我想這都要歸功於您。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor after the banquet is over.
Please give us the opportunity to treat you, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
宴會結束後，請去我們的莊園坐坐。
請給我們一個款待您的機會，親愛的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
您帶的行李好像很多，沒事吧？
看起來又多又大。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
要不要減少一些？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you a fan of mine? Did you make an appointment? If you are a guest of mine, why don't you go see my father over there?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
您是仰慕我的粉絲嗎？有預約嗎？既然您是我的客人，為什麼不去那邊見見我的父親呢？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I am glad that you are still here. Sorry about my bad manners earlier. I wanted to have more conversation with you. However, if I make any mistakes while I talk in front of my mother, I get scolded.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，很高興您還在這裡。抱歉剛才失禮了。我想和您多聊一會兒。但是，如果我在母親面前說話出了差錯，就會被責罵。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Not that she would be harsh on my, but it still kind of bothers me so I had to leave. I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
雖然她不會對我太嚴厲，但還是讓我有些困擾，所以我不得不離開。很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, since you are already here, may I introduce my family to you? This elegant lady here is my sister, ^0000cdKatrin Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，既然您已經來了，我可以向您介紹一下我的家人嗎？這位優雅的女士是我的姐姐，^0000cd卡特琳·維格納^000000。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You shouldn't call me your sister, but the first daughter of the Wigner family in this occasion.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
在這種場合，您不應該叫我姐姐，而應該稱我為維格納家的長女。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, I am honored to meet you. I hope you have a restful stay with the Wigners.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
親愛的冒險者，很榮幸見到您。希望您能在維格納家度過愉快的時光。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
This is my brother, ^0000cdIsaac Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這是我的弟弟，^0000cd艾薩克·維格納^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
He is the youngest child of the Wigner family. Unlike my sister and I who are not interested in the family business, he is a prodigy who will shine the name of the Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
他是維格納家最小的孩子。不像我和姐姐對家族生意不感興趣，他是個天才，將會為維格納家族爭光。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Hello? I am Isaac Wigner. What a trouble you are going through to visit a boring family like this. I hope you have fun here if you can...
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你好？我是艾薩克·維格納。您費這麼大勁來拜訪我們這樣無聊的家庭，真是麻煩您了。希望您能在這裡玩得開心，如果可能的話...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Isaac, I have warned you about such manner of speaking before.
You are also being disrespectful to Jurgen who has just introduced you. Are you going to put us all to shame?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
艾薩克，我之前就警告過你這種說話方式。
你剛才對剛介紹你的尤爾根也很不敬。難道你想讓我們全家丟臉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It is a joke, just a joke! Sister, you are so inflexible.
In a dreary atmosphere like this, this adventurer deserves to laugh a little, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
開個玩笑而已，只是玩笑！姐姐，你太死板了。
在這種沉悶的氣氛下，這位冒險者應該笑一笑，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are not being funny but disrespectful to the guest. Dear adventurer, please excuse the bad manners. I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你這不是幽默，而是對客人的不敬。親愛的冒險者，請原諒他的無禮。我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
By the way, I want to go home as soon as possible. This place is too narrow and gloomy.
I would like to be in the Banquet Hall at least.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
順便說一句，我想盡快回家。這裡太狹窄陰暗了。
我至少想在宴會廳裡待著。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
There must be a lot of people who want to see me. I am obliged to show my face.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
肯定有很多人都想見我。我有義務露個面。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
My presence will light up the dark palace, you know. I should entertain the bored people there.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我的存在會讓這座昏暗的宮殿亮起來，你知道的。我應該去逗樂那些無聊的人。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are insulting the Royal Assembly. You need to do your best. Royal Assembly is more sacred that you think.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你在侮辱皇家議會。你必須全力以赴。皇家議會比你想像的更神聖。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You shouldn't forget that you are one of the candidates for the throne who will lead the kingdom with the seven royal families.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你不應該忘記，你是王位候選人之一，將與七大王室共同領導這個王國。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It means that you shouldn't act like a child. I have told you not to take the weight of your responsibility and duty so lightly.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
這意味著你不應該像個孩子一樣行事。我告訴過你，不要如此輕視你的責任和義務。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Of course, I know that well. That's why I have tidied up my looks and fixed my hair perfectly.
I tried not to loosen up, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
當然，我很清楚。所以我整理好了儀容，把頭髮打理得完美無缺。
我儘量沒有鬆懈，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You need to be able to groom yourself up well to take care of greater matters.
Of course, I am well-prepared.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你需要把自己打扮得體面，才能處理更重要的事務。
當然，我已經準備得很充分了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Would you like to see my new cape?
It goes with the color of my eyes. It would definitely brighten up the palace.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你想看看我的新斗篷嗎？
它的顏色與我的眼睛相配。它一定會讓宮殿更加明亮。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, not again. Dear adventurer, you should be used to this to have a conversation with my brother at our home.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
噢，又來了。親愛的冒險者，要在我們家和我弟弟交談，你得習慣這種場面。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, there he goes again. I should get going now. Dear adventurer, I would like to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
噢，他又開始了。我該走了。親愛的冒險者，希望稍後能再見到你。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, I guess that is it for today. If you are not busy, ^0000cdwhy don't you go have a cup of tea with our parents^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
親愛的冒險者，我想今天就這樣了。如果你不忙，^0000cd為什麼不和我們的父母喝杯茶呢^000000？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
My parents love to hear the stories of adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我的父母很喜歡聽冒險者的故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is a good idea. Please excuse me then.
[Jurgen]
Our ^0000cdparents^000000 are over there. They'd like to talk to you.
By the way, are there many people waiting outside the door?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是個好主意。那麼我就先失陪了。
[尤爾根]
我們的^0000cd父母^000000在那邊。他們想和你談談。
順便問一下，門外有很多人在等嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
They are waiting for me. However, it is a little tiring to meet them all one by one.
It is very demanding to guard the world's peace with my beauty.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
他們在等我。不過，逐一會見他們有點累。
用我的美貌來守護世界和平，真是很費力的事。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Our ^0000cdparents^000000 are over there. They'd like to talk to you.
By the way, are there many people waiting outside the door?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我們的^0000cd父母^000000在那邊。他們想和你談談。
順便問一下，門外有很多人在等嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
They are waiting for me. However, it is a little tiring to meet them all one by one.
It is very demanding to guard the world's peace with my beauty.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
他們在等我。不過，逐一會見他們有點累。
用我的美貌來守護世界和平，真是很費力的事。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It seems that my sister has lost something. I couldn't understand her words since she was in such a hurry.
Would you please ask her what it is about?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
看來我姐姐丟了什麼東西。因為她太匆忙了，我沒聽清她在說什麼。
你能去問問她是怎麼回事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Whatever she has lost, it must be very valuable to her. I feel that she'd better get someone to help her to find it.
Well, then she would be scolded by our father though...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
不管她丟了什麼，對她來說一定都很珍貴。我覺得最好找人幫她找找。
不過，那樣她可能會被父親責罵...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I wonder if you can look into it as fast and quietly as possible.
My sister's fate depends on your hands.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
不知你能否儘快且安靜地調查一下。
我姐姐的命運就掌握在你手中了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It seems that she may drop dead if she doesn't find whatever she has lost.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
如果找不到丟失的東西，她可能會氣暈過去。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you are here. How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你來了。情況如何？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. Everyone has seen it there, but no one has seen it taken.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不。大家都看到它在那裡，但沒人看到它被拿走。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How about the one who has taken it? Oh, right, the one who has taken it wouldn't say so.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那拿走它的人呢？哦，對了，拿走它的人肯定不會承認的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, people seem to have a strange prejudice about Katrin. I know the words they say are not true, but you'd better to something about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
順便說一句，大家似乎對卡特琳有些奇怪的偏見。我知道他們說的話不是真的，但你最好做點什麼。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What do you meant?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, please don't take it wrong. Some people have said that Katrin may have done it to draw attention or they cannot trust Katrin.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，請別誤會。有些人說卡特琳可能是為了吸引注意力才這麼做的，或者他們不信任卡特琳。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What a nonsense! Phew... This is exactly why I have told her to open her heart to others and talk more...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
真是胡扯！呼...這正是我告訴她要對別人敞開心扉、多交流的原因...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Why should I do that? I don't care about the people who don't know me well anyway.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我為什麼要那樣做？反正我不在乎那些不瞭解我的人。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, when did you come back?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
姐姐，你什麼時候回來的？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I came here just a minute ago. However, I heard what you said. So, do you think it's my fault to hear such things?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我剛才才到。不過，我聽到你們說的話了。所以，你覺得聽到這些話是我的錯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You are to blame to a certain level. Look at me. I always to treat others with all my hearts. They all love me for that.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你確實有一定責任。看看我。我總是全心全意地對待別人。他們都因此喜歡我。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Do you think people like you for your attitude?
Don't you remember the trouble that all the family members have been through because of your attitude issue during the Royal Assembly?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你覺得人們是因為你的態度才喜歡你的嗎？
你不記得在皇家集會上，因為你的態度問題，全家人都經歷了什麼麻煩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
If it is not my attitude, then for what?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
如果不是因為我的態度，那是因為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Do you mean that it is for my looks?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你是說因為我的長相？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Can you deny it? Since you were young, when you are doing nothing, no, even when you are rude, people have been nice to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你能否認嗎？從小到大，即使你什麼都不做，不，即使你態度惡劣，人們也對你很好。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
They all smiled at you to please the pretty-looking heir of the Wigner family, the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
他們都對你微笑，是為了討好維格納家族英俊的繼承人，王位的候選人。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You say that is for my looks?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你說那是因為我的長相？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Looks have played an important role. You cannot deny it. Looks are part of your talent, right?
Especially, in our family. You should know it by now.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
長相起了很大的作用。你不能否認。長相是你天賦的一部分，對吧？
尤其是在我們家族。你應該已經知道了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Even if it's all for my looks, have I ever wanted it to be that way?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
即使都是因為我長相，我什麼時候希望是這樣了？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Even when I am not doing anything wrong, I am always compared to my handsome brother, and bad rumors follow me. Do you think I have ever wanted it to be that way?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
即使我沒有做錯任何事，我總是被拿來和我英俊的哥哥比較，壞名聲也總是跟著我。你覺得我希望是這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
That's why you need to open up to others and act nice...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
所以你需要敞開心扉，對人友善一點...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
The best way not to cause misunderstanding is to be silent. When I don't talk, I don't make a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
避免誤解的最好方法就是保持沉默。我不說話，就不會犯錯。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
That doesn't always work. About what happened today, you know. Even when you were silent...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那並不總是有效的。比如今天發生的事，你知道的。即使你保持沉默...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am already doing my best! You know what? The darkest shadow is always right next to the brightest light! It is just like me next to you! I have been trying!
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我已經盡力了！你知道嗎？最黑暗的陰影總是緊挨著最明亮的光！就像我站在你身邊一樣！我一直在努力！

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
However, people don't see who I really am! What else should I do now?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
然而，人們看不到真正的我！我現在還能做什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Both of you should calm down.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們兩個都冷靜一下。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Yes. Whatever it is, you'd better calm down. I could hear you yelling at each other from the other end of the hallway.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
是的。不管發生了什麼，你們最好冷靜下來。我在走廊那頭都能聽到你們在互相吼叫。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Our family is supposed to have a reputation to keep, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我們家族應該維護自己的聲譽，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
What you have ruined last time is about to be recovered now, brother.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
上次你搞砸的事情，現在正要挽回，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
......

[Isaac]
By the way, ^0000cdisn't it your box^000000, sister? It was on the table while there are a bunch of people hanging out. I kept it not to get it lost.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
順便問一下，^0000cd這不是你的盒子嗎^000000？剛才桌上放著，旁邊還有一群人。我把它收起來，怕它丟了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
This... ^0000cdWas it you who had taken it^000000?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這個... ^0000cd是你拿走的嗎^000000？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You should have let me know when you were taking it. Do you know how much trouble I have been through for this?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你拿走的時候應該告訴我。你知道我為了找它費了多少勁嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Wait, this is unfair! No? I have taken it with me for your sake, sister.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
等等，這不公平！不是嗎？我把它帶在身上是為了你好，妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
You know how our father gets furious if anything goes missing in our house!
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你知道如果家裡丟了什麼東西，父親會發多大的火！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
He would go on and on about how we don't need a person who cannot manage even a small thing in the Wigner family and how management skill is the greatest virtue of our family... Just think about it scares me.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
他會喋喋不休地說，維格納家族不需要連小事都管不好的人，還說管理能力是我們家族最大的美德...光是想想我就害怕。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What is in there? Why did you fuss about it so much?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
裡面是什麼？你為什麼那麼在意？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
There is nothing which is considered valuable by others in it. However, it is the most precious thing to me. Look.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
裡面沒有別人認為值錢的東西。但是，這是對我最珍貴的東西。看看。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
A note?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
一張紙條？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
A diary?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
一本日記？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It is better to avoid a futile conversation. If you don't talk, you don't make mistakes. However, there are moments that you want to be honest with yourself.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
與其進行無意義的對話，不如保持沉默。不說話就不會犯錯。但是，總有些時刻，你希望對自己誠實。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
This diary has been capturing the moments that I want be true to myself.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
這本日記記錄了我想要對自己誠實的那些時刻。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Nevertheless, I still am mistaken by others even I stay quiet. I guess silence has not been the best policy after all. Since I have my diary back, I should get going.
Dear adventurer, please excuse me for all the trouble.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
儘管如此，即使我保持沉默，別人還是會誤解我。看來沉默並不是最好的策略。既然拿回了日記，我該走了。
親愛的冒險者，抱歉給您添麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, I...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
姐姐，我...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
That's all right now. I'll forget it all. You don't have to care about it either.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
沒關係。我會忘記這一切的。你也不用放在心上。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
She walks so fast. What was it all about?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
她走得真快。剛才到底是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It's all because you have taken the box without a word... Phew... Well, long story short, our sister is upset.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
都怪你一聲不吭就拿走了那個盒子...呼...簡單來說，姐姐很生氣。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Argh! Why is she upset?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
啊！她為什麼生氣？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It is complicated. I guess there are some bad rumors about her out there.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
情況很複雜。我想外面流傳著一些關於她的壞話。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, I have heard about it before. However, I thought you would take care of it since it is mainly your fault.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
哦，我聽說過。不過我以為你會處理好的，畢竟主要是你的錯。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You knew about that? Why didn't you tell me about it?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你知道那件事？為什麼不告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Even if I did, you wouldn't have taken it seriously. It is true that you were born with that blessed looks.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
就算告訴你，你也不會當回事。確實，你天生就擁有那令人羨慕的容貌。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
That's why the people around you have looked up to you. Not that our parents have been hard on us. No wonder you have grown up to be so carefree.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
所以周圍的人都很仰慕你。並不是說父母對我們很嚴厲。難怪你長得這麼無憂無慮。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you picking up a fight with me?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你想跟我吵架嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
No, listen to me. I am telling the truth here. No hard feelings.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
不，聽我說。我在說真話。別往心裡去。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Due to your superlative looks, we have been quite disadvantaged, growing up.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
因為你那出眾的容貌，我們在成長過程中其實處於劣勢。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Do you remember what our sister has said? How the darkest shadow is always right next to the brightest light? It is true.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你還記得姐姐說過什麼嗎？最黑暗的陰影總是在最明亮的光旁邊。這是真的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I don't get it. Beauty is a good thing. Everyone likes it.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我不明白。美貌是好事。大家都喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
The people who see it may appreciate it. However, the people right next to it are being compared to it.
Among the three of us, it must have been the hardest for our sister.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
看到它的人可能會欣賞它。但是緊挨著它的人會被拿來比較。
在我們三兄妹中，姐姐一定是最難熬的。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Imagine a plain person standing next to an angelic beauty. Despite looking completely normal, she or he would look unattractive and somber. We have been compared to you like that, all our lives.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
想像一下，一個普通人站在天使般的美人旁邊。儘管看起來完全正常，但他或她會顯得醜陋而陰沉。我們一生都被這樣與你比較。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Our sister must have suffered from the stress even more. She has managed to endure it with her extraordinary patience and generosity. In fact, I think she could be an angel.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
姐姐一定承受了更大的壓力。她憑藉非凡的耐心和寬容堅持了下來。事實上，我覺得她簡直就是一位天使。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I didn't know that... At all..
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我完全不知道... 一點都不知道...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What should I do now?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我現在該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I don't think it is entirely your fault. It was our parents who have created you like that.
Oh, well, you are to blame for your carefreeness though.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我覺得這不完全是你的錯。是我們父母把你創造成這樣的。
不過，你確實要為你的粗心大意負責。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Anyway, who we need to worry about is our sister. Has she ever been mad at us? What should we do when she is upset?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
總之，我們需要擔心的是姐姐。她曾經生過我們的氣嗎？當她難過的時候，我們應該怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well, she has been mad at me once when I was young.
I guess it was somewhat similar to what has just happened. She said something about comparison then...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯，我小時候她生過我的氣。
我想那和剛才發生的事有點類似。當時她說了些關於比較的話...

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I was too young to remember it. However, I do remember how our sister became very quiet after arguing with you.
You have been the main culprit of it after all.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我當時太小，不記得了。但我記得和你吵完架後，姐姐變得非常沉默。
畢竟，你是主要的原因。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It is not the time to waste time to distinguish between right and wrong. What should we do, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
現在不是分辨是非對錯的時候。親愛的冒險者，我們該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know. Have you ever tried to countervail someone's anger?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道。你試過化解別人的怒氣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
No. No one's ever been mad at me, except our sister.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
沒有。除了姐姐，從來沒有人對我發過火。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, please help us out here.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，請幫幫我們吧。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Leave me out of it. I wasn't the one who got her mad.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
別把我扯進來。又不是我惹她生氣的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You were the cause of the problem.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你才是問題的根源。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I was trying to keep it safe... Please, dear adventurer, help us!
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我只是想保護它... 求你了，親愛的冒險者，幫幫我們！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What can you do? You'd better wait until your sister lets off steam... Or, you could try giving her something she likes...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你能做什麼？你最好等姐姐發洩完情緒... 或者，你可以試著送她一些她喜歡的東西...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What doesn't she like? Do you know?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她不喜歡什麼？你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I know as much as you do.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我和你一樣，什麼都不知道。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Which means you know nothing, great!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
也就是說你什麼都不知道，真棒！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She seems to value experiences and memories. Don't you have any good memories with her? Trace back your memory back a little.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她似乎很珍視經歷和回憶。你們和她之間沒有美好的回憶嗎？試著回憶一下過去。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hum... Hum... There's no such... Wait! Yes, I remember one!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯... 嗯... 沒有這樣的... 等等！我想起來了！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
What? Is there any?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
什麼？有嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Do you remember how we walked around the Comodo beach together during the summer vacation? We picked up some pretty stones on the shore and in the cave.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你還記得嗎？暑假的時候，我們一起在克魔島的海灘散步。我們在岸邊和洞穴裡撿了一些漂亮的石頭。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Our sister really liked...This clear stone containing some sea water and a piece of coral inside.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我們的姐姐特別喜歡...這塊清澈的石頭，裡面封存著海水和一片珊瑚。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
The Sea Stone?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
大海之石？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Yes, that's it! She lined up those stones near the window and enjoyed looking at them glittering in the sun.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
是的，就是它！她把那些石頭擺在窗邊，喜歡看著它們在陽光下閃閃發光。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, I remember now. I remember seeing them glittering in her room.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
哦，我想起來了。我記得看到它們在她房間裡閃閃發光。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The ^0000cdSea Stone^000000? What is it?

[Jurgen]
It is a pretty stone which can only be found in Comodo. It is called the Sea Stone because it looks as if there is the sea captured inside of it, with the sea water and corals.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那是一種只能在克魔島找到的漂亮石頭。因為它看起來像是把大海封存在了裡面，有著海水和珊瑚，所以被稱為大海之石。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Some romantics call it, the gift from a mermaid.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
有些浪漫的人稱它為美人魚的禮物。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You may find them upon digging the ground on the Comodo beach once in a while. Our sister, Isaac and I used to dig them out whenever we are on summer vacation.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
偶爾在克魔島的海灘上挖土就能找到它們。我們姐妹和艾薩克以前每次暑假都會挖出來玩。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I have heard that it is not found on the beach these days. Instead, you can get it by killing the ^0000cdMedusa inside the cave in the west of Comodo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我聽說現在海灘上已經找不到了。相反，你需要去克魔島西邊的洞穴裡，通過擊殺^0000cd米杜沙^000000來獲得。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What? Did the Medusa take them all?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
什麼？米杜沙把它們都拿走了？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Who knows? It is supposed to be the gift from a mermaid. Some say, the Mermen have given them to the Medusa. Well, this also sounds like a fairytale.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
誰知道呢？它本該是美人魚的禮物。有人說，是海人族把它們交給了米杜沙。嗯，這也聽起來像個童話。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How do you know it so well?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你怎麼知道得這麼清楚？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I have once tried to distribute them all over the continent. You used to be able to get them by just digging the ground. Tourists used to pick them up as souvenirs or gamblers used to use them as talismans for their prayers to the sea-god.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我曾經試圖把它們分發到整個大陸。以前只要挖土就能得到。遊客們會撿走它們作為紀念品，或者賭徒們會把它們當作向海神祈禱的護身符。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Since it became hard to get them, I have given up the plan. The game is not worth the candle, having to kill the Medusa on the way.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
既然變得很難獲取，我就放棄了這個計劃。為了得到它們還得去殺米杜沙，這遊戲不值得玩。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I didn't know that. Anyway, I remember there was something else next to the stone.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我不知道這些。總之，我記得石頭旁邊還有別的東西。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
There were some flowers, a bunch of them. What flower was that? I lasted so long that it never seemed to wither at all.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
有一些花，一大束。那是哪種花？它保持了很久，看起來從來沒有枯萎過。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, do you have any idea what flower that would have been?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你知道那可能是什麼花嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If it didn't whither for so long, it could have been a Witherless Rose.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果它保持了這麼久都沒有枯萎，那可能是永恆玫瑰。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Is there such a thing? Why do you need a Witherless Rose when you can just buy another flower before the older one withers?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
有這種東西嗎？既然舊花枯萎了可以再買新的，為什麼非要永恆玫瑰呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You want what you like to last long. If you replace it with another flower, it is not the same flower you liked anymore.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人總是希望喜歡的東西能長久。如果換成另一朵花，那就不是當初喜歡的那朵了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hum... Well, I guess I can imagine myself being replaced with another person. I understand it now.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯...我想，如果我被別人取代了，大概也能理解這種感覺。我現在明白了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
So, when are you going to get them for us?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那麼，你打算什麼時候去把它們弄來？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Isaac]
You didn't think that we would go there to get them ourselves, did you?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你不會以為我們會親自去弄吧？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I am busy with my business, and Jurgen attracts too many people around him.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我忙著做生意，而尤爾根身邊總是圍著太多人。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
We need someone else we can trust, who happens to be right in front of us.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我們需要一個值得信賴的人，而這個人恰好就在我們面前。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I was worried about it as well. Please, dear adventurer, help us. The loving relationship among us depends on you.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我也很擔心這件事。請幫幫我們吧，親愛的冒險者。我們姐妹間的感情就靠你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you say so... How many of them do you need? Where can I get the Sea Stone?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你們這麼說了...你們需要多少？我在哪裡能買到大海之石？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hum... I guess we need ^0000cd1 Witherless Rose^000000 and ^0000cd10 Sea Stones^000000 since we want to decorate the window with them.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯...因為我們要用它們裝飾窗戶，所以需要^0000cd1 1朵永恆玫瑰^000000和^0000cd10 10塊大海之石^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
We are depending on you.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我們就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you came! Did you bring what we asked you for? Please tell us that you did.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你來了！你帶了我們需要的東西嗎？請告訴我們你帶了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I wasn't able to bring them all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒能把它們全部帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Why? Did you forget what to bring by any chance? Let me tell you once more.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
為什麼？難道你忘了要帶什麼嗎？讓我再告訴你一次。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
^0000cd10 Sea Stones^000000. You can get them while hunting Medusa in Comodo. They are valuable because it is difficult to kill Medusa.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
^0000cd10 10塊大海之石^000000。你可以在克魔島打米杜沙時獲得。因為米杜沙很難打，所以它們很珍貴。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
And ^0000cd1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
還有^0000cd1 1朵永恆玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I know that's a lot of things to bring, but I believe we need them all to make our sister feel better.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我知道這要求有點多，但我相信我們需要集齊這些，才能讓姐姐心情好起來。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, did you bring what we asked you for? Please tell us that you did.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你帶了我們需要的東西嗎？請告訴我們你帶了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Yes, please tell us that you did. We tried our best to balance out her anger. However, she's been giving the cold shoulder to us.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
是的，請告訴我們你帶了。我們盡力安撫她的怒氣，但她一直對我們冷言冷語。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I brought them. You'd better not to press an angry person so impatiently like that, you know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我帶來了。你們知道吧，對生氣的人不要這麼急切地催促，那樣不好。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Whoa, they are all here! You saved our lives. We should call our sister now. What if she is still mad at us...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
哇，全都帶來了！你救了我們一命。我們得趕緊叫姐姐過來。萬一她還在生我們的氣怎麼辦...

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I have already called her.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我已經叫她過來了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Why do you keep calling me? Please leave me alone for that I am not mad at you any more.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你們為什麼一直叫我？請讓我一個人待會兒，我已經不生氣了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, forgive us. Please stop being mad at us.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
姐姐，原諒我們吧。請別再生我們的氣了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
...Do you know what you have done wrong?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
...你們知道自己做錯了什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I don't think I am to blame, but I am sorry that I have taken your stuff without telling you.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我覺得我不該受責備，但我很抱歉，未經你同意就拿走了你的東西。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well, I am sorry about it all. I haven't been considerate of your feelings. However, it wouldn't have hurt you to open up to me a little, since we are family.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯，這一切都是我的錯。我沒有體諒你的感受。不過，既然我們是家人，你稍微對我敞開心扉一點，也不會讓你受傷吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
If we don't be honest to each other, we will just grow away. We will get our wires crossed again.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
如果我們不坦誠相待，只會越來越疏遠。我們會再次產生誤會。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are right. I have given it a thought as well. I think some part of it is my fault. I should have been honest with you, at least.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你說得對。我也仔細想了想。我覺得有一部分是我的錯。我本該對你坦誠相告的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
When we were young, we used to talk a lot, and have some good times. Look at these. We used to run around looking for things like these. Do you remember this stone? You liked to watch them glitter in the sun.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
小時候，我們經常聊天，度過很多美好的時光。看看這些。我們以前經常到處尋找這樣的東西。你還記得這塊石頭嗎？你喜歡看它在陽光下閃閃發光。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
They are.. When did you get them...?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
這些是...你什麼時候找到的...？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
The adventurer helped us. I guess those were the times when we were the closest to one another. Look at this.
This stone is so clear that you can see the seawater and coral reef inside right through it.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
是那位冒險者幫了我們的忙。我想，那大概是我們最親密的時候了。看看這個。
這塊石頭清澈透明，透過它甚至能看到裡面的海水和珊瑚。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I think people are just the same. We don't need to show everything, but we do need to show some to let others know how pretty we are inside.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我覺得人也是一樣的。我們不需要展示一切，但我們需要展示一部分，讓別人知道我們內心有多美好。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Yes, you are right. I think you have got the point. I'll try. I'll do it to avoid any more misunderstanding.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
是的，你說得對。我想你明白了重點。我會試試的。為了避免再產生誤會，我會努力的。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
By the way, when did you learn to talk like that? I think I am finally able to talk with you guys now.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
對了，你什麼時候學會這樣說話的？我覺得我現在終於能跟你們好好說話了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You mean, you haven't been able to talk with us?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你的意思是，你以前一直沒法跟我們好好說話？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Well, thanks to my effort, we brothers and sister have become close to one another again.
Thank you for your work, dear adventurer. This is not much, but I hope you take it. Sorry about all the trouble you have been through for us.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
嗯，多虧了我的努力，我們兄妹三人又變得親密了。
謝謝你，親愛的冒險者。這點東西不多，但希望你能收下。抱歉讓你為我們費了這麼多心。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Material reward has never seems to small before.
I guess what you have done for us is just that priceless.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
物質上的獎勵似乎從未顯得如此微不足道。
我想，你為我們所做的一切，是無價的。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am sorry to cause such an embarrassing scene in front of you. If you have time, please come by again. We will make sure to receive you properly next time.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
很抱歉在你面前造成了這麼尷尬的場面。如果你有空，請再來玩。下次我們一定會好好招待你的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I have learned new lessons and earned many things, thanks to you. If you need our help, we will try to help you as much as we can. I wish you luck!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，多虧了你，我學到了新的道理，也收穫了很多。如果你需要我們的幫助，我們會盡力而為。祝你一切順利！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen, Hello?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤爾根，你好？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, dear adventurer, welcome.
Are you enjoying the banquet? Do you need any help by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
哦，親愛的冒險者，歡迎。
您正在享受宴會嗎？需要我幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. I just wanted to talk to you for a second.
I wonder how your sister is doing these days as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不用。我只是想跟你聊一會兒。
我也想知道你妹妹最近過得怎麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Thanks to your help, we have never been better than this.
I've been talking to my sister much more, and..
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
多虧了你的幫助，我們從來沒有像現在這樣好過。
我和妹妹聊天的時間多了很多，而且...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
打擾一下。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I am sorry. I thought no one was here. I just wanted to clean the room, I am really sorry. I'll come back later.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
抱歉。我以為這裡沒人。我只是想打掃房間，真的很抱歉。我稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Not at all. Please come in. It is a nonsense that you cannot clean the room because of the people inside.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
沒關係。請進。因為裡面有人就不能打掃房間，這太荒唐了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, long time no see. Sorry about the trouble you went through last time. Fortunately, the box thing has been resolved well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，好久不見。上次給你添麻煩了，很抱歉。幸好箱子的事已經順利解決了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh... Yes... I see...
Hello...
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哦...是的...我明白了...
你好...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Is this the person from the last time? Whom you asked about the box...?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這位是上次那位嗎？就是詢問箱子事情的那位...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, she is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，就是她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I am sorry about that. We were desperate and in a hurry. I apologize if you were upset by it.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
對此我很抱歉。當時我們很焦急，也很匆忙。如果讓你感到不快，我向你道歉。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Thank you for telling me that. Since I am a maid, there are people who suspect me or treat me like a thief.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
謝謝你告訴我這些。因為我是女僕，有些人會懷疑我，或者把我當成盜賊。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
However, you seem different, dear prince. I am a little surprised. I thought people who belong to the high society didn't know how to apologize.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
不過，您似乎與眾不同，親愛的王子。我有點驚訝。我以為上流社會的人不知道如何道歉。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, it was very presumptuous of me.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哦，是我太冒昧了。
對不起。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
No, that's OK.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
不，沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Then, I should get going.
I am supposed to clean the room when there is no one inside anyway. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
那麼，我該走了。
反正我本來就該在沒人的時候打掃房間。請原諒我的失禮。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You shouldn't have to... Well, she's gone...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你不必這樣... 嗯，她走了...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯，親愛的冒險者？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
Well, I think ^0000cdI have fallen in love^000000 .
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯，我想^0000cd我戀愛了^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, you have.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你戀愛了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
I have never met anyone who looks directly into my eyes like that.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我從未見過有人能那樣直視我的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I fell in love with her. I love her dignified and calm voice. Unaffected behaviors That tone of voice reflecting strong will...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我愛上了她。我愛她高貴而沉穩的聲音，她不受拘束的舉止，還有那透著堅定意志的語調...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
All the women I have seen so far are like flowers in the greenhouse. However, she resembles a wild flower in the field.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我所見過的所有女性都像溫室裡的花朵。然而，她更像田野裡的野生花。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She is totally different from the ladies I have met before.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她與我以前遇到的女士們完全不同。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! How can I tell someone I have fallen in love at first sight how I feel? Should I go take her hands and say I love her?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者！我該如何向這位一見鍾情的姑娘表達我的心意？我應該去牽起她的手，告訴她我愛她嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? You don't know anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？你對此一無所知？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She is my ^0000cdfirst love^000000. My life will never be the same since I have met her.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她是我的^0000cd初戀^000000。自從我遇見她，我的人生將不再相同。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum... Try to remember what all the people outside the door have done to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯... 試著回憶一下門外那些人對您做過什麼。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well... Nothing that I can recall... Hum... There have been some impressive people though. There was this person who penetrated defense and hid behind the curtain in my room...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯... 我想不起來有什麼... 嗯... 不過確實有一些令人印象深刻的人。有一個人突破了防禦，躲在我房間的窗簾後面...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum... That's impressive. However, it is a crime. You should forget it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯... 那確實令人印象深刻。不過，那是犯罪行為。您應該忘掉它。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
There was this person who sent me a life-size golden statue. I sent it back since I didn't need it and it didn't look as good as real me.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
還有一個人給我寄了一尊真人大小的金像。我把它退回了，因為我不需要它，而且它看起來沒有我本人好看。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How about sending her a gold statue looking exactly like me?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那送給她一尊完全像我的金像怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She will be repelled if you try too hard like that from the very beginning. How about sending her a ^0000cdletter^000000 with a small gift?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一開始就那樣過分熱情，她會被嚇跑的。不如送給她一封^0000cd信件^000000和一份小禮物？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It is a good idea! Please wait a moment!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這是個好主意！請稍等片刻！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? Wait for what?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？等什麼？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Did you forget? If I take a step out of that door, I'll draw attention.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
您忘了嗎？如果我邁出那扇門，就會引起注意。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It would cause her trouble, wouldn't it. By the way, I didn't even get the chance to ask her what her name was.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那會給她帶來麻煩，不是嗎。順便說一句，我甚至沒機會問她的名字。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send this letter to her with this box containing jewelry.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請把這封信和這個裝有珠寶的盒子一起送給她。

scripts.text: OK.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: It will be difficult.
scripts.translation: 這會很困難。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It will be difficult. I have other things to do.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這會很困難。我還有其他事情要做。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sorry about the difficult request. I guess I should go there myself. You may be able to see the news that the heir of the Wigner family has been crushed to death by his followers on Daily Rune-Midgarts tomorrow morning.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
抱歉提出了這麼困難的要求。看來我還是得親自去一趟。明天早上，您或許能在《盧恩·米德加茲日報》上看到維格納家族繼承人被信徒們壓死的新聞。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Or, the poor maid could be hospitalized by tomorrow. Anyway, I understand.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
或者，那位可憐的女僕明天就會住院。總之，我理解您的處境。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. I should get going then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。那我這就出發。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! I've been waiting for you. How did it go? Has she said she loves me too?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者！我一直在等您。事情怎麼樣了？她也說喜歡我嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I haven't been able to meet her yet. Let me go see her again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我還沒能見到她。讓我再去看看她吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! I've been waiting for you.
How did it go? Has she said she loves me too?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者！我一直在等您。
事情怎麼樣了？她也說喜歡我嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, actually... She ^0000cdturned it down^000000. She returned what you had sent her as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，其實...她^0000cd拒絕了^000000。她還把您送的東西都退了回來。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She turned me down?
Why? Did she say that she didn't like my looks? Or wasn't what I had sent her enough for her?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她拒絕了我？
為什麼？是因為她覺得我長得不好看嗎？還是我送的東西不夠好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, not that... She has said she is currently not in the situation to go out with someone. She seems to have a reason.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，不是那樣...她說目前的情況不適合談戀愛。她似乎有她的理由。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Does she already have a boyfriend? I am not surprised. She is so attractive after all. No wonder I have fallen for her.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她已經有男朋友了？我並不驚訝。畢竟她那麼迷人。難怪我會被她迷住。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, not that either... She just has said she is currently not in the situation to date someone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，也不是那樣...她只是說目前的情況不適合談戀愛。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Whoa... ^0000cdIt is my first time to want something so badly in this life^000000. Never did I know that it would be so difficult to get.
Is living such a difficult thing?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
天哪...^0000cd這是我人生中第一次如此渴望得到某樣東西^000000。我從不知道得到它竟然這麼難。
生活難道這麼艱難嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
However, my father has told me that I should always try at least three times.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
不過，我父親曾告訴我，凡事至少要嘗試三次。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
First try to begin, second try to confirm and the third try to give up since it is not meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
第一次嘗試是為了開始，第二次嘗試是為了確認，第三次嘗試則是為了放棄，因為那並非命中註定。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
So, dear adventurer. Please do this one more time for me.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
所以，親愛的冒險者。請再為我做這一次吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I think you should write the letter again...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我想您應該重新寫封信...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I need something special. Something pretty and shiny which reflects my feelings...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我需要一些特別的東西。一些美麗且閃閃發光的東西，能映照出我的心意...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
The Sea Stone! And flower!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
大海之石！還有花兒！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
I want to send her ^0000cdthe heart that is as wide and beautiful as the sea^000000 and ^0000cdthe amaranthine heart for her^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我想送給她^0000cd如大海般廣闊美麗的心^000000，以及^0000cd為她綻放的永恆之心^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I go get them all myself as well?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難道我也要親自去把它們都弄來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please, dear adventurer, be the messenger of love for me. Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，請做我的愛之信使吧。請替我送出這顆比大海更廣闊、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you say so, I'll do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你都這麼說了，那我就去做吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send her my letter with ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請把我的信連同^0000cd15顆大海之石和1朵永恆玫瑰^000000一起送給她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
As I told you before, you can get the Sea Stone from killing Medusa.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
正如我之前所說，大海之石可以通過擊敗米杜沙獲得。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I will never forget this and make it up to you. We, Wigners, never forget any debt.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，我絕不會忘記這份恩情，並會加倍報答。我們維格納家族，從不忘記任何債務。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not that I am doing it expecting something in return, but I will deliver them to her since you look so desperate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可不是為了回報才這麼做的，但看你這麼焦急，我就替你把它們送給她吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Thank you! Oh, do you happen to get her name by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
謝謝你！哦，你碰巧知道她的名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mary, her name is Mary.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
瑪麗，她的名字叫瑪麗。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
^0000cdMary^000000. It is a common but pretty name. What is common means that it is well loved by many people. I'll get all my things embroidered with this name from now on.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
^0000cd瑪麗^000000。這是一個普通卻美麗的名字。普通意味著它被許多人喜愛。從今以後，我要在所有東西上都繡上這個名字。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you may set off now. Please deliver my feelings to her safely.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，您可以出發了。請安全地將我的心意送達她手中。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Did you deliver my heart to Mary safely? You have come back so early.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你安全地把我的心意送到瑪麗那裡了嗎？你回來得真快。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Have you forgotten what you have to bring with you?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你忘記要帶什麼東西了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You need to bring ^0000cd15 Sea Stones which you can get from killing Medusa and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你需要帶上^0000cd15顆可以通過擊敗米杜沙獲得的大海之石，以及1朵永恆玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Mary wouldn't feel uncomfortable if I express my feelings with ordinary things like these, right? Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
用這些普通的東西表達心意，瑪麗應該不會覺得不自在吧？請替我送出這顆比大海更廣闊、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! You are back!
I couldn't stop thinking about her even while you were gone.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者！你回來了！
你不在的時候，我滿腦子都是她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Even when I eat, drink a tea, look into the mirror and talking to other people! I though about her all day. It was painful but I was in a flutter.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
無論是吃飯、喝茶、照鏡子還是和別人說話！我整天都在想她。雖然很痛苦，但我心裡卻像長了翅膀一樣興奮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's what falling in love is like.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這就是戀愛的感覺吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, then I must have been doing bad things to numerous people. There is nothing I can do for them.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
哦，那我一定對很多人做過不好的事。我無以為報。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
By the way, since your hands are empty, I guess she has accepted my heart at last!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
順便說一句，既然你兩手空空，看來她終於接受我的心意了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, hum... She didn't react negatively, but you'd better be careful since you don't know each other yet.
Why don't you spare her some time?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...她雖然沒有表現出反感，但你們還不太熟，所以最好小心一點。
不如給她一點時間？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She must have not accepted my heart completely then. I am all right though! She hasn't turned me down yet!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
看來她還沒有完全接受我的心意。不過沒關係！她還沒有拒絕我！

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I didn't know how painful it was to love someone. I did know how I would be fidgety about a word or gesture of her.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我以前不知道愛一個人會這麼痛苦。我知道我會因為她的一個詞或一個動作而心神不寧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is true. Winning someone's heart is the hardest thing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
確實如此。贏得一個人的心是最難的事。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I guess I should be nicer to the people who like me.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我想我應該對喜歡我的人好一點。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think that is a good idea...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得這不是個好主意...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, thank you again. Would you come by again tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，再次感謝你。明天你還會來嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
It seems like a good sign. Paddle as the wave approaches. That's one of the many mottos of our family.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這似乎是個好兆頭。趁波浪來臨時划槳。這是我們家的格言之一。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I want to let her know of my blazing heart every day.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我想每天讓她知道我這顆火熱的心。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I have a feeling that everything will turn out great if you send it for me.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我感覺如果你替我送出去，一切都會很好的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How about allowing her some time?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不如給她一點時間？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What if she forgets about me? Then, please send her my message once a day. You wouldn't say no, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
萬一她把我忘了怎麼辦？那麼，請每天替我給她送一次訊息。你不會拒絕吧？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, I almost forgot. It is not much, but please accept this as my token of gratitude for the messenger of my love.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
哦，我差點忘了。雖然不多，但請收下這個，作為對我這位愛情信使的感謝。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I'll see you tomorrow then!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那明天見！

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Did you deliver my heart to Mary safely? You have come back so early.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你安全地把我的心意送到瑪麗那裡了嗎？你回來得真快。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Have you forgotten what you have to bring with you?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你忘記要帶什麼東西了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You need to bring ^0000cd15 Sea Stones which you can get from killing Medusa and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你需要帶上^0000cd15顆可以通過擊敗米杜沙獲得的大海之石，以及1朵永恆玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Mary wouldn't feel uncomfortable if I express my feelings with ordinary things like these, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
瑪麗不會因為我用這些普通的東西表達感情而感到不自在吧？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請替我把這顆比大海還寬廣、永不枯萎的心送給她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I'd like to call you who has delivered my message of love to her, the ^0000cdMessenger of Love^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，我想稱呼你這位替我傳遞愛意的人為^0000cd愛情信使^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please don't...

[Jurgen]
^0000cdCupid of Love^000000...

[{0}]
Please stop it.

[Jurgen]
On the day Mary accepts my feelings, I would like to give you a huge pure gold statue.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
當瑪麗接受我的心意時，我想送您一座巨大的純金雕像。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You really don't have to do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您真的不必這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
However, this is the only thing I can offer you for now. Please visit our manor later. There are some real valuable things.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
不過，這是我目前唯一能送給您的東西。請稍後參觀我們的莊園，那裡有一些真正珍貴的物品。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Then dear adventurer, I'll see you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那麼，親愛的冒險者，我們明天再見。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, what brought you here around this time? May I help you?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，這個時間您來這裡有什麼事嗎？需要我幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you here to deliver my message of love to Mary?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
您是來替我把愛意傳達給瑪麗的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, well, it was you who had said that she would be repelled by my impatience.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
哦，原來是你說過她會因我的急躁而感到反感。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I am trying hard not to send her my love letter every minute and second. Please comeback when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我正在努力剋制自己，不每分鐘、每秒都給她寫情書。請等到時機成熟時再來。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you came! It seems that something good may happen today.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你來了！看來今天可能會發生好事。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please deliver her the message of my love with deliver my message of love with ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請替我把愛意傳達給她，並附上^0000cd15顆大海之石和1朵永恆玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Do you remember? You can get the Sea Stone by killing Medusa.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你記得嗎？可以通過擊敗米杜沙獲得大海之石。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send them to her and tell me how Mary is doing today. I am sad that she doesn't come here to clean the room anymore.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請把這些送給她，並告訴我瑪麗今天過得怎麼樣。她不再來這裡打掃房間了，這讓我很難過。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I want to go see her myself. However, I guess she will feel uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我想親自去見她。不過，我想她可能會感到不自在。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I am depending on you!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，我就拜託你了！

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, we are honored to have you with us. Have you met our father who is the head of the Wigner family?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
親愛的冒險者，很榮幸能與您相遇。您見過我們維格納家族的族長，也就是我的父親嗎？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
How about meeting Jurgen, the hair of the Wigner family who is participating in the Royal Assembly?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
要不要見見尤爾根？他是維格納家族的族長，目前正在參加皇家議會。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Then, have a comfortable time in the Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
那麼，祝您在維格納家族度過愉快的時光。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am over!
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我走了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, please calm down. Where did you put it? Are you sure you have left it here?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
姐姐，請冷靜一下。你把它放在哪裡了？你確定把它留在這裡了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Here, I have left it right here! After talking to the adventurer, I put it here and... It was gone... Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
就在這裡，我明明把它放在這裡了！跟冒險者說完話後我就放這兒了...怎麼不見了...它去哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What did you lose?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們弄丟了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
My jewelry box... Well, it is technically not a jewelry box since it doesn't hold any jewelry in it, but anyways, ^0000cda small box containing something very important is missing.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我的寶石盒...雖然嚴格來說它裡面並沒有裝珠寶，但總之，^0000cd一個裝著非常重要東西的小盒子不見了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I took it out of my bag and out it here. Then it was gone. What should I do? I don't know what I should do without it... I cannot afford to let anyone see it...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我從包裡拿出來放在這裡，然後它就不見了。我該怎麼辦？沒有它我真的不知道該怎麼辦...我不能讓任何人看到它...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It could be the ^0000cdmaid^000000 who came here earlier to clean the room. She may have taken it.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
可能是剛才來打掃房間的^0000cda女僕^000000。也許是拿走了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You haven't seen her taking it. You shouldn't doubt other people without proof.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你並沒有看到她拿走。在沒有證據的情況下，不應該懷疑別人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not that I am suspicious of her, but it may help to ask her. If she saw it or when was the last time she saw it...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是懷疑她，但問問她也許有幫助。比如她是否看到了，或者最後一次看到是什麼時候...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Please don't. She would be upset if she feels that she is being suspected.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
請不要這樣。如果她覺得被懷疑了，會很難過的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
But you are being so nervous. Isn't it an important thing to you?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
但你這麼緊張。這對你們來說很重要嗎？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It is, but...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
是的，但是...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You really need to get it back, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你真的很想把它找回來，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are right, but...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你說得對，但是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll make sure to ask her about it as politely as possible. Please relax and wait here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會盡量禮貌地問她。請放鬆，在這裡等一下。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I don't know if is the best idea. I don't want her to feel that we are suspecting her.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我不確定這是個好主意。我不想讓她覺得我們在懷疑她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Just wait until the adventurer comes back. The adventurer is really experienced in this kind of stuff.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
就等冒險者回來吧。冒險者在這種事情上很有經驗。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Should I...
Then, please help me, dear adventurer. I'll go search other pleases then.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我應該...
那麼，請幫幫我，親愛的冒險者。我去其他地方找找看。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please, help her. I have heard that ^0000cdthe maids are in the kitchen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請幫幫她。我聽說^0000cda女僕們在廚房^000000。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Oh, what should I do?
I should have taken better care of it...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
哦，我該怎麼辦？
我應該更小心保管的...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Please make sure not to hurt other people's feelings.
I would like to go find it myself, but I am not in the situation to do that...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
請務必不要傷害別人的感情。
我想自己去找，但我現在的狀況不允許...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I don't even want to imagine anyone else sees it though...
I would be embarrassed to death.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我甚至不敢想像別人看到它...
我會尷尬到死的。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Please leave me alone now!
Ah, it was you, dear adventurer. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
請讓我一個人待會兒！
啊，是你啊，親愛的冒險者。請原諒我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your feeling must have been hurt by your brothers.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您的感情一定被您的兄弟們傷害了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It is not that.
I am... I am just angry at myself.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
不是這樣的。
我...我只是生自己的氣。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Something like this never would have happened if was more careful...
Moreover, I shouldn't have said such things to my brothers either.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
如果我更小心一點，這種事根本不會發生...
而且，我也不該對兄弟們說那樣的話。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
However, I couldn't take it anymore when I heard the rumors and Jurgen's attitude...
I thought I was used to those things... I guess I am not.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
但是，當我聽到那些謠言，看到尤爾根的態度時，我真的無法忍受了...
我以為我已經習慣了那些事...看來我並沒有。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I should have given it up by now...
Oh, I am sorry. I believe you haven't come here to listen to a story like this.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我本該早就放棄的...
啊，對不起。我想您來這裡不是為了聽這種故事的。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am sorry, but I want to be alone for now.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
對不起，我現在想一個人待一會兒。
拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Thanks to you, we have become closer to one another now.
Now I can open up to my brothers more.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
多虧了你，我們現在彼此更親近了。
現在我可以向兄弟們敞開心扉了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I have tried to hide my feelings and save my words. However, I have realized that It is not the best policy.
From now own, I am going to tell them how I feel to avoid any misunderstanding.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我一直試圖隱藏我的感情，保留我的話語。但我意識到這並不是最好的做法。
從現在開始，我會告訴他們我的感受，以避免任何誤解。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
親愛的冒險者，謝謝您。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I believe I haven't met you before. Are you here to see my father?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我想我之前沒見過您。您是來見我父親的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
My father is over there.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我父親在那邊。

scripts.text:
[Isaac Wigner]
Dear adventurer, do you know the old saying that the emptier it is, the more you can fill it?
It is one of the many aphorisms passing down in our family.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克·維格納]
親愛的冒險者，您知道那句老話嗎？越空，越能裝得下更多？
這是我們家族代代相傳的許多格言之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, Isaac Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，艾薩克·維格納。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, welcome, dear adventurer, my brother is over there...
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
哦，歡迎，親愛的冒險者，我哥哥在那邊...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. I am here to see you, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不。我是來見您的，艾薩克。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Is it about Wolf?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
是關於狼的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. How did you know it...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。你怎麼知道...？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Wolf is not here even after the time he has promised. He is the man of his word. Something must have happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
狼已經過了他承諾的時間還沒來。他是言出必行的人。一定發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I never expected you would come here instead though. So is he cancelling the appointment today then?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我沒想到您會來這裡。那麼，他是取消今天的約定了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, he is. And he asked me to get ^0000cda certain thing^000000 from you, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，他取消了。他讓我向您，艾薩克，取^0000cda某樣東西^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
That thing...? Wolf must trust you, dear adventurer. Or it could be...
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那件東西...？狼一定很信任你，親愛的冒險者。或者那可能是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Some kind of a test.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
某種考驗。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Don't take it the wrong way. I am just be careful. In order to do what I do, I need to know who I can trust first.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
別誤會。我只是想謹慎一點。為了做我所做的事，我必須先知道誰是可以信任的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
You can bring it to Wolf. Please be careful with it.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你可以把它交給狼。請小心保管。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
May I ask you for one more thing? I have heard that there is ^0000cda strange rumor^000000 circulating in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我還能再拜託你一件事嗎？我聽說普隆德拉正在流傳^0000cda奇怪的謠言^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It is supposed to be about ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000. Would you investigate about the rumor and let me know the truth?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
據說那是關於^0000cd赫爾穆特·羅根伯格^000000的。你能調查一下這個謠言，並告訴我真相嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Since I have a reputation to keep. I cannot afford to have a scandal. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
因為我要維護自己的名聲。我不能讓醜聞發生。請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那麼，請原諒我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Have you deliver the thing to Wolf safely? You should be careful with it since it can be dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你安全地把那件東西交給狼了嗎？因為它可能很危險，所以你要小心。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
And, don't forget to ask about the rumor as well.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
還有，別忘了詢問關於那個謠言的事。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那麼，請原諒我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, you are back. Did you deliver the thing safely? What did he say about the rumor?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
親愛的冒險者，你回來了。你安全地把那件東西交給他了嗎？他對那個謠言說了什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here is the document about that. Here... It was. Wait, I must have forget to bring it with me. I am sorry. I'll be back with it soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是關於那件事的檔案。在這裡...它應該是...等等，我好像忘了帶在身上。對不起。我很快就會帶著它回來。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Such things happen. Take your time. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
這種事難免會發生。慢慢來。我會等你的。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, you are back. Did you deliver the thing safely? What did he say about the rumor?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
親愛的冒險者，你回來了。你安全地把那件東西交給他了嗎？他對那個謠言說了什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here is the ^0000cddocument^000000 about it. It is written by Wolf Roegenburg himself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是關於它的^0000cd檔案^000000。是沃爾夫·羅根伯格本人寫的。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Let's see... Hum... So the new business will be delayed indefinitely. The direction of the business will be changed.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
讓我看看...嗯...所以新的業務將無限期推遲。業務的方向將會改變。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I'll see you again after taking care of the matters. - W. R.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
處理完這些事情後，我會再與你見面。- W. R.

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It means that he would stop the deal about the war, right? The rumor must have been quite threatening.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
這意味著他會停止關於戰爭的交易，對嗎？那個謠言一定很令人擔憂。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I feel sorry. It would have been a great chance for me to impress my family.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
真遺憾。那本來是我向家人證明自己的大好機會。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Well, I believe Wolf would find a better direction to the business. Please tell Wolf that I support his decision. And that I am excited about his new business.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
好吧，我相信狼會找到更好的業務方向。請告訴狼，我支援他的決定。並且我對他的新業務感到興奮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我會的。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那麼，請原諒我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It is a shame.
It was a great opportunity for me and Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
真遺憾。
這對我和狼來說本是個絕佳的機會。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
However, since my partner wants to quit, I shouldn't force him to carry on with it.
I believe that Wolf must already have the plan about the next business item in his mind.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
不過，既然我的搭檔想退出，我不應該強迫他繼續。
我相信狼心裡一定已經有了下一個生意的計劃。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
That's why I accepted his suggestion to be partners in business.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
所以我才接受了他合夥做生意的建議。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那麼，請原諒我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, since you are here to the Wigner family, why don't you go meet some other members of the family?
Like my parents, my brother who is the candidate to the throne or my sister who is the eldest child.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
親愛的冒險者，既然你來到了維格納家族，何不順便見見家族的其他成員呢？
比如我的父母，作為王位候選人的哥哥，還有作為長女的姐姐。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I believe that you would have more productive time with them.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我相信和他們相處，你會度過更有意義的時間。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, did you bring what I had asked you?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
親愛的冒險者，你帶了我讓你帶的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I'd like to go get them myself or ask other people to do it. But, I feel a little uncomfortable since it is a family matter.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我想自己去拿，或者拜託別人去。但畢竟是家事，我覺得有點不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I know how it is troubling you, but please help us. You have not forgotten what to bring, have you?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我知道這讓你很困擾，但請幫幫我們。你沒有忘記要帶什麼吧？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
You need to bring ^0000cd10 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你需要帶^0000cd10個大海之石和1朵永恆玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Our fate depends on you! We may be able to get along again or we may become distant.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我們的命運就掌握在你手中了！我們可能會重歸於好，也可能從此疏遠。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please bring them to us as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
請儘快把它們帶過來！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Thanks to you, my brother and sister have become close to each other again.
What would they do without me?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
多虧了你，我的哥哥和姐姐又變得親密了。
要是沒有我，他們會怎麼樣呢？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, I'll see you around then.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
親愛的冒險者，那我們就改天再見吧。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Is it your first time to visit the Wigner family?
Then, ^0000cdyou should meet our parents^000000 over there first.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
這是你第一次來維格納家族嗎？
那麼，^0000cd你應該先去那邊見見我們的父母^000000。

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
Jurgen, you are mine!
scripts.translation:
[婦女們]
尤爾根，你是我的！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
I couldn't shake hands with Jurgen! Oh, it's too hot!
scripts.translation:
[單身漢]
我沒能和尤爾根握手！噢，太燙了！

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, you shouldn't bring too much stuff in here.
As you see there are a lot of fragile things.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
噢，你不應該帶這麼多東西進來。
你看，這裡有很多易碎品。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
You need to leave some out. It would be a big problem if the bundle touches the dishes and breaks them.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
你得留一些在外面。如果包裹碰到餐具把它們打碎了，那就成大問題了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I am cleaning the kitchen now, which is the hardest place to clean. It is really difficult to get rid of all the dirt in here.
My arms are way too weak to handle it.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
我現在正在打掃廚房，這是最難打掃的地方。要把這裡所有的汙垢都清除掉真的很難。
我的手臂太弱了，根本應付不來。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I happen to see someone with a strong set of arms... Those arms... What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
我正好看到一個人有著強壯的手臂...那手臂...是什麼把你帶到這裡的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am the adventurer invited to the royal banquet. Are you the maid who have cleaned the Wigner residence this afternoon?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是受邀參加皇家宴會的冒險者。你就是今天下午打掃維格納宅邸的女僕嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes, I am. What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
是的，就是我。有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you happen to see ^0000cda small box^000000 in the Wigner residence? It was supposed to be on the table next to the bed. The box belongs to Princess Katrin. Have you seen it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你剛才有沒有看到^0000cd一個小盒子^000000？它原本應該放在床邊的桌子上。那個盒子屬於卡特琳公主。你有看到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes, I have. It was the box which looked simple but classy. I held it up for a second to clean the table and put it down. I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
看到了。那個盒子看起來雖然樸素，但很有格調。我剛才為了擦桌子把它拿起來看了一眼，然後放回去了。我記得很清楚。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you see it there when you leave the room? Wasn't there anyone else in the room?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你離開房間的時候看到它還在嗎？房間裡還有別人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Wait a moment. I know where you are getting with this. We, maids, often get into a situation like this.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
等一下。我知道你想說什麼了。我們女僕經常遇到這種情況。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Isn't the box missing and are you ^0000cdsuspecting the maid who has cleaned the room^000000? Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
是不是盒子不見了，而你^0000cd懷疑是打掃房間的女僕拿的^000000？我猜得對嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am not suspecting you. I am just ^0000cdasking you about the situation^000000 to track the box.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒有懷疑你。我只是^0000cd詢問一下情況^000000，以便找到那個盒子。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
With an element of suspicion in your mind, right?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
雖然嘴上這麼說，但心裡還是有點懷疑吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I am not suspecting you. Please don't get me wrong. I am just asking you when you have seen it and if there haven't been anyone else there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我沒有懷疑你。請不要誤會。我只是想問問你最後一次看到它是什麼時候，以及當時有沒有其他人。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Ha, you are not being honest with me. If I say that there was no one around, I would be suspected, right?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哈，你對我不夠誠實。如果我說當時沒人，那豈不是更可疑了？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I can tell you this one though. I didn't take it. If you ask me if there was anyone in the room, well...
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
不過我可以告訴你這一點：我沒有拿。如果你問房間裡有沒有人...嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There was someone in the room, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
房間裡有人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Was there? This kitchen is too messy that I cannot think straight. ^0000cdI may be able to recall if it is cleaned up^000000.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
有人嗎？這廚房太亂了，我腦子都轉不過來了。^0000cd如果把它清理乾淨，我可能就能想起來了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, the kitchen is messy and so are the thoughts inside my head. Oh, how dirty and messy!
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
噢，廚房很亂，我腦子裡也很亂。噢，真是又髒又亂！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I help you clean up?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以幫你一起打掃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, would you do that for me? I would be so grateful. Here is a ^0000cdPoring Scrub Sponge^000000, please scrub every inch of this place clean.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
噢，你願意幫我嗎？那我太感激了。這是一塊^0000cd波利擦洗海綿^000000，請用它把這裡每個角落都擦乾淨。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Since it is a specially-maid Scrub Sponge, it serves multiple purposes. It coaches you on how to clean so make good use of it.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
因為這是特製的擦洗海綿，所以有很多用途。它會指導你如何清潔，請好好利用它。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
You may be surprised by it, but it is a safe Scrub Sponge which doesn't hurt others. Don't worry.
It is a Scrub Sponge developed by a legendary figure.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
你可能會驚訝，但這是一種安全的擦洗海綿，不會傷害別人。別擔心。
它是由一位傳奇人物發明的。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, wait! You know, there is a certain protocol when it comes to cleaning. You first need to wipe off the mold on the wall. Then you have to clean up the grease. The last thing for you to do is cleaning the floor.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
噢，等等！你知道的，清潔是有講究的。首先你需要擦掉牆上的黴菌。然後要清理油汙。最後才是清潔地板。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Have you finished it already?
It doesn't seem so. The thoughts in my head haven't cleared up yet.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
你已經打掃完了嗎？
看起來不像啊。我腦子裡的思緒還沒理清呢。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I think I would be able to recall when you come back after cleaning the kitchen with the Scrub Sponge I have given you.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
我想，等你用我給你的擦洗海綿把廚房打掃乾淨回來，我就能想起來了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Wow... The kitchen has become so clean! You really need to clean the grease with a strong set of arms!
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哇...廚房變得好乾淨！清理油汙確實需要一雙有力的手臂呢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Argh... My arms... Was there anyone else in the room?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...我的手臂...剛才房間裡還有別人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
You must know what kind of family that is. It is the wealthiest family in Rune-Midgarts. Despite being a temporary residence, the room was decorated with so much care.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
你應該知道那是什麼樣的家庭。那是盧恩·米德加茲最富有的家族。雖然只是臨時住所，但房間佈置得如此精心。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
All the gorgeous pieces of furniture and carpets... I have never seen tiger skin as white and huge as that one in there.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
那些華麗的傢俱和地毯...我從未見過像那裡那樣潔白巨大的虎皮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why are you talking about the furniture all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你怎麼突然說起傢俱了？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, my, how are you going to deal with the members of the royal families with such slow wit?
Think. Why would I ^0000cdtalk about the furniture^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哎呀，你反應這麼慢，怎麼應付王室成員呢？
想想看。我為什麼要^0000cd談論傢俱^000000？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You ^0000cdcan ask the person who was delivering the furniture^000000 .

[Maid]
I cannot point it out, but I think I have given you enough clues.
By the way, is the box really missing in the first place?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
我不能直接指出來，但我覺得我已經給了你足夠的線索。
順便問一下，那個箱子真的不見了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
It is not my opinion, but there are these words people say. You know, the rumors.
Since the prince of the Wigner family looks so handsome...
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
這不是我的觀點，但人們都在這麼說。你知道的，那些謠言。
既然維格納家族的王子長得那麼英俊...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
He has been the center of the attention since he was young. People say that the lady is stressed about it and does things to draw attention.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
他從小就是眾人關注的焦點。人們說那位女士因此感到壓力很大，並做出一些引人注目的舉動。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
This could be one of her tricks, they say.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
據說這可能是她的小把戲之一。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
The words haven not been spread yet, but I am sure that everyone will be talking about it even before the teatime is over.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
這些話還沒傳開，但我確信，茶會結束前大家都會議論紛紛的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think that is true. She is not that kind of person.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不覺得是真的。她不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
That's what people say. You don't have to reason with me. Anyways, I should get back to my cleaning duty. If you are not going to help me, please leave me alone now.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
那是人們說的。你不用跟我講道理。總之，我得回去繼續打掃了。如果你不打算幫我，請現在離開。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you know where the man who have delivered the furniture is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道送傢俱的那個男人在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
