scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Did ^0000cdall royal families^000000 attend the banquet?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
^0000cd所有王室成員^000000都參加了宴會嗎？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The palace must be crowded. It is very rare that all royal families gather like this, but...
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
宮殿裡一定很擁擠。所有王室成員像這樣聚在一起是非常罕見的，但是...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I heard that there are royal families ^0000cdwho do not attend the Royal Assembly^000000. Who's that?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
我聽說有王室成員^0000cd不參加皇家議會^000000。那是誰？

scripts.text: Wigner and Heine.
scripts.translation: 維格納和海爾內

scripts.text: Roegenburg and Richard.
scripts.translation: 羅根堡和理查德

scripts.text: Geoborg and Walther.
scripts.translation: 吉奧堡和瓦爾特

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我剛才說錯了，因為想到了別的事情。
我搞錯了。你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I heard that there are royal families ^0000cdwho do not attend the Royal Assembly^000000. Who's that?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
我聽說有王室成員^0000cd不參加皇家議會^000000。那是誰？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Well, it is understandable that the Geoborg and the Walther do not attend the assembly.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
嗯，吉奧堡和瓦爾特不參加議會是合情合理的。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The family of the previous king ^0000cdbecame so due to the old curse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
前任國王的家族^0000cd因為古老的詛咒^000000才變成了這樣...

scripts.text: You mean the Nerius?
scripts.translation: 你是說內裡烏斯？

scripts.text: You mean the Geoborg?
scripts.translation: 你是說吉奧堡？

scripts.text: You mean the Richard?
scripts.translation: 你是說理查德？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我剛才說錯了，因為想到了別的事情。
我搞錯了。你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The family of the previous king ^0000cdbecame so due to the old curse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
前任國王的家族^0000cd因為古老的詛咒^000000才變成了這樣...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Yes, you are right. it is ^0000cdthe Geoborg^000000. The queen must be lonely.
Thank you very much for advising me though you are busy.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
是的，你說得對。是^0000cd吉奧堡^000000。女王一定很孤獨。
雖然你很忙，但還是非常感謝你的提醒。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I have been alone these days as no one has visited the library due to the banquet.
History of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
這幾天因為宴會，沒有人來圖書館，我一直很孤單。
《盧恩·米德加茲的歷史》。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
You can borrow it for one week. There is a fee for overdue books, but I was instructed to make you exempt from it
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
你可以借閱一週。逾期會有罰款，但我被指示對你免除這項費用。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Well, if you make much of honor, you will not be overdue.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
嗯，如果你很看重榮譽，就不會逾期的。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Then, enjoy the book!
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
那麼，祝你閱讀愉快！

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Take the time to look around. Take out and read any book that comes into your favor.
The book always enriches mind.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
花點時間四處看看。拿出並閱讀任何你喜歡的書。
書籍總是能豐富心靈。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
There are so many guests attending the banquet.
However, since we are in the library, would you keep it down?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
參加宴會的客人真多。
不過既然我們在圖書館，請小聲一點好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Are you attending the banquet and exchanging greeting with each family?
Then you should go see Spica Nerius, not me.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
你是去參加宴會，和各家族交換問候的嗎？
那你應該去找斯皮卡·內裡烏斯，而不是我。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Although Shedhar, the current head of the family, is not here, Spica has all the actual power.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
雖然現任家主謝德哈爾不在這裡，但斯皮卡掌握著所有的實權。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am just participating in the Royal Assembly to fill in the place as a Nerius.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
我只是作為內裡烏斯家族的一員，來填補皇家議會的席位罷了。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am not interested in the throne at all.
So you should go see Spica.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
我對王位毫無興趣。
所以你應該去找斯皮卡。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Enjoy the banquet too.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
也請好好享受宴會。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Did you meet Spica?
She is such a cheerful girl, isn't she?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
你見到斯皮卡了嗎？
她真是個開朗的女孩，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Erich]
She will be the head of the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
她將成為內裡烏斯家族的家主。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am treated like a prince since I was adopted against my will. However, Shedhar, the head of the family, has been nice to me.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
我是被違背意願收養的，因此一直被當作王子對待。不過，家主謝德哈爾對我很好。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
She told me to do whatever I wanted.
...She even let me decide whether I should attend the ritual or not,
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
她讓我想做什麼就做什麼。
...甚至讓我自己決定要不要參加儀式，

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I think I will be forgiven whatever I do.
I seem to have gained freedom and negligence at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
我想無論我做什麼都會被原諒。
我似乎同時獲得了自由和疏忽。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I like the way it is now though.
I can do whatever I want to do.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
不過我喜歡現在的狀態。
我可以做任何我想做的事。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh! This! That! This!
And there it is!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
噢！這個！那個！這個！
還有那個！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh, I don't have this book in my collection!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
噢，我的收藏裡沒有這本書！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
How great to be in the palace! There is everything!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
能在皇宮裡真是太好了！這裡什麼都有！

scripts.text:
[Alf]
Oh! This book must be the one from the legend...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
噢！這本書一定是傳說中的那本...

scripts.text:
[Alf]
I wasn't interested in attending the royal banquet...
However, I am glad to be here!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
我本來對參加皇家宴會沒興趣...
不過，我很高興能在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
It is not here either....
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
這裡也沒有....

scripts.text:
[Taunting Man]
Why do you need that book? Just go without it.
scripts.translation:
[出言挑釁的男子]
你為什麼要找那本書？沒有它也沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
The first impression is the most important. The first greeting has a big impact! By the way, what should I speak as a greeting?
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
第一印象最重要。第一次問候影響很大！順便問一下，我該說什麼作為問候？

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
'Good morning, sir. I, an unworthy person, live in Prontera....' No. No. I cannot speak like to a person who is younger than me.
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
“早上好，大人。我，一個不配的人，住在普隆德拉....” 不。不。我不能對比我年輕的人這樣說話。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
Hi? Your brother told me to attend the banquet. No. No. this is not either. My patner is a princess!
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
嗨？你哥哥讓我來參加宴會的。不。不。這也不行。我的搭檔是公主！

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
Why is there no book such as ¡®Royal Etiquette - Meet Princess First Time' It's a royal library.
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
為什麼沒有像《皇家禮儀 - 初次見公主》這樣的書？這可是皇家圖書館。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
He sent me on the excuse of being busy. Jonathan, I'll get you.
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
他以忙碌為藉口把我打發走了。喬納森，我會收拾你的。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
It is not here, either. How can I find it. There are so many books here.
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
這裡也沒有。我該怎麼找到它呢？這裡有太多的書了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Guardian Knight]
Would you enter the Banquet Hall?
scripts.translation:
[皇家守護騎士]
您願意進入宴會廳嗎？

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要進入

scripts.text:
[Royal Guardian Knight]
The Banquet Hall will be open at all times. Please honor the banquet with your presence.
scripts.translation:
[皇家守護騎士]
宴會廳將全天候開放。請蒞臨宴會，以您的出席為榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Royal Guardian Knight]
Let me escort you inside.
scripts.translation:
[皇家守護騎士]
請允許我為您引路。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
Chatting is forbidden while working.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
工作時禁止閒聊。

scripts.text: Please play a song
scripts.translation: 請演奏一首曲子

scripts.text: Wrap up the conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
This is not a song in the program...
How about listening to a song I recommend?
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
這不是節目單上的曲子...
不如聽聽我推薦的曲子？

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <I miss you>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《我想你》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Alpen Rose>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《阿爾卑斯玫瑰》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Tales of East>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《東方傳說》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Dream of Whale>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《鯨魚之夢》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Dazzling Snow>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《璀璨之雪》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Marschmallow Waltz>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《棉花糖圓舞曲》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Eclage>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《埃克拉珠》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <One Step Closer>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《更近一步》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Not so Far away>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《並不遙遠》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Theme of Alberta>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《艾爾貝塔主題》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Splendide Dreams>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《輝煌之夢》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Jittering Nightmare>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《顫慄夢魘》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Yuna Song>.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《尤娜之歌》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Good Morning> which has a sad story behind it.
This is not a song in the program...
How about listening to a song I recommend?
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
我將演奏《早安》，這首歌背後有一個悲傷的故事。
它並不在節目單上...
不如聽聽我推薦的歌曲？

scripts.text: I'll play <Good Morning> which has a sad story behind it.
scripts.translation: 我將演奏《早安》，這首歌背後有一個悲傷的故事。

scripts.text: - Unlike her gaze glaring at the table while being cautious about the surroundings, the speed of her eating the food on the table is so remarkable that it is almost artistic. -
scripts.translation: - 儘管她警惕地環顧四周，目光卻緊緊盯著餐桌，進食的速度快得驚人，簡直堪稱藝術。 -

scripts.text: - There is a girl with a expressionless face looking at the table. Her outfit seems rather unusual in Prontera. She could be a guest attending the banquet. -
scripts.translation: - 一個面無表情的少女正看著餐桌。她的穿著在普隆德拉顯得頗為獨特。她可能是參加宴會的賓客之一。 -

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
...I am hungry.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
......
...我餓了。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
Ah....!

[Glamorous Girl]
You... At Cheshrumnir...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
你...在瑟斯隆尼勒...

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Hum hum!
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
哼哼！

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
...I am sorry Niren...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...對不起，尼倫...

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Shh! Shh! Do not call me by the name, please. We are not officially invited to be here! Don't forget!
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
噓！噓！請不要叫我的名字。我們並沒有正式受邀來到這裡！別忘了這一點！

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
Eh...
How did you come here?
scripts.translation: 你是怎麼來到這裡的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did you come here?
Is it something dangerous? Is it about the international affairs or the international situation...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是怎麼來到這裡的？
是有什麼危險嗎？是關於國際事務還是國際局勢...

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
.....
In secret.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
.....
秘密地。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
...The banquet... Something tasty.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...宴會...美味的食物。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
<Miss Lang>
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
《朗小姐》

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Woman with Glasses]
In the <Miss Lang Guide> which is written by Miss Lang who is the most prominent gourmet in Midgards, there is Prontera Palace.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
在由米德加爾特最著名的美食家朗小姐所著的《朗小姐指南》中，提到了普隆德拉宮殿。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Good food and drink are the most enjoyable things in life. It is worth pursuing them. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
美食美酒是生活中最享受的事物。追求它們是值得的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
....
...It tastes good.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
....
...味道很好。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Anyways, we have managed to find this dining room where aren't many people. But we need to go back soon.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
總之，我們找到了這個沒什麼人的餐廳。但我們得快點回去了。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
I have been telling people that we are in costumes. I guess our outfits are not very appropriate for this kind of occasion in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
我一直告訴別人我們穿的是戲服。看來我們的穿著並不適合普隆德拉這種場合。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Well, I guess you have looked around enough. Let's go back before anyone comes.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
好了，我想你也看夠了。在有人來之前，我們回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
Yes...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
是的...

scripts.text: - However the cookie plate is held tightly by the right hand of the Pope. -
scripts.translation: - 然而，那塊碟仙惡靈被教皇緊緊握在右手中。-

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Oh, who is this.
You are{0}the one who would lead to the highest peaks of dark art, right?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
哦，這位是。
{0}，你就是那位將引領黑暗藝術登上最高峰的人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You've been invited to this banquet too?
Hum, are you the hero of the century recommended by the guild?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
你也受邀參加這場宴會了嗎？
哼，你是公會推薦的本世紀英雄嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Ha, what a nonsense to disregard me, Dumk!
I can never agree to that.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
哈，無視我鄧克簡直是胡鬧！
我絕對無法接受這一點。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
By the way, where is Vicente?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
順便問一下，維森特在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Hey, you assassin, do you know Vicente?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
嘿，你個刺客，你認識維森特嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
...Cut it out there, Dumk...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
...別在那兒胡說了，鄧克...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
It's been a long time. Did you catch up with Lin and Ekinasia?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
好久不見。你追上琳和埃基納西亞了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
They seemed very excited in the fancy place...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
她們在那豪華的地方看起來很興奮...

scripts.text: ...It is a pain to stand in a place where you don't belong...
scripts.translation: ...站在一個不屬於你的地方真是讓人頭疼...

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
You are a visitor to the Prontera Palace.
Do you need a guide?
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
你是普隆德拉宮殿的訪客。
你需要嚮導嗎？

scripts.text: Valkyrie Realm
scripts.translation: 瓦爾基里雷恩

scripts.text: Royal Villa
scripts.translation: 皇家別墅

scripts.text: Banquet Hall
scripts.translation: 宴會廳

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
You may move to the northern corridor from here.
There is the entrance to Valkyrie Realm in the middle of the northern corridor.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
你可以從這裡前往北走廊。
北走廊的中間是瓦爾基里雷恩的入口。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
The door on the left is the entrance to the royal villa.
There are the residences for the Heine, Nerius and Walther families and a room reserved for a special guest.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
左邊的門是皇家別墅的入口。
那裡有海爾內、內裡烏斯和瓦爾特家族的住所，以及一間為特殊客人預留的房間。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
You can enter the Banquet Hall through the big gate which appears when you go to the center by following the corridor on the right from here.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
沿著右邊的走廊走到中間，會出現一扇大門，你可以從那裡進入宴會廳。

scripts.text:
[Noblesse Operator]
Hello.
We have ^4d4dffNoblesse^000000 equipment that can be exchanged for {0}.
I will guide you to exchange items according to your job.
scripts.translation:
[貴族操作員]
您好。
這裡有可以用{0}兌換的^4d4dff貴族^000000裝備。
我會根據您的職業引導您進行兌換。

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
You can exchange the Honor Marks given by the noble people of Rune-Midgarts as the token of trust with some valuable items of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[軍需官 阿納爾]
您可以將盧恩·米德加茲的貴族們作為信任象徵贈送的榮譽勳章，兌換成普隆德拉的一些珍貴物品。

scripts.text: Consumables
scripts.translation: 消耗品

scripts.text: Armors
scripts.translation: 防具

scripts.text: View item description
scripts.translation: 檢視物品說明

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
Would you view the item description?
scripts.translation:
[軍需官 阿納爾]
您要檢視物品說明嗎？

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
The ^3131FF{0}s^000000 you can exchange with the Honor Marks are as follows.
scripts.translation:
[軍需官 阿納爾]
以下是可以用榮譽勳章兌換的^3131FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
^3131FF{0}^000000... You've been looking at this.
It is a useful-looking {1}.
It can be exchanged for ^FF0000{2} Honor Marks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[軍需官 阿納爾]
^3131FF{0}^000000...您一直在看這個。
這是一個看起來很有用的{1}。
可以用^FF0000{2}榮譽勳章^000000兌換。

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 兌換

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
For the glory of Prontera!
scripts.translation:
[軍需官 阿納爾]
為了普隆德拉的榮耀！

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
You don't have enough Honor Marks.
scripts.translation:
[軍需官 阿納爾]
您的榮譽勳章不足。

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
It is the symbol of honor in Prontera. Please take good care of it.
scripts.translation:
[軍需官 阿納爾]
這是普隆德拉榮譽的象徵。請妥善保管。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Are you the adventurer invited to the banquet every one is talking about?
Do you have any <Honor Marks>? Would you give them to me?
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
你就是那個被邀請參加人人都在談論的宴會的冒險者嗎？
你有<榮譽勳章>嗎？能給我一些嗎？

scripts.text: Why do you need them?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼要它們？

scripts.text: Give 30 Honor Marks.
scripts.translation: 給予30個榮譽勳章

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Even if I work so hard here my entire life, I would always live in the shade.
If you are a man, you should dream big. I always say that to Arner, but he is just too priggery.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
即使我在這裡辛苦工作一輩子，也總是活在陰影裡。
如果是男人，就應該有遠大的夢想。我總是對阿納爾這麼說，但他就是太死板了。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
I don't dream of becoming rich overnight, but I do want to have some honor since I am a man.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
我不夢想一夜暴富，但既然我是個男人，我就想要一些榮譽。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
The aristocrats would never let me handle some great opportunity though. However, you may have acquired some <Honor Marks>, right?
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
貴族們絕不會讓我處理什麼大機會。不過，你可能已經獲得了一些<榮譽勳章>，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
If you give me ^FF0000 30 <Honor Marks>^000000, I'll give you something really useful.
For people like us, the <Honor Marks> mean rapid promotion.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
如果你給我^FF0000 30個<榮譽勳章>^000000，我會給你一些真正有用的東西。
對我們這種人來說，<榮譽勳章>意味著快速晉升。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
What I have is a wrapped box which is one of the items that Arner has.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
我手裡有一個包裹好的盒子，那是阿納爾擁有的物品之一。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
It is authentic for that it has been made to be distributed to the nobility. However, I don't know what's in there. It depends on your luck.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
它是正品，因為它是專門製作來分發給貴族的。但我不知道里面是什麼。這取決於你的運氣。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
After collecting all the Honor Marks, I'll take that build a castle on the shore and spend the rest of my life there with that stubborn Arner.
That stupid Arner. If it was not for me, he would stay in the palace exchanging things until he dies.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
收集完所有的榮譽勳章後，我要在海邊建一座城堡，和那個固執的阿納爾一起度過餘生。
那個愚蠢的阿納爾。要不是有我，他會在宮殿裡一直兌換東西直到老死。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
I have told you I need 30 of them.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
我告訴過你，我需要30個。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Thank you. This is the thing I have promised.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
謝謝。這就是我答應給你的東西。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
How terrifying.
This must be Prontera in the past?
I guess we have picked the right time to be here-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好可怕。
這應該是過去的普隆德拉吧？
看來我們選對了時間來到這裡——

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Shall we look around more?
Or go back?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們要不要四處看看？
還是回去？

scripts.text: It that possible?
scripts.translation: 這有可能嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa, don't you underestimate me.
I am a Court Mage.
I studied in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇，別小看我。
我是宮廷魔法師。
我在埃克拉珠學習過。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I have also learned a lot of things at the Cat Paw Services!
I believe that I have the most thorough knowledge when it comes to the crack of dimension!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我在貓爪服務處也學到了很多！
我相信在維度裂縫這方面，我的知識是最淵博的！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As long as it is from a place on the crack of dimension,
It is a piece of care to go back!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
只要是從維度裂縫中的某個地方出發，
回去就是一件小事！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Since we don't belong to this time, it is much easier to get out than to enter.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
既然我們不屬於這個時代，離開比進入要容易得多。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
So, what are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那麼，你打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Let's get in.
scripts.translation: 讓我們進去。

scripts.text: Let's go back to our time.
scripts.translation: 讓我們回到我們的時代。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Do you remember the gate we got out?
It is supposed to be connected to the inside of the palace.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你還記得我們出來的那個門嗎？
它應該連線著宮殿內部。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
However, we arrived here. I guess the spaces are twisted a little so that they are connected.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
然而我們來到了這裡。我想空間稍微扭曲了一下，所以它們連線在了一起。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I have already experimented this. If you enter the entrance to the palace,
It is connected to the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 which we have just been to.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我已經實驗過了。如果你進入宮殿的入口，
它會連線到我們剛才去過的^4d4dff王室往事^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, shall we march in?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那麼，我們要不要進去看看？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa, shall we organize the thoughts now?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇，我們現在整理一下思路嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^4d4dffWhat was in the Room of Consciousness^000000 must have been...
Well, this must have something to do with ^4d4dffthe undead army attacking Prontera^000000 now.
Well, it must have been ^4d4dfftaken away by them^000000, am I right?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^4d4dff意識室^000000裡原本的東西一定是...
嗯，這肯定和現在^4d4dff亡靈大軍襲擊普隆德拉^000000有關。
嗯，一定是^4d4dff被他們拿走了^000000，對吧？

scripts.text: Right.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Can we stop this?
Or, can we take it with us?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們能阻止這件事嗎？
或者，我們能把它帶走嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I believe our superiors will order us to do so.
Try whatever it takes to make it work.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我相信上級會命令我們這樣做的。
盡一切辦法讓它成功吧。

scripts.text: I guess so.
scripts.translation: 我想是的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Perhaps, well it is just my imagination though.
Whatever was in the Room of Consciousness was taken, right?
However, the royal families have been performing the ritual without knowing that somehow.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
也許，這只是我的想像。
意識室裡的東西被拿走了，對吧？
然而，王室家族一直在進行儀式，卻對此毫不知情。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
They must have done something or it must have returned...
This could meet the condition to see the sealed part of the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
他們一定做了什麼，或者它已經回來了...
這或許能讓我們看到被封印的^4d4dff王室家族的記憶^000000...

scripts.text: You mean, the ones who know the truth?
scripts.translation: 你是說，那些知道真相的人？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Yes, I mean that. If this is the truth which is the key to open the seal,
We are bringing an important piece of information back with us.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
是的，我是那個意思。如果這就是開啟封印的關鍵真相，
那麼我們就帶著重要的情報回來了。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
We didn't protect or take the thing...
But we know the truth now. It will break the seal of the document...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們並沒有保護或帶走那個東西...
但我們現在知道了真相。這會打破檔案的封印...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As the secret of the royal family is revealed, we will get the missing pieces of the puzzle.
Hahahaha, and you are the one who would be the center of all that, my darling!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
隨著王室秘密的揭露，我們將拼湊出缺失的拼圖。
哈哈哈哈哈，而你將成為這一切的中心，我的親愛的！

scripts.text: Don't call me that!
scripts.translation: 別那樣叫我！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What about it?
We will see each other everyday from now on, won't we?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那又怎樣？
從現在開始，我們每天都會見面，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, shall we go back then?
Our mission here is done for now!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，我們回去吧？
我們在這裡的任務暫時完成了！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's go back!
Nothing good can be done staying in a place which is not of our time too long
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們回去吧！
在一個不屬於我們時代的地方待太久，不會有什麼好事的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, then get ready!
Three!
Two!
One!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，準備好！
三！
二！
一！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha! This place is exciting...
...As always.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈！這個地方真刺激...
...一如既往。

scripts.text: Let's get out of here!
scripts.translation: 讓我們離開這裡！

scripts.text: I'll look around.
scripts.translation: 我要四處看看。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Have a safe trip!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
祝你旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's go it!
Forget everything and let's get out-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
讓我們走吧！
忘掉一切，讓我們離開——

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hey, you need to be cured first.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嘿，你得先接受治療。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh... Those undead bastards... I'll kill them all...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
可惡...那些不死族混蛋...我要殺光他們...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh.... Those undead...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
可惡....那些不死族...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My colleague who had been laughing with me just... Aww...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
剛才還和我一起笑的同事...唉...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please. Don't get yourself killed by the enemy.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
拜託了。別被敵人殺了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
What was it that had dropped from the sky? How could it bring the undead to the capital?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
剛才從天上掉下來的是什麼？它怎麼能把不死族帶到首都？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I'll... I'll make sure to defend this place.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我會...我會誓死保衛這裡。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The endless battle against the enemies...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
與敵人的無盡戰鬥...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
An eccentric scientist, Doyeon, went out there with soldiers, and there has been no message from them. I am getting worried.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
那位古怪的科學家道淵帶著士兵們出去了，至今沒有訊息。我很擔心。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Damn it... Those undead...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
該死...那些不死族...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Scientist Doyeon... Would she be OK? How can she go out there to study in a situation like this?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
科學家道淵...她沒事吧？在這種局勢下，她怎麼能出去研究？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The troops of immortality... They are really strong. Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
不死族的軍隊...他們真的很強。請小心。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We will defend the palace of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我們要保衛普隆德拉的王宮。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My family live in Prontera. I wonder if they have fled safely.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我的家人住在普隆德拉。不知道他們是否安全撤離了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Thank god... The undead are not coming this way much. What a relief.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
謝天謝地...不死族沒有朝這邊來。真是鬆了口氣。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My friend has followed Scientist Doyeon. I am worried. I have heard that she really is an oddball.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我的朋友跟著科學家道淵出去了。我很擔心。聽說她真的很古怪。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hahaha, I was supposed to have a romantic dinner with my girlfriend, damn it!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，我本來要和女朋友吃浪漫晚餐的，該死！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Humph! Bring it on!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哼！來吧！

scripts.text: [Soldier]
scripts.translation: [士兵]

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Are you an adventurer? I am sorry, but I am in the middle of something. Please leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
你是冒險者嗎？抱歉，我手頭正忙。請別打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I thank you on behalf of the Prontera Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
謹代表普隆德拉衛兵向您致謝。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
We will make sure to end the battle with the undead as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我們會盡快結束與不死族的戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier dispatched to the area near the village office that you helped the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我聽說被派往村公所附近計程車兵說，您幫助了村民們。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
He is a young man who has been hanging around in the village for a while. He seems to work diligently...
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
他是個在村裡待了一段時間的年輕男子。看起來工作很勤勉...

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
However, Mr. Quadro who runs Prontera Smelter seems to have lost an important document in the chaos.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
不過，經營普隆德拉冶煉廠的誇德羅先生似乎在混亂中丟失了一份重要檔案。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
He is the one in charge of the weapons used by the guards. I am worried if it would cause any trouble in his work.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
他負責管理衛兵使用的武器。我擔心這會給他的工作帶來麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Oh! Anyways, thank you for helping the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
哦！總之，感謝您幫助了村民們。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
由於目前局勢艱難，我們無法提供太豐厚的獎勵，但這是衛兵們為您準備的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldiers dispatched to the Knights' building that you saved Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我聽說被派往騎士團計程車兵說，您救了洛溫。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Lowen is a spirited girl who claims that she likes the Crusaders to the Royal Lord Knights.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
洛溫是個活潑的女孩，她聲稱自己從十字軍喜歡到了騎士領主。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Rosa who is the younger sister to the girl is also popular among our soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
那個女孩的妹妹羅莎，在我們士兵中也很受歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I thank you on behalf of the Prontera Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
謹代表普隆德拉衛兵向您致謝。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
由於目前局勢艱難，我們無法提供太豐厚的獎勵，但這是衛兵們為您準備的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier dispatched to the village office that a soldier on his vacation has been fled here.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我聽說被派往村公所計程車兵說，一名休假中計程車兵逃到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I guess there has been a soldier on vacation during such a difficult time. I had been ignorant of it before I got the report.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我想，在如此艱難的時刻，竟然有士兵在休假。在收到報告之前，我對此毫不知情。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I am faced with my inadequacies as the one in charge of the security of the capital.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
作為負責首都安全的人，我深感自己的不足。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
由於目前局勢艱難，我們無法提供太豐厚的獎勵，但這是衛兵們為您準備的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier in the cathedral that you saved the couple, Eryus and Ellie.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我聽說大教堂計程車兵說，您救了那對情侶，埃裡烏斯和艾莉。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I think I have heard of their names. I have heard that they irritate the minds of lonely soldiers with their endless public display of affection.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我想我聽說過他們的名字。聽說他們無休止的公開示愛行為，讓那些孤獨計程車兵們感到心煩。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Everyone in Prontera must know about it. Anyways, thank you for doing this for the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
普隆德拉的人肯定都知道這件事。總之，感謝您為衛兵們做了這件事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
由於目前局勢艱難，我們無法提供太豐厚的獎勵，但這是衛兵們為您準備的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I'll mark the places to which the soldiers haven't been dispatched to due to circumstances on the map.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我會把那些由於情況特殊，未能派遣士兵前往的地方標記在地圖上。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Please help any villagers in trouble if you find them.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
如果您發現有村民陷入困境，請幫助他們。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Don't stand there in the middle of our line! Watch out!
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
別站在我們隊伍中間！小心點！

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
If you are hurt step back to get yourself cured. If you are recovered, get back in the line.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
如果你受傷了，就退後接受治療。如果恢復了，就回到隊伍中。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Huh? I haven't seen you before. You seem like a civilian. Why are you coming from there?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
咦？我沒見過你。你看起來像是平民。你為什麼會從那裡過來？

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
What? Have the undead entered the palace already?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
什麼？不死族已經攻入宮殿了嗎？

scripts.text: No... I don't think so... I am just...
scripts.translation: 不...我不這麼認為...我只是...

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
So you are supposed to be an adventurer invited to the banquet, right?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
所以你是受邀參加宴會的冒險者，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Has there been a banquet in the palace lately? I don't remember.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
最近宮殿裡有宴會嗎？我不記得了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Well... Since we are busy dealing with
the undead invading the village, as long as the palace is safe from the undead, I won't make a big deal out of it.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
嗯...既然我們正忙於應對入侵村莊的不死族，只要宮殿沒有受到不死族的威脅，我就不會深究這件事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I won't stop you from moving around the town. I'll mark the places to which the soldiers haven't been dispatched to due to circumstances on the map.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我不會阻止你在城鎮裡走動。我會把那些由於情況特殊，未能派遣士兵前往的地方標記在地圖上。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Please help any villagers in trouble if you find them.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
如果您發現有村民陷入困境，請幫助他們。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... You are not an undead, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哇...你不是不死族，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Haha... I am alive now.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哈哈...我現在還活著。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you know how scare I have been? This place was packed with the undead, and I heard screams from everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
你知道我有多害怕嗎？這裡到處都是不死族，我還聽到四面八方傳來的尖叫聲。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Thank god... The shelter is supposed to be near the village office over there. Why don't we continue this conversation there?
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
謝天謝地...避難所應該就在那邊的村委會附近。我們要不去那裡繼續聊？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
你看得見我嗎？真奇怪。我不應該被看見的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Huh...? What a nerve! That guy... Save a stranger from the sea, and heùéll ask for more...
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哼...？真是大膽！這傢伙...從海里救了一個陌生人，還想要更多...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! I wasn't going to eavesdrop. Please don't get me wrong.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哦！我並沒有在偷聽。請別誤會。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Dear adventurer. I believe that uniform is worn by the Guards of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
親愛的冒險者。我相信那身制服是吉芬衛兵穿的。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Who is that soldier? He seems to enter the shelter so smoothly in a situation like this. He confuses me.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
那個士兵是誰？在這種局勢下，他進入避難所的樣子如此從容，讓我感到困惑。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
這裡是村委會，也就是普隆德拉的第三個避難所。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... I am saved. How fortunate. I guess I am a lucky man.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哇...我獲救了。真幸運。看來我是個幸運的人。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Wait? Where did it go? I think I lost the Tool Bag while I was running.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
等等？它去哪了？我想我逃跑的時候把工具包弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
I can guess where it has been dropped...
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
我可以猜到它掉落在哪裡了...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
You must be pretty tough to roam the village in a situation like this. Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
在這種局勢下還能在村裡四處走動，你一定很強壯。請幫我一個忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you know where the Prontera Smelter is?
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
你知道普隆德拉的冶煉廠在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
It is quite a famous store in Prontera. Someday, I will...
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
那是普隆德拉很有名的一家店。總有一天，我會...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! Never mind. I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哦！算了。就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... I thought I have lost it. You really found it!
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哇...我還以為它丟了。你真的找到了！

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
This is awesome. Thank you so much. You must be busy, right? I have to go take care of something now...
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
太棒了。非常感謝。你肯定很忙吧？我現在得去處理點事情...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! I know you are strong enough, but please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哦！我知道你很強，但請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Thank you. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
謝謝。再見。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
你看得見我嗎？真奇怪。我不應該被看見的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
In front of the Prontera Smelter
There a bag which would be full if you put some items.
scripts.translation:
普隆德拉冶煉廠前
這裡有一個袋子，如果你放入一些物品，它會變得很滿。

scripts.text: Pick up.
scripts.translation: 撿起

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: You have acquired a bag.
scripts.translation: 你獲得了一個袋子。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
這裡是村委會，也就是普隆德拉的第三個避難所。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Oh! Dear {0}... That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
哦！親愛的{0}...那條腰帶？看起來像是被不死族殺害的同事的遺物。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you ride a {0}.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
請把它交給我，讓我安撫他可憐的靈魂。雖然因為緊急情況服務已暫停，但讓我幫你騎乘{0}吧。

scripts.text: Use the service.
scripts.translation: 使用服務

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
I see. Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
明白了。那麼，再見。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to learn how to ride a {0} first.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您需要先學會如何騎乘{0}。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already using a {0}.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您已經在騎乘{0}了。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to let go of the bridle to ride a {0}.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
你需要鬆開韁繩才能騎乘{0}。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
謝謝。如果你發現其他陣亡士兵留下的物品，請帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
這裡是村委會，也就是普隆德拉的第三個避難所。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Oh, dear Mechanic! That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
哦，親愛的機匠！那條腰帶？看起來像是被不死族殺害的同事的遺物。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you borrow a Cart or ride a Magical Gear.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
請把它交給我，讓我安撫他可憐的靈魂吧。雖然因為緊急情況服務已經停止，但我可以幫你租用手推車，或者騎乘魔導裝甲。

scripts.text: Borrow a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推車

scripts.text: Ride a Magical Gear
scripts.translation: 騎乘魔導裝甲

scripts.text: Do not use it.
scripts.translation: 不使用

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
You are already using a Cart.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
您已經在騎乘手推車了。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
謝謝。如果你發現其他陣亡士兵留下的物品，請帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
You cannot ride another magical gear since you are already riding one.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
您已經在騎乘魔導裝甲了，無法再騎乘另一輛。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Go get a license to ride a magical gear first.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
請先去辦理騎乘魔導裝甲的許可證。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
謝謝。如果你發現其他陣亡士兵留下的物品，請帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Oh... Really. I see.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
噢...是嗎。我知道了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text: Hey dear, are you OK?
scripts.translation: 嘿，親愛的，你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
I was running to the church with my sister, Rosa... And I lost her... Awww...
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
我正和姐姐羅莎跑向教堂...然後我弄丟她了...嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Rosa should have held on to my hand tightly. How clumsy of her to be lost!
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
羅莎應該緊緊抓住我的手的。她怎麼這麼笨，居然走丟了！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Would you take me to the cathedral?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
你能帶我去大教堂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
We promised to meet at the cathedral when we are lost. I believe she would be there in the church.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
我們約定好走散時在大教堂見面。我相信她會在教堂裡。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
噢？你能看見我嗎？真奇怪。我不應該被看見的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Please take care of Lowen. She is like a mascot to us in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
請照顧好洛溫。她對我們普隆德拉來說就像吉祥物一樣。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Ellie is really fragile. I hope she is all right.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
艾莉真的很虛弱。希望她沒事。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, my... Ellie is in a critical condition. I hope a priest comes out to help her if there is one in there.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
噢，天哪...艾莉的情況很危急。希望裡面有牧師能出來救救她。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Thank you for your effort. We will devote our lives to protect the cathedral from the undead coming this way.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
謝謝你的努力。我們將獻出生命，保護大教堂免受湧來的不死族侵害。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
This the cathedral which is the first shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
這裡是普隆德拉的第一個避難所——大教堂。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
That belt... It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead. Would you mind giving it to me?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
那條腰帶...看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同事的。你介意把它交給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
I know it is an emergency, but I'd like to comfort the soul of my colleague.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
我知道情況緊急，但我想安撫我同事的亡魂。

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 給他

scripts.text: Do not give it him.
scripts.translation: 不給他

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, I see. Please bring them to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
噢，我明白了。如果你改變主意，請把它帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
噢，你是在哪裡弄丟那條腰帶的？

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Thank you. I guess the dead may rest in peace now. This is the only thing that I can offer you... However...
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
謝謝。我想逝者終於可以安息了。這是我唯一能給你的...不過...

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
If you find more articles left by the soldiers, would you please bring them to me?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
如果你發現更多士兵留下的遺物，請帶給我好嗎？

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Dear crusader!
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
噢！親愛的十字軍！
那條腰帶？看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同事的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Dear paladin!
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
噢！親愛的聖殿十字軍！
那條腰帶？看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同事的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
那條腰帶？看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同事的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me call Pecopeco for you.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
請把它交給我，讓我安撫他可憐的亡魂吧。雖然因為緊急情況服務暫停了，但我可以為你呼叫大嘴鳥。

scripts.text: Use the service.
scripts.translation: 使用服務

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh... Really. I see.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
噢...真是的。我明白了。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear crusader
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
親愛的十字軍
噢！你是在哪裡弄丟那條腰帶的？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear paladin
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
親愛的聖殿十字軍
噢！你是在哪裡弄丟那條腰帶的？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
噢！你是在哪裡弄丟那條腰帶的？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh... I guess you should learn how to ride a Pecopeco first.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
噢...我想你應該先學會怎麼騎大嘴鳥。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You are already using the Pecopeco.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
你已經在騎大嘴鳥了。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You need to let go of the bridle to ride it.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
你需要鬆開韁繩才能騎上去。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
謝謝。如果你發現其他陣亡士兵留下的遺物，請帶給我。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh, I am an uncle now...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
噢，我現在是個叔叔了...

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
If you are here to borrow a PecoPeco, I have to say I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
如果您是想借大嘴鳥，我很抱歉，恐怕不行。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Due to the emergency situation, all troops of Prontera are deployed to protect the residents of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
由於緊急情況，普隆德拉的所有部隊都已部署，以保護普隆德拉的居民。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Whoa, thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
哇，太感謝你了！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Rosa! Rosa!
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
蘿莎！蘿莎！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh, Uncle Peco, did you see my sister here?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
噢，大嘴鳥叔叔，你看到我的姐姐了嗎？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Cough... Uncle...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
咳...叔叔...

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You mean Rosa? Do you mean Rosa? I haven't seen Rosa here. Wasn't she coming with you?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
你是說蘿莎？你是說蘿莎嗎？我沒在這裡見到蘿莎。她不是和你一起來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Aww... Rosa, where are you now?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
唉...蘿莎，你現在在哪裡呢？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
She could have gone to the Knights' building. Weren't you sisters supposed to go to the shelter there?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
她可能去了騎士團的大樓。你們姐妹不是應該去那裡的避難所嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Eh? It must have not been the cathedral then... Huh? What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
咦？那就不是大教堂了...啊？我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear adventurer, if you are not in a hurry, would you help Lowen flee to the Knights' building?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
親愛的冒險者，如果您不趕時間，能幫洛溫逃往騎士團的大樓嗎？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Lowen's sister is a careful girl, unlike Lowen. She must have fled to the Knights' building.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
洛溫的姐姐是個細心的女孩，不像洛溫。她一定已經逃往騎士團的大樓了。

scripts.text: Since I am here already, let me keep helping her.
scripts.translation: 既然我已經在這裡了，就讓我繼續幫她吧。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Thank you. Please take care of her.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
謝謝你。請照顧好她。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
噢？你能看見我嗎？真奇怪。我不應該被看見的。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
This the knight's building which is the second shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
這裡是騎士團的大樓，是普隆德拉的第二避難所。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Knight Gray]
Are you the one who has helped Sister Erinin? What a relief that we have someone like you?
scripts.translation:
[騎士 格雷]
你是幫助了艾琳姐姐的人嗎？有你在真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Knight Gray]
With the honor of the knight, I'll protect the villagers inside.
scripts.translation:
[騎士 格雷]
以騎士的榮譽，我會保護裡面的村民。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
Are you here to hire a mercenary?
scripts.translation:
[傭兵公會管理員]
您是來僱傭傭兵的？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
I am sorry, but all mercenaries dispatched in this area have been hired by the palace.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵公會管理員]
很抱歉，這個區域的所有傭兵都已被宮殿徵召。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵公會管理員]
很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Lowen, where did you go this time?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎·埃裡寧]
洛溫，你這次又跑到哪裡去了？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Hehe... Thank you, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
嘿嘿... 謝謝你，親愛的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Oh! Dear adventurer, thank you. She is so handful, you know.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎·埃裡寧]
哦！親愛的冒險者，謝謝你。這孩子總是讓人操心。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
She is so delicate, but she is reckless. I am worried about her.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎·埃裡寧]
她雖然很嬌弱，但做事卻總是魯莽。我很擔心她。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Well, we shall go hide in there so that the knights here don't need to worry about us anymore.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎·埃裡寧]
好了，我們進去躲起來吧，這樣這裡的騎士們就不用再為我們擔心了。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Thank you. Goodbye!
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
謝謝。再見！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
噢？你能看見我嗎？真奇怪。我不應該被看見的。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Dear adventurer, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎·埃裡寧]
親愛的冒險者，你看得見我嗎？奇怪，我不應該被看見的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh! The undead! Bring it on!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
啊！亡靈！來吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, what would be the use of telling them to bring it on when you are hiding in there...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你自己都躲在這裡，喊他們“來吧”有什麼用...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You adventurer don't understand it. I am pushed to this corner after a long battle against the undead.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你不懂，冒險者。在與亡靈激戰許久之後，我被逼到了這個角落。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You must be quite courageous for walking around the town in a situation like this.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
在這種局勢下還能在鎮上走動，你一定很勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You must be as brave as I am... The hero who has subjugated the Kobolds in Geffen...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你一定和我一樣勇敢... 在吉芬降服了刺錘犬妖的英雄...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hahahahaha
Just in time. I was getting exhausted by the attacks of the undead.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈哈哈哈
來得正好。我已經被亡靈的襲擊弄得精疲力竭了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I am on the way to go hide in the shelter nearby. Would you come with me?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我正打算去附近的避難所躲起來。你願意跟我一起嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, sure.

[Soldier]
Good. Since I am tired from the previous battle, please escort me to the Knight's building.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
很好。既然我之前的戰鬥已經讓我累了，請護送我去騎士團的大樓。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，你看得見我嗎？奇怪，我不應該被看見的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Thank god, you heard my voice.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
謝天謝地，你聽到了我的聲音。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I was going to help the knights defending the knight's building since I heard that many residents had been fled there. However, there seem to be enough troops here.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我本來想去幫助守衛騎士團大樓的騎士們，因為我聽說很多居民都逃到了那裡。不過，這裡的兵力似乎已經足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
If I show my face, it may just disturb their concentration. I'd rather go without seeing them.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
如果我露出臉來，可能會打擾到他們的注意力。我寧願就這樣不見面地離開。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I shall go join the defense on another place. I guess I can join the troops at the village office down there.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我要去別的地方支援防禦了。我想去下面那個村莊辦公室，加入那裡的部隊。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Since I want to save my energy for the battle, please escort me to the village office.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
為了在戰鬥中保留體力，請護送我去村莊辦公室。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，你看得見我嗎？奇怪，我不應該被看見的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
There are not many people guarding this place.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
這裡守衛的人不多。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I should go help them now.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我現在應該去幫助他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is such a secluded place, and there are 3 soldiers here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡很偏僻，而且有3名士兵。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Dear adventurer, you know nothing.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
親愛的冒險者，你一無所知。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Oh, I wasn't going to tell you this story, because I didn't want to boast...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
噢，我本來不想告訴你這件事的，因為我不想炫耀...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Millions of Kobolds have invaded Geffen before.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
以前曾有數百萬只刺錘犬妖入侵吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The endless march of the Kobolds...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
刺錘犬妖無盡的行軍...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Huh... Thinking about it makes me sweat...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
呼...想想就讓我冷汗直流...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Well,, from my experience, a place like this is the toughest to guard when the enemies march in out of blue.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嗯，根據我的經驗，當敵人突然來襲時，像這樣的地方是最難防守的。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
It is a secret that it is the greatest timing for the rise of a hero.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
這是一個秘密，這正是英雄崛起的最佳時機。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I'll take a rest inside, and come out to save these people when this place is in danger. You shall go save another place.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我會在裡面休息，當這裡陷入危險時再出來拯救這些人。你去拯救其他地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，你看得見我嗎？奇怪，我不應該被看見的。

scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Are you an adventurer?
Oh, Odin... Thank you! Dear adventurer, please find my wife.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
你是冒險者嗎？
噢，奧丁...謝謝你！親愛的冒險者，請幫我找到我的妻子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What happened here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
It happened in the evening, at dusk.
With a roaring sound, we heard that something dropped near the old swordsmen's guild.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
那是傍晚，黃昏時分。
伴隨著轟鳴聲，我們聽到有什麼東西掉落在老劍士公會附近。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Many residents gathered around the area to find out what had caused such a commotion.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
許多居民聚集在那片區域，想弄清楚是什麼引起了這麼大的騷動。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
I went down there with my wife Ellie.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我和妻子艾莉也去了那裡。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
When the people gathered, and night fell, the undead which had been buried under the ground of Prontera started waking up.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
當人群聚集，夜幕降臨時，埋在普隆德拉地下的不死族開始甦醒了。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
People freaked. While running around, I lost hold of my wife's hand.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
人們驚慌失措。在四處奔逃中，我鬆開了妻子的手。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Oh, Ellie... My wife is a very fragile woman. I hope she is all right.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
啊，艾莉...我的妻子是個柔弱的女子。希望她沒事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let me go find her. You should go hide in the cathedral. I'll take you there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我去找她。你應該去大教堂躲藏。我帶你去。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Awww... Please help me. Please find my wife.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
嗚嗚...請幫幫我。請找到我的妻子。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Awww... I need to find my wife... And I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
嗚嗚...我必須找到我的妻子...而且我不應該被人看到。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Awww... Please help me. Please find my wife... I am really worried about her.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
嗚嗚...請幫幫我。請找到我的妻子...我非常擔心她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait in the cathedral. I'll look for your wife. Where did you lose her?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在大教堂等著。我去找你的妻子。你在哪裡和她走散的？

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Aww... I must have forgotten to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
哎呀...我忘了告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
I lost hold of her hand near the Prontera employment agency.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我在普隆德拉的就業機構附近鬆開了她的手。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
I am not sure if she is still there...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我不確定她是否還在那裡...

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Aww... Please help me, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Oh! Thank god! Dear adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
哦！感謝上帝！親愛的冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Ellie]
Oh, Eryus... Cough... Cough...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，埃裡烏斯...咳...咳...

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Ellie, what is going on? Are you ill again? Where is your medicine?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
艾莉，怎麼了？你又生病了嗎？你的藥在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Ellie]
Cough... Cough... I must have dropped it while running...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
咳...咳...我跑動的時候可能把它弄掉了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where did you drop the medicine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你把藥掉在哪裡了？

scripts.text:
[Ellie]
Cough... Cough... I don't know. Cough, it could be there... Cough... Cough...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
咳...咳...我不知道。咳，可能在那裡...咳...咳...

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Where you were before? Wait a moment. Let me go get it for you.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
你剛才所在的地方？等一下。讓我去給你拿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is dangerous out there. I'll go. You should stay here and take care of your wife.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
外面很危險。我去。你應該留在這裡照顧你的妻子。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Would you do that for us? Please. We are running out of time. Ellie. hold on...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
你願意為我們做這件事嗎？請。我們時間不多了。艾莉，堅持住...

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Please. We are running out of time.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
拜託了。我們時間不多了。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Oh, you are here.
The priest of the cathedral is taking care of my wife in there.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
哦，你來了。
大教堂的牧師正在裡面照顧我的妻子。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Thank you for helping us. I guess I shall bring the medicine to her as fast as possible.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
謝謝你幫助我們。我想我得儘快把藥帶給她。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Thank you so much. God bless your journey...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
非常感謝。願上帝保佑你的旅途...

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Awww... I need to find my wife... And I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
嗚嗚...我必須找到我的妻子...而且我不應該被人看到。

Who are you?

[艾莉]
你是誰？

[{0}]
I have been asked by your husband.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Ellie]
Oh... He is such a kind person... He must have been in danger as well, but he still cares about me...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
噢...他真是個善良的人...他肯定也身處險境，卻還惦記著我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Prontera, the Capital of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]
Welcome to Prontera
in the heart of Rune-Midgarts!
Prontera is located
in the center of the continent,
and it is famous as the busy city
of commerce and trade.
scripts.translation:
[盧恩·米德加茲王國首都 普隆德拉]
歡迎來到盧恩·米德加茲心臟地帶的普隆德拉！
普隆德拉位於大陸中心，
以繁忙的商業和貿易城市而聞名。

[盧恩·米德加茲王國首都 普隆德拉]
這裡有主要建築，包括可以進行十字軍轉職的普隆德拉宮殿；
可以進行服事、牧師轉職並舉行婚禮儀式的普隆德拉大教堂；
以及騎士團建築等。

scripts.text:
[Prontera, the Capital of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]
There are many people and stores
as well so make sure to look around.
scripts.translation:
[盧恩·米德加茲王國首都 普隆德拉]
這裡有許多人和商店，
請務必四處看看。

scripts.text:
[Prontera, the Capital of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]
Also, in the south east of the central fountain,
there is the historic Quadro Blacksmith's Workshop.
Drop by the place if you want to get
your equipment
repaired.
scripts.translation:

有歷史悠久的誇德羅鐵匠鋪。
如果你想修理裝備，
不妨去那裡看看。

scripts.translation:

東南方是依斯魯得島，南方是斐揚，西方是吉芬，北方是艾爾帕蘭。
